Tanya, Part I; Likkutei Amarim 36: Vehinne, mudaat zot maamar rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha, shettachlit beriat olam hazze hu – shennitavva hakkadosh-baruch-hu lihyot lo dira battachtonim.
Vehinne, lo shayyaych lefanav yitbarech bechinat mala umatta, ki hu yitbarech memalle kol almin beshave.

Ella beur hainyan, ki kodem shennivra haolam haya hu levaddo yitbarech yachid umeyuchad, umemalle kol hammakom hazze shebbara bo haolam, vegam atta ken hu lefanav yitbarech. rak shehashshinnuy hu el hamekabbelim chayyuto veoro yitbarech, shemmekabbelim al yede levushim rabbim hamechassim umastirim oro yitbarech, kedichtiv: "ki lo yirani haadam vachay", vechidfershu rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha, sheafilu malachim hannikraim "chayyot" en roin kulei.

Vezehu inyan hishtalshelut haolamot viridatam mimmadrega lemadrega, al yede ribbuy hallevushim hammastirim haor vehachayyut shemmimmennu yitbarech, ad shennivra olam hazze haggashmi vehachumeri mammash, vehu hattachton bammadrega, sheen tachton lematta mimmennu beinyan hester oro yitbarech vechoshech kaful umechuppal, ad shehu male kelippot vesitra ochora, shehen neged Adonai mammash, lomar: "ani veafsi od".

Vehinne, tachlit hishtalshelut haolamot viridatam mimmadrega lemadrega – eno bishvil olamot haelyonim, hoil velahem yerida meor panav yitbarech, ella hattachlit hu olam hazze hattachton, shekkach ala birtzono yitbarech, lihyot nachat ruach lefanav yitbarech, kad itkafya sitra ochora veithappech chashocha linhora – sheyyair or Adonai en-sof baruch-hu bimkom hachoshech vehassitra ochora shel kol olam hazze kullo, beyeter seet veyeter oz veyitron or min hachoshech, mehearato beolamot elyonim, shemmeir sham al yede levushim vehester panim, hammastirim umaalimim or-en-sof baruch-hu shello yibbatlu bimtziut.

Velaze natan hakkadosh-baruch-hu leyisrael et hattora, shennikret oz vechoach, uchemaamar rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha, shehakkadosh-baruch-hu noten koach batztzaddikim lekabbel secharam leatid lavo, shello yitbattelu bimtziut mammash beor Adonai hannigle leatid beli shum levush, kedichtiv: "velo yikkanef od morecha [perush, shello yitkasse mimmecha bechanaf ulevush], vehayu enecha root et morecha", uchetiv: "ki ayin beayin yiru vegomer", uchetiv: "lo yihye lach od hashshemesh leor yomam vegomer, ki Adonai yihye lach leor olam vegomer".
Venoda, sheyyemot hammashiach, uvifrat kesheyyichyu hammetim, hem tachlit ushelemut beriat olam hazze, shellechach nivra mittechillato

Haggaha
vekabbalat sachar ﬠykkaro baelef hashsheviﬠy, kemo shekkatuv belikkute tora mehaari zichrono livracha:

Vegam kevar haya leolamim meen ze, bishat mattan tora, kedichtiv: "atta hareta ladaat ki Adonai hu haelohim en od millevaddo" – "hareta" mammash, biriyya chushiyyit, kedichtiv: "vechol haam roim et hakkolot" – "roim et hannishma", ufershu rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha: mistakkelim lammizrach veshomin et haddibbur yotze anochi kulei. vechen learba ruchot ulemala ulematta, vechidfershu battikkunim "delet atar dela mallel minneh immehon kulei".

Vehayeynu, mippene gilluy retzono yitbarech baaseret haddibberot, shehen kelalut hattora, shehi penimit retzono yitbarech vechachmato, veen sham hester panim kelal, kemo shenneemar: "ki veor panecha natatta lanu torat chayyim". velachen hayu betelim bimtziut mammash, kemaamar rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha "sheal kol dibbur parcha nishmatan kulei, ella shehechezirah hakkadosh-baruch-hu lahen betal sheatid lehachayot bo et hammetim", vehu tal tora shennikra "oz", kemaamar rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha: "kol haosek battora – tal tora mechayyehu kulei".

Rak sheachar kach garam hachet venitgashshemu hem vehaolam, ad et ketz hayyamin, sheaz yizdakkech gashmiyyut hagguf vehaolam, veyuchelu lekabbel gilluy or Adonai, sheyyair leyisrael al yede hattora shennikret "oz". umiyyitron haheara leyisrael – yaggiah chshech haummot gam ken, kedichtiv: "vehalchu goyim leorech vegomer", uchetiv: "bet yaakov lechu venelcha beor Adonai", uchetiv: "venigla kevod Adonai, verau chol basar yachdav vegomer", uchetiv: "lavo benikrot hatztzurim uvisife hasselaim mippene pachad Adonai vahadar geono vegomer", uchemo sheomrim: "vehofa bahadar geon uzzecha al kol yoshve tevel artzecha vegomer":
Tanya, Part I; Likkutei Amarim 37: Vehinne, tachlit hashshelemut hazze shel yemot hammashiach utechiyyayt hammetim, shehu gilluy or-en-sof baruch-hu baolam hazze haggashmi – taluy bemaasenu vaavodatenu kol zeman meshech haggalut.

Ki haggorem sechar hammitzva – hi hammitzva beatzmah, ki baasiyyaytah, mamshich haadam gilluy or-en-sof baruch-hu milmala lematta lehitlabbesh begashmiyyut olam hazze, bedavar shehaya techilla tachat memshelet kelippat noga umekabbel chayyutah mimmenna, shehem kol devarim hattehorim umuttarim shennaaset bahem hammitzva maasiyt, kegon: kelaf hattefillin umezuza vesefer tora, uchemaamar rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha: "lo hucheshar limlechet shamayim ella tehorim umuttarim beficha". vechen etrog sheeno arla,

Haggaha
shehaﬠrela hi mishshalosh kelippot hattemeot legamre sheen lahem ﬠliyya leolam, kemo shekkatuv bﬠtz chayyim, vechen kol mitzva habbaa baﬠvera chas veshalom:
Umaot hatztzedaka sheenan gezel, vechayyotze vahem.

Veachshav shemmekayyem bahem mitzvat Adonai uretzono – hare hachayyut shebbahem ole umitbattel venichlal beor-en-sof baruch-hu, shehu retzono yitbarech hamelubbash bahem, meachar sheen sham bechinat hester panim kelal lehasetir oro yitbarech.

Vechen koach nefesh hachiyyunit habbahamit shebbeevre guf haadam hamekayyem hammitzva – hu mitlabbesh gam ken baasiyya zo, veole mehakkelippa, venichlal bikdushshat hammitzva shehi retzono yitbarech, uvatel beor-en-sof baruch-hu.

Vegam bemitzvot talmud tora ukeriat shema utefilla vechayyotze vahen, af sheenan baasiyya gashmit mammash shettachat memshelet kelippat noga, mikkol makom, ha kayyma lan dehirhur lav kedibbur dame", veeno yotze yede chovato ad sheyyotzi bisfatav, vekayyma lan daakimat sefatav have maase", ki i efshar lannefesh haelohit levatte bisfatayim ufe velashon veshinnayim haggashmiyyim, ki im, al yede nefesh hachiyyunit habbahamit hamelubbeshet beevre hagguf mammash, vechol ma shemmedabber bechoach gadol yoter – hu machnis umalbish yoter kochot minnefesh hachiyyunit bedibburim ellu.

Vezehu sheamar hakkatuv: "kol atzmotay tomarna vegomer". vezehu sheamru rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha: "im arucha bechol ramach evarim mishtammeret, veim lav – enah mishtammeret", ki hashshichcha hi mikkelippat hagguf venefesh hachiyyunit habbahamit, shehen mikkelippat noga hannichlelet lifamim bikdushsha, vehayeynu keshemmattish kochan umachnis kol kochan bikdushshat hattora o hattefilla:

Zot veod acheret, shekkoach nefesh hachiyyunit hammitlabbeshet beotiyyot haddibbur betalmud tora o tefilla vechayyotze vahen, o mitzvot maasiyyot – hare kol giddulo vechayyuto mehaddam, shehu mikkelippat noga mammash, shehen kol ochalin umashkin sheachal veshata venaasu dam, shehayu tachat memshaltah veyanku chayyutam mimmenna, veatta hi mithappechet mera letov venichlelet bikdushsha, al yede koach nefesh hachiyyunit haggadel mimmenna, shennitlabbesh beotiyyot ellu o baasiyya zo, asher hen hen penimiyyut retzono yitbarech beli shum hester panim, vechayyutan nichlal gam ken beor-en-sof baruch-hu shehu retzono yitbarech, uvechayyutan nichlal veole gam ken koach nefesh hachiyyunit.

Veal yede ze, taale gam ken kelalut kelippat noga, shehi kelalut hachayyut shel olam hazze haggashmi vehachumeri, kaasher kol hanneshama venefesh haelohit shebbechol yisrael, hammitchalleket bifratut leshishshim ribbo, tekayyem kol nefesh peratit kol taryag mitzvot hattora:

Shasa lo taase – lehaferid shasa gidim shel dam nefesh hachiyyunit shebbagguf, shello yinku vikabbelu chayyut baavera zo meachat mishshalosh kelippot hattemeot legamre, shemmehen nishpaim shasa lo taase deorayyta veanfehen shehen midderabbanan, veshuv, lo tuchal nefesh hachiyyunit laalot el Adonai im nitmea betumeat hashshalosh kelippot hattemeot, sheen lahen aliyya leolam, ki im – bittul vehaavara legamre, kemo shekkatuv: "veet ruach hattumea aavir min haaretz"; veramach mitzvot ase – lehameshich or-en-sof baruch-hu lematta, lehaalot lo ulekashsher uleyayched bo kelalut hannefesh hachiyyunit shebberamach evre hagguf, beyichud gamur lihyot laachadim mammash, kemo sheala birtzono yitbarech lihyot lo dira battachtonim, vehem lo lemerkava kemo haavot.

Umeachar shekkelalut nefesh hachiyyunit shebbichlalut yisrael tihye merkava kedosha laAdonai – azay gam kelalut hachayyut shel olam hazze, shehi kelippat noga achshav, tetze az mittumeatah vechelatah, vetaale likdushsha lihyot merkava laAdonai, behitgallut kevodo, "verau chol basar yachdav", veyofia alehem bahadar geon uzzo, "veyimmale chevod Adonai et kol haaretz", veyisrael yiru ayin beayin kivmattan tora, dichtiv: "atta hareta ladaat ki Adonai hu haelohim en od millevaddo".
Veal yede ze, yitballeu veyitbattelu legamre kol hashshalosh kelippot hattemeot, ki yenikatan vechayyutan mehakkedushsha achshav – hi al yede kelippat noga hamemutztzaat benehen.

Venimtza, ki kol tachlit shel yemot hammashiach utechiyyayt hammetim – shehu gilluy kevodo velohuto yitbarech, ulehaavir ruach hattumea min haaretz – taluy behameshachat elohuto veor-en-sof baruch-hu lannefesh hachiyyunit shebbichlalut yisrael bechol ramach evareha, al yede kiyyumah kol ramach mitzvot ase, ulehaavir ruach hattumea mimmenna, bishmiratah kol shasa mitzvot lo taase, shello yinku mimmenna shasa gideha.

Ki kelalut yisrael, shehem shishshim ribbo neshamot peratiyyot, hem kelalut hachayyut shel kelalut haolam, ki bishvilam nivra, vechol perat mehem hu kolel veshayyaych lo hachayyut shel chelek echad mishshishshim ribbo mikkelalut haolam hattaluy benafsho hachiyyunit, lehaaloto laAdonai baaliyyaytah, dehayynu, bema shemmishtammesh meolam hazze letzorech gufo venafsho hachiyyunit laavodat Adonai, kegon, achila ushetiyya vedomehem, vedira vechol kele tashmishav.

Ella sheshshishshim ribbo neshamot peratiyyot ellu hen sharashim, vechol shoresh mitchallek leshishshim ribbo nitzotzot, shekkol nitzotz hu neshama achat, vechen benefesh veruach, bechol olam mearba olamot atzilut-beria-yetzira-asiyya.

Vechol nitzotz, lo yarad laolam hazze, af shehi yerida gedola uvechinat galut mammash, ki gam sheyyihye tzaddik gamur oved Adonai beyira veahava rabba betaanugim lo yaggia lemaalot devekuto baAdonai bidchilu urechimu beterem yeridato laolam hazze hachumeri, lo minnah velo miktzatah, veen erech vedimyon benehem kelal, kannoda lechol maskil, shehagguf eno yachol lisbol kulei, ella yeridato laolam hazze lehitlabbesh bagguf venefesh hachiyyunit, hu kede letakkenam bilvad, ulehafridam mehara shel shalsh kelippot hattemeot, al yede shemirat shasa lo taase veanfehen, ulehaalot nafsho hachiyyunit im chelkah hashshayyaych lah mikkelalut olam hazze, ulekashsheram uleyaychadam beor-en-sof baruch-hu, asher yamshich bahem al yede kiyyumo kol ramach mitzvot ase benafsho hachiyyunit, shehi hi hamekayyemet kol mitzvot maasiyyot kannizkar leel.

Uchemo shekkatuv [beetz chayyim shaar 26], ki hanneshama atzmah enah tzericha tikkun kelal kulei, velo hutzercha lehitlabbesh baolam hazze vechulei, rak lehameshich or letakkenam kulei, vehu mammash dugemat sod galut hashshechina, levarer nitzotzin vechulei.

Uvaze yuvan ma shehifligu rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha bimod meod bemaalat hatztzedaka, veamru sheshshekula keneged kol hamitzvot", uvechol talmud yerushalmi hi nikret beshem "mitzva" setam, ki kach haya hergel hallashon likro tzedaka beshem "mitzva" setam, mippene shehi ikkar hammitzvot maasiyyot, veola al kullana, shekkullan hen rak lehaalot nefesh hachiyyunit laAdonai, shehi hi hamekayyemet otan, umitlabbeshet bahen likkalel beor-en-sof baruch-hu hamelubbash bahen, veen lecha mitzva shennefesh hachiyyunit mitlabbeshet bah kol kach kivmitzvat hatztzedaka, shebbechol hammitzvot en mitlabbesh bahen rak koach echad minnefesh hachiyyunit bishat maase hammitzva levad, aval bitzdaka, sheadam noten migia kappav, hare kol koach nafsho hachiyyunit melubbash baasiyyayt melachto o esek acher shennistakker bo maot ellu, ucheshennotnan litzdaka – hare kol nafsho hachiyyunit ola laAdonai.
Vegam mi sheeno nehene migio, mikkol makom, hoil uvemaot ellu haya yachol liknot chayye nafsho hachiyyunit – hare noten chayye nafsho laAdonai.

Velachen amru rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha shemmekarevet et haggeulla", lefi shebbitzdaka achat maale harebe minnefesh hachiyyunit, ma shello haya yachol lehaalot mimmenna kol kach kochot uvechinot bechamma mitzvot maasiyyot acherot.

Uma sheamru rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha shettalmud tora keneged kullam", hayeynu, mippene shettalmud tora hi bedibbur umachashava, shehem levushim happenimim shel nefesh hachiyyunit. vegam mahutan veatzmutan shel bechinot chachma-bina-daat mikkelippat noga shebbannefesh hachiyyunit – nichlalot bikdushsha mammash kesheosek battora beiyyun vesechel.

Veaf shemmahutan veatzmutan shel hammiddot – chesed gevura tiferet kulei – lo yachlu lahem habbenonim lehappecham likdushsha, hayeynu, mishshum shehara chazak yoter bammiddot mibbechachma-bina-daat, mippene yenikatan sham mehakkedushsha yoter, kayyadua leyode chen:

Zot, veod acheret, vehi haola al kullana, bemaalat esek talmud tora al kol hamitzvot, al pi ma shennizkar leel beshem hattikkunim, deramach pikkudin hen ramach evarin demalka, uchemo baadam hattachton, derech mashal, en erech vedimyon kelal ben hachayyut shebberamach evarav legabbe hachayyut shebbammochin, shehu hassechel hammitchallek leg bechinot: chachma-bina-daat – kacha mammash derech mashal, lehavedil berivvot havedalot leen ketz, behearat or-en-sof baruch-hu hammitlabbeshot bemitzvot maasiyyot, legabbe hearat or-en-sof shebbivchinat chachma-bina-daat shebbechachmat hattora, ish ish kefi sichlo vehassagato.
Veaf sheeno massig ella begashmiyyut, hare hattora nimshela lemayim, sheyyordim mimmakom gavoah kulei, kemo shennitbaer leel.

Veaf-al-pi-chen, amru rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha: "lo hammidrash ikkar ella hammaase", vehayyom laasotam" ketiv, umevattelin talmud tora lekiyyum mitzva maasiyt keshei efshar laasotah al yede acherim, mishshum, "ki ze kol haadam" vetachlit beriato viridato laolam hazze, lihyot lo yitbarech dira battachtonim davka, leahafacha chashocha linhora, "veyimmale chevod Adonai et kol haaretz" haggashmit dayyka, "verau chol basar yachdav", kannizkar leel.

Ma sheen ken kesheefshar laasotah al yede acherim – en mevattelin talmud tora, af shekkol hattora enah ella perush hammitzvot maasiyyot, vehayeynu, mishshum shehi bechinat chachma-bina-daat shel en-sof baruch-hu, uveasko bah – mamshich alav or-en-sof baruch-hu beyeter seet veheara gedola leen ketz meheara vehameshacha al yede pikkudin, shehen evarin demalka. vezehu sheamar rav sheshet: "chadai nafshai, lach karai lach tanai", kemo shennitbaer bemakom acher baarichut:

Vehinne, hameshacha veheara zo shehaadam mamshich umeir mehearat or-en-sof baruch-hu al nafsho, veal nafshot kol yisrael, hi hashshechina, keneset yisrael, mekor kol nishmot yisrael kemo sheyyitbaer lekamman, al yede esek hattora – nikret bilshon "keria" – "kore battora", perush, sheal yede esek hattora kore lehakkadosh-baruch-hu lavo elav, kivyachol, keadam hakkore lachavero sheyyavo elav, ucheven katan hakkore leaviv lavo elav lihyot immo betzavvta chada, velo lippared mimmennu velishshaer yechidi chas veshalom.

Vezehu shekkatuv: "karov Adonai lechol korav lechol asher yikrauhu veemet" – "veen emet ella tora", dehayynu, shekkore lehakkadosh-baruch-hu al yede hattora davka, leappuke – mi shekkore oto shello al yede esek hattora, ella tzoek kach: abba! abba! uchemo shekkovel alav hannavi: "veen kore veshimcha kulei", uchemo shennitbaer bemakom acher. umizze yitbonen hammaskil, lehameshich alav yira gedola bishat esek hattora, kemo shennitbaer leel [perek 23]:
Tanya, Part I; Likkutei Amarim 38: Vehinne, im kol hannichtav leel, yuvan hetev pesak hahalacha haarucha battalmud ufoskim dehirhur lav kedibbur dame", veim kara keriat shema bemachashavto uvelibbo levad, bechol koach kavvavnato – lo yatza yede chovato vetzarich lachazor velikrot, vechen bevirkat hammazon deorayyta, uvishar berachot derabbanan, uvitfilla; veim hotzi bisfatav velo kivven libbo – yatza yede chovato bediavad, veen tzarich lachazor, levad mippasuk rishon shel keriat shema uveracha rishona shel tefillat shemone esre, vechidita [beresh perek 2 divrachot]: "ad kan mitzvat kavvavna, mikkan veelach mitzvat keria vechulei".

Vehayeynu, mishshum shehanneshama enah tzericha tikkun leatzmah bammitzvot, rak, lehameshich or – letakken nefesh hachiyyunit vehagguf al yede otiyyot haddibbur shehannefesh medabberet baAdonai motzaot happe, vechen bemitzvot maasiyyot shehannefesh osa bishar evre hagguf:

Ach af-al-pi-chen, amru: tefilla o shear beracha belo chavvavna – hen keguf belo neshama, perush, ki kemo shekkol habberuim shebbaolam hazze sheyyesh lahem guf uneshama, shehem: "nefesh kol chay veruach kol besar ish", venishmat kol asher ruach chayyim beappav" mikkol baale chayyim, vaAdonai "mechayye et kullam" umehavve otam meayin leyesh tamid beor vechayyut shemmashpia bahem, sheggam hagguf hachumeri, vaafilu avanim veafar haddomem mammash – yesh bo or vechayyut mimmennu yitbarech, shello yachazor lihyot ayin vaefes keshehaya, veaf-al-pi-chen, en erech vedimyon kelal ben bechinat or vechayyut hammeir bagguf, legabbe bechinat or vechayyut hammeir banneshama, shehi nefesh kol chay.

Veaf shebbishnehem or echad shave, bivchinat hester panim ulevushim shavim shehaor mistatter umitallem umitlabbesh bo, ki shenehem hem meolam hazze, shebbichlaluto mistatter beshave haor vehachayyut shemmeruach piv yitbarach, bivchinat hester panim viridat hammadregot behishtalshelut haolamot mimmadrega lemadrega betzimtzumim rabbim vaatzumim, ad shennitlabbesh biklippat noga lehachayot kelalut olam hazze hachumeri, dehayynu, kol devarim hammuttarim vehattehorim shebbaolam hazze, umimmenna veal yadah mushepaim devarim hattemeim, ki hi bechina memutztzaat kannizkar leel.
Af-al-pi-chen, haheara, shehi hameshachat hachayyut asher Adonai meir umechayye derech levush ze, enah shava bechullan bivchinat tzimtzum vehitpashshetut.

Ki bagguf haggashmi, vehaddomem mammash kaavanim veafar – haheara hi bivchinat tzimtzum gadol asher en kamohu, vehachayyut shebbo muetet kol kach, ad sheen bo afilu koach hatztzomeach, uvatztzomeach – haheara enah betzimtzum gadol kol kach.
Vederech kelal, nechlakot learba madregot: domem, tzomeach, chay, medabber keneged 4 otiyyot shem havaya baruch-hu, shemmimmennu mushepaim.

Uchemo sheen erech vedimyon haheara vehameshachat hachayyut shebbedomem vetzomeach, lehaheara vehameshachat hachayyut hamelubbeshet bechay umedabber, af shebbechullan or echad shave bivchinat hester panim, umelubbash bilvush echad bechullan shehu levush noga, kach, en erech vedimyon kelal ben hearat vehameshachat or-en-sof baruch-hu, shehu penimiyyut retzono yitbarech beli hester panim ulevush kelal, hammeira umelubbeshet bemitzvot maasiyyot mammash, vechen bemitzvot hatteluyot bedibbur uvittuy sefatayim beli chavvavna, shehu nechshav kemaase mammash kannizkar leel – legabbe haheara vehameshachat or-en-sof baruch-hu hammeira umelubbeshet bechavvavnat hammitzvot maasiyyot, shehaadam mitkavven baasiyyaytan kede ledavka bo yitbarech al yede kiyyum retzono, shehu uretzono echad.
Vechen bechavvavnat hattefilla ukeriat shema uvirchoteha ushear berachot, shebbechavvavnato bahen – medabbek machashavto vesichlo bo yitbarech.

Velo sheddevekut hammachashava vesechel haadam bo yitbarech, hi mitztzad atzmah lemala middevekut kiyyum hammitzvot maasiyyot befoal mammash, kemo sheyyitbaer lekamman, ella, mippene shezzehu gam ken retzono yitbarech – ledavka besechel umachashava vechavvavnat hammitzvot maasiyyot uvechavvavnat keriat shema utefilla ushear berachot, vehearat ratzon haelyon hazze, hammeira umelubbeshet bechavvavna zo, hi gedola leen ketz, lemala mala mehearat ratzon haelyon hammeira umelubbeshet bekiyyum hammitzvot atzman bemaase uvedibbur beli chavvavna – kegodel maalat or hanneshama al hagguf, shehu keli umalbush hanneshama, kemo guf hammitzva atzmah shehu keli umalbush lechavvavnatah.

Veaf shebbishtehen, bammitzva uvechavvavnatah, melubbash ratzon echad, pashut betachlit happeshitut beli shum shinnuy veribbuy chas veshalom, umeyuchad bemahuto veatzmuto yitbarech betachlit hayyichud, af-al-pi-chen, haheara, enah shava bivchinat tzimtzum vehitpashshetut,

Haggaha
uchemo shekkatuv bﬠtz chayyim, shekkavvavnat hammitzvot vetalmud tora hi bemadregat or, veguf hammitzvot hen madregot uvechinot kelim, shehem bechinat tzimtzum, sheﬠl yede tzimtzum haor nitihauu hakkelim, kayyaduﬠ leyodﬠy chen:

Venechleket gam ken learba madregot. ki guf hammitzvot atzman mammash – hen 2 madregot, shehen, mitzvot maasiyyot mammash umitzvot hatteluyot bedibbur umachashava, kemo talmud tora ukeriat shema utefilla uvirkat hammazon ushear berachot; vechavvavnat hammitzvot ledavka bo yitbarech, shehi – kinshama lagguf, nechleket gam ken lishte madregot, kemo shete madregot hanneshama shehen bagguf hachumeri, shehen: chay umedabber.

Ki, mi sheddato yafa ladaat et Adonai ulehitbonen bigdullato yitbarech, uleholid mibbinato yira illaa bemocho veahavat Adonai bechalal hayemani shebbelibbo, lihyot nafsho tzemea laAdonai, ledavka vo al yede kiyyum hattora vehammitzvot, shehen hameshachat vehearat or-en-sof baruch-hu al nafsho – ledavka vo, uvechavvavna zo – hu lomed umekayyem hammitzvot, vechen bechavvavna zo – mitpallel umevarech, hare kavvavna zo, al derech mashal, kemo nishmat hamedabber, shehu baal sechel uvechira uvedaat yedabber.

Umi sheddato ketzara leda ulehitbonen bigdullat en-sof baruch-hu, leholid haahava mibbinato behitgallut libbo, vechen hayyira bemocho ufachad Adonai belibbo, rak shezzocher umeorer et haahava hattivit hamesutteret belibbo, umotziah mehahelem vehester hallev el haggilluy bammoach al kol panim, sheyyihye retzono shebbemocho vetaalumot libbo, maskim umitratztze beritztzuy gamur beemet laamitto, limsor nafsho befoal mammash al yichud Adonai, kede ledavka vo nafsho haelohit ulevusheha, ulechallan beyichudo veachduto, shehu ratzon haelyon hamelubbash betalmud tora uvekiyyum hammitzvot, kannizkar leel; vegam hayyira kelula vah, lekabbel malchuto shello limrod bo chas veshalom; uvechavvavna zo – hu sur mera veose tov, velomed umitpallel umevarech beferush hammillot levaddo, belo dechilu urechimu behitgallut libbo umocho, hare kavvavna zo, al derech mashal, kemo nishmat hachay, sheeno baal sechel uvechira, vechol middotav, shehen yirato middevarim hammazzikim oto veahavato laddevarim hanneehavim etzlo, hen rak tiviyyim etzlo velo mibbinato vedato; vechach hen, al derech mashal, hayyira vehaahava hattiviyyot hamesuttarot belev kol yisrael, ki hen yerushsha lanu meavotenu, uchemo teva benafshotenu, kannizkar leel:
Tanya, Part I; Likkutei Amarim 39: Umippene ze gam ken, nikraim hammalachim beshem chayyot uvehemot, kedichtiv: "ufene arye el hayyamin vegomer ufene shor mehassemol vegomer", lefi sheenam baale vechira, veyiratam veahavatam hi tivit lahem, kemo shekkatuv beraya mehemna" parashat pinchas. velachen maalat hatztzaddikim gedola mehem, ki, medor nishmot hatztzaddikim – hu beolam habberia, umedor hammalachim – beolam hayetzira.

Haggaha
vehayeynu bistam malachim, aval yesh malachim ﬠleyonim beolam habberia sheﬠvodatam bidchilu urechimu sichliyyim, kemo shekkatuv beraﬠya mehemna" sham, sheyyesh shene mine chayyot hakkodesh: tivﬠyim vesichliyyim, uchemo shekkatuv bﬠtz chayyim:

Vehahevdel shebbenehem hu, ki beolam hayetzira, meirot sham middotav shel en-sof baruch-hu levaddan, shehen ahavato ufachdo veyirato kulei. uchemo shekkatuv [battikkunim veetz chayyim] "deshit sefirin mekannenin bitzira".

Velachen, zot hi avodat hammalachim tamid, yomam valayla lo yishkotu, laamod beyira vafachad vechulei, vehayeynu, kol machane gavriel shemmehassemol, vaavodat machane michael hi haahava kulei. aval beolam habberia meirot sham chachmato uvinato vedato shel en-sof baruch-hu, shehen mekor hammiddot veem veshoresh lahen, vechidita battikkunim deimma illaa mekannena bitlat sefiran bechurseyya", shehu olam habberia.

Velachen hu medor nishmot hatztzaddikim, ovde Adonai bidchilu urechimu, hannimshachot min habbina vadaat digdullat en-sof baruch-hu, sheahava zo nikra "reuta delibba", kannizkar leel; umeruta delibba" naase levush lanneshama beolam habberia, shehu gan eden haelyon, kedilkamman, uchemo shekkatuv bazzohar vayyakhel.

Ach hayeynu davvka neshamot mammash, shehen bechinat mochin degadlut en-sof baruch-hu, aval bechinat haruach shel hatztzaddikim, vechen shear kol nishmot yisrael sheavdu et Adonai bidchilu urechimu hamesuttarot belev kelalut yisrael, en olot lesham, rak beshabbat verosh-chodesh levad, derech haammud shemmiggan eden hattachton legan eden haelyon, shehu olam habberia hannikra gan eden haelyon, lehitanneg al Adonai velehanot mizziv hashshechina, ki en hanaa vetaanug lesechel nivra, ella bema shemmaskil umevin veyodea umassig besichlo uvinato, ma sheefshar lo lehavin ulehassig meor-en-sof baruch-hu, al yede chachmato uvinato yitbarech, hammeirot sham beolam habberia.

Uma shezzochot neshamot ellu laalot lemala mehammalachim, af sheavdu bidchilu urechimu tiviyyim levad, hayeynu, mippene sheal yede dechilu urechimu shellahem, itkafya sitra ochora hamelubbeshet begufam, ben bivchinat "sur mera" lichbosh hattaavot uleshabberan, uven bivchinat "vaase tov" kannizkar leel, vehem hayu baale vechira livchor bera chas veshalom uvacharu betov, leachpaya lesitra ochora leistalleka yekara dekudesha berich-hu kulei, keyitron haor kulei, kannizkar leel.

Vehinne, kol ze hu bimdor hanneshamot umekom amidatan, ach toratan vaavodatan nichlalot mammash bey sefirot, shehen bechinat elohut, veor-en-sof mityayched bahen betachlit hayyichud; vehayeynu, bey sefirot divria – al yede dechilu urechimu sichliyyim, uvey sefirot ditzira – al yede dechilu urechimu tiviyyim; uvetochan, melubbashot 10 sefirot daatzilut umeyuchadot bahen betachlit, vey sefirot daatzilut – meyuchadot betachlit bemaatzilan en-sof baruch-hu.

Ma sheen ken hanneshamot, enan nichlalot belohut dey sefirot, ella omdot behechalot umedorin divria o yetzira, venehenin mizziv hashshechina, hu or-en-sof baruch-hu hameyuchad bey sefirot divria o ditzira, vehu ziv toratan vaavodatan mammash [ayyen zohar vayyakhel daf 210], ki sechar mitzva – hi mitzva atzmah:

Veolam haatzilut shehu lemala mehassechel vehahassaga vehahavana lesechel nivra, ki chachmato uvinato vedato shel en-sof baruch-hu meyuchadot sham bo betachlit hayyichud, beyichud atzum venifla, beyeter seet veyeter oz leen ketz mibbeolam habberia, ki sham yardu lehair bivchinat tzimtzum, kede sheyyuchelu sechalim nivraim lekabbel mehen chachma-bina-daat, leda et Adonai, ulehavin ulehassig ezo hassaga beor-en-sof baruch-hu, kefi koach sechalim hannivraim, shehem baale gevul vetachlit, shello yitbattelu bimtziutam, velo yihyu begeder nivraim kelal, rak yachzeru limkoram vesharsham shehu bechinat elohut mammash.
Vehinne, tzimtzum ze, hi sibbat haheara shemmeirot sham chachma-bina-daat shel en-sof baruch-hu linshamot ellu beolam habberia.
Ma sheen ken baatzilut, sheenam bivchinat tzimtzum kol kach, i efshar lischalim nivraim lekabbel mehen, velachen, "let machashavta dilhon tefisa sham kelal".

Lachen hu mador latztzaddikim haggedolim, sheavodatam hi lemala mala afilu mibbechinot dechilu urechimu hannimshachot min habbina vadaat bigdullato yitbarech, kemo sheolam haatzilut hu lemala mala mibbechinat bina vadaat lesechel nivra, ella avodatam hayta bivchinat merkava mammash leen-sof baruch-hu, velibbatel elav bimtziut, ulehikkalel beoro yitbarech, hem vechol asher lahem, al yede kiyyum hattora vehammitzvot, al derech sheamru: "haavot hen hen hammerkava", vehayeynu, lefi shekkol yemehem hayta zot avodatam.

Ach mi sheshshoresh nishmato katan mehachil avoda tamma zo, libbatel velikkalel beoro yitbarech baavodato bikviut, rak lifrakim veittim shehem et ratzon lemala, uchemo bitfillat shemone esre shehi baatzilut, uvifrat behishtachavavot shebbah, shekkol hishtachavava hi bivchinat atzilut [kemo shekkatuv bifri etz chayyim bekabbalat shabbat], ki hi inyan bittul beoro yitbarech, lihyot chashiv kammeh kela mammash, azay gam ken ikkar keviut nishmato hu beolam habberia [rak lifrakim beet ratzon taale nishmato laatzilut bivchinat "mayyin nukevin", kayyadua leyode chen]:

Vehinne, "sechar mitzva – mitzva", perush, shemmissecharah neda mahutah umadregatah, veen lanu esek bannistarot shehem tzaddikim haggedolim, shehem bivchinat merkava, rak hanniglot lanu, sheacharehem kol adam yimshoch, leda neemana mahut umadregat avodat Adonai bidchilu urechimu behitgallut libbo, hannimshachot min habbina vadaat bigdullat en-sof baruch-hu – mekomah bey sefirot divria, vaavoda bidchilu urechimu hattiviyyim shebbemocho – bey sefirot ditzira.

Aval avoda beli hitorrut dechilu urechimu afilu bemocho bivchinat gilluy, dehayynu, leorer haahava hattivit hamesutteret ballev, lehotziah mehahelem vehester hallev el haggilluy, afilu bemocho vetaalumot libbo al kol panim, rak hi nisheret mesutteret ballev ketoladtah, kemo shehayta kodem haavoda, hare avoda zo nisheret lematta beolam happerud, hannikra "chitzoniyyut haolamot", veen bah koach laalot velikkalel beyichudo yitbarech, shehen eser sefirot hakkedoshot, uchemo shekkatuv battikkunim, divla dechilu urechimu – la farcha leella", vela yachla lesalka ulemekam kodam Adonai.

Vehayeynu, afilu im eno osek shello lishmah mammash, leshum ezo peniyya chas veshalom, ella kemo shekkatuv: "vattehi yiratam oti mitzvat anashim melummada", perush, mechamat hergel shehuregal mikkatnuto, shehirgilo velimmedo aviv verabbo liro et Adonai uleavdo, veeno osek lishmah mammash, ki, lishmah mammash i efshar belo hitorrut dechilu urechimu hattiviyyim al kol panim, lehotzian mehester hallev el haggilluy bammoach vetaalumot libbo al kol panim, ki, kemo sheen adam ose davar bishvil chavero lemallot retzono, ella im ken ohavo o yare mimmennu, kach, i efshar laasot lishmo yitbarech beemet lemallot retzono levad beli zichron vehitorrut ahavato veyirato kelal bemocho umachashavto vetaalumot libbo al kol panim.
Vegam, ahava levaddah enah nikret beshem "avoda", beli yira tattaa lefachot, shehi mesutteret belev kol yisrael, kemo sheyyitbaer lekamman.

Uchesheosek shello lishmah mammash, leshum ezo peniyya lichvod atzmo, kegon, lihyot talmid chacham uchehay gavvna, azay, otah peniyya shemmitztzad hakkelippa denoga – mitlabbeshet betorato, vehattora hi bivchinat galut betoch hakkelippa lefi shaa, ad asher yaase teshuva shemmevia refua laolam, shebbeshuvo el Adonai – gam torato shava immo.

Velachen amru rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha: "leolam yaasok adam vechulei, shemmittoch shello lishmah – ba lishmah" bevadday, shebbevadday sofo laasot teshuva begilgul ze o begilgul acher, ki "lo yiddach mimmennu niddach".

Ach kesheose setam, lo lishmah velo shello lishmah – en haddavar taluy bitshuva, ella miyyad shechozer velomed davar ze lishmah, hare gam ma shellamad bistam, mitchabber umitztaref lelimmud ze ufarcha leela, meachar shello nitlabbesh bo adayin shum kelippa denoga. velachen "leolam yaasok adam kulei".
Vechen hainyan bitfilla shello vechavvavna, kemo shekkatuv bazzohar:
Tanya, Part I; Likkutei Amarim 40: Ach kol zeman shello chazar velamad davar ze lishmah, en limmudo ole afilu bey sefirot hammeirot beolam hayetzira vehaasiyya, ki hassefirot hen bechinat elohut, uvahen mitlabbesh umityayched or-en-sof baruch-hu mammash, "uvela dechilu urechimu la yachla lesalka ulemekam kodam Adonai", kemo shekkatuv battikkunim, rak limmudo ole lehechalot umedorin shehen chitzoniyyut haolamot shebbahen omdim hammalachim; uchemo shekkatav harav chayyim vital zichrono livracha beshaar hannevua perek 2, shemmehattora shello vechavvavna – nivraim malachim beolam hayetzira, umehammitzvot beli chavvavna – nivraim malachim beolam haasiyyay, vechol hammalachim, hem baale chomer vetzura.

Aval tora shello lishmah mammash, kegon lihyot talmid chacham uchehay gavvna, enah ola kelal lemala afilu lehechalot umedor hammalachim dikdushsha, ella nisheret lematta baolam hazze haggashmi shehu medor hakkelippot;

Haggaha
kemo shekkatuv bazzohar chelek 3 daf 31 ﬠmud 2 vedaf 121 ﬠmud 2, ﬠyen sham: hahi milla salka uvakﬠ rekiﬠyn kulei veitﬠr ma deitﬠr i tav tav kulei, ﬠyen sham; vedaf 105 ﬠmud 1: milla deorayyta itﬠvid minneh kala vesalik kulei; vedaf 168 ﬠmud 2: kalin deorayyta utzelota bakﬠyn rekiﬠyn kulei:

Uchemo shekkatuv bazzohar al pasuk: "ma yitron laadam bechol amalo sheyyaamol tachat hashshamesh" daafilu amala deorayyta, i avid begin yekareh kulei". vezehu sheamru: "ashre mi shebba lechan vetalmudo beyado", perush – shello nishar lematta baolam hazze.

Veaf deorayyta vekudesha-berich-hu kulla chad, shehu uretzono echad, hare kudesha-berich-hu ihu memalle kol almin beshave, veaf-al-pi-chen, en haolamot shavim bemaalatam; vehashshinnuy hu mehamekabbelim, bev bechinot: haechad, shehaelyonim mekabbelim heara yoter gedola leen ketz mehattachtonim; vehashshenit, shemmekabbelim beli levushim umasachim rabbim kol kach kevattachtonim; veolam hazze hu olam hashshafal bev bechinot: ki haheara shebbo metzumetzemet meod ad katze haacharon, velachen hu chumeri vegashmi, vegam zot, hi bilvushim umasachim rabbim, ad shennitlabbesha biklippat noga lehachayot kol devarim hattehorim shebbaolam hazze, uvichlalam – hu nefesh hachiyyunit hamedabberet shebbaadam.

Velachen, keshemmedabberet divre tora utefilla belo chavvavna, af shehen otiyyot kedoshot, veen kelippat noga shebbannefesh hachiyyunit masach mavdil kelal lehasetir ulechassot al kedushshato yitbarech hamelubbeshet bahen, kemo shehi masteret umechassa al kedushshato yitbarech shebbannefesh hachiyyunit keshemmedabberet devarim betelim, veshebbannefesh hachiyyunit shebbishar baale chayyim hattehorim, deaf delet atar panuy minneh", mikkol makom, ihu setimu dechol setimin, venikra – "el mistatter", vegam haheara vehitpashshetut hachayyut mimmennu yitbarech, mistatteret bilvushim umasachim rabbim vaatzumim, ad shennitlabbesha venistattera bilvush noga; ma sheen ken baotiyyot hakkedoshot shel divre tora utefilla, deadderabba, kelippat noga mithappechet letov venichlelet bikdushsha zo, kannizkar leel, mikkol makom, haheara shebbahen mikkedushshato yitbarech, hi bivchinat tzimtzum ad katze haacharon, meachar shehakkol vehaddibbur hu gashmi.

Aval bitfilla bechavvavna vetora bechavvavna lishmah, hare hakkavvavna mitlabbeshet beotiyyot haddibbur, hoil vehi makor veshoresh lahen, shemmechamatah uvesibbatah hu medabber otiyyot ellu, lachen hi maala otan ad mekomah bey sefirot ditzira o divria, lefi ma shehi hakkavvavna bidchilu urechimu sichliyyim o tiviyyim kulei, kannichtav leel.

Vesham meir umitgalle or-en-sof baruch-hu, shehu ratzon haelyon baruch-hu, hamelubbash beotiyyot hattora shellomed uvechavvavnatan, o bitfilla uvechavvavnatah, o bemitzva uvechavvavnatah, beheara gedola leen ketz, ma shello yachol lehair ulehitgallot kelal beod haotiyyot vehammitzva baolam hazze haggashmi, lo minnah velo miktzatah, ad et ketz hayyamin, sheyyitalle haolam miggashmiyyuto, "venigla kevod Adonai vegomer", kannichtav leel baarichut.

Haggaha
vesham meir umitgalle gam ken hayyichud haﬠleyon hannaﬠse bechol mitzva vetalmud tora, shehu yichud middotav yitbarech, shennichlalot zo bazo, venimtakot haggevurot bachasadim, ﬠl yede ﬠt ratzon haﬠleyon en-sof baruch-hu, hammeir umitgalle bivchinat gilluy rav vﬠtzum, beitﬠruta diltatta hi ﬠsiyyayt hammitzva o ﬠsek hattora, shebbahen melubbash ratzon haﬠleyon en-sof baruch-hu. ach ﬠykkar hayyichud hu lemaﬠla maﬠla beolam haatzilut, sheshsham hu mahut vﬠtzemut middotav yitbarech, meyuchadot bemaatzilan en-sof baruch-hu, vesham hu mahut vﬠtzemut ratzon haﬠleyon en-sof baruch-hu, vehearatan levad hi meira bivria yetzira ﬠsiyya, bechol olam mehen lefi maﬠlato. veaf shennefesh haadam haosek betora umitzva zo enah meatzilut, mikkol makom hare ratzon haﬠleyon hamelubbash bemitzva zo, vehu hu ﬠtzemo haddevar halacha vehattora sheosek bah, hu elohut veor-en-sof hammaatzil baruch-hu, shehu uretzono echad, uvirtzono yitbarech heetzil middotav hameyuchadot bo yitbarech, vﬠl yede gilluy retzono hammitgalle ﬠl yede ﬠsek tora umitzva zo, hen nichlalot zo bazo venimtakot haggevurot bachasadim, bﬠt ratzon zo:

Uvaze yuvan hetev, ha didchilu urechimu nikrain "gadfin" derech mashal, kedichtiv: "uvishtayim yeofef" [uchemo shekkatav harav chayyim vital zichrono livracha beshaar hayyichudim perek 11], shehakkenafayim baof hen zeroot haadam kulei; uvattikkunim pershu, shehaoskim betora umitzvot bidchilu urechimu – nikraim "banim", veim lav – nikraim "efrochim", dela yachlin lefarcha.

Haggaha
uvetikkun 45, deofa hu 58, resha dileh – 10, vegufa – vav, uteren gadfin – Adonai Adonai kulei, vehayeynu olam hayetzira shennikra 58, uvo hen gufe halachot shebbammishna, veresha dileh hen hammochin uvechinot chachma bina daﬠt, shehen penimiyyut hahalachot vesodan vetaﬠmehen, uteren gadfin dechilu urechimu hen Adonai ﬠyllaa, shehi rechimu, vaAdonai tattaa hi yira tattaa, ol malchut shamayim ufachad Adonai, kefachad hammelech derech mashal, shehi yira chitzonit veniglet; ma sheen ken yira ﬠyllaa, yere boshet, hi mehannistarot laAdonai elohenu", vehi bechachma ﬠyllaa yod shel shem havaya baruch-hu, kemo shekkatuv beraﬠya mehemna:

Ki, kemo shekkanfe haof enam ikkar haof, veen chayyuto taluy bahem kelal, keditnan: "nittelu agappeha – keshera", vehaikkar, hu rosho vechol gufo, vehakkenafayim enam rak meshammeshim lerosho vegufo lefarcha behon; vechach derech mashal, hattora umitzvot hen ikkar hayyichud haelyon, al yede gilluy ratzon haelyon hammitgalle al yedehen, vehaddechilu urechimu – hem maalim otan lemakom sheyyitgalle bo haratzon or-en-sof baruch-hu vehayyichud, shehen yetzira uveria.

Haggaha
o afilu baﬠsiyya bey sefirot dikdushsha, mekom mitzvot maﬠsiyyot, vechen mikra. aval bemishna mitgalle hayyichud veor-en-sof baruch-hu bitzira, uvetalmud bivria. dehayynu, shebbelimmud mikra mitpashshet hayyichud veor-en-sof baruch-hu meatzilut ﬠd haﬠsiyya, uvemishna ﬠd hayetzira levaddah, uvetalmud ﬠd habberia levaddah, ki kullan baatzilut. aval kabbala enah mitpashshetet kelal meatzilut livria yetzira ﬠsiyya, kemo shekkatuv bifri ﬠtz chayyim:

Vehinne, af didchilu urechimu hem gam ken mittaryag mitzvot, af al pi chen, nikrain "gadfin", lihyot, ki tachlit haahava hi haavoda meahava, veahava beli avoda, hi "ahava betaanugim", lehitanneg al Adonai meen olam habba vekabbalat sachar, vehayyom laasotam", ketiv, ulemachar lekabbel secharam".

Umi shello higgia lemidda zo, litom meen olam habba, ella adayin nafsho shokeka utzemea laAdonai vechalta elav kol hayyom, veeno meravve tzimono beme hattora shellefanav – hare ze kemi sheomed bannahar vetzoek: "mayim! mayim lishtot!", kemo shekkovel alav hannavi: "hoy kol tzame lechu lammayim". ki lefi feshuto eno muvan, demi shehu tzame umitavvev lilmod, peshita sheyyilmod meatzmo, velamma lo lannavi litzok alav "hoy"? uchemo shemmevoar bemakom acher baarichut:
Tanya, Part I; Likkutei Amarim 41: Beram, tzarich lihyot lezikkaron tamid reshit haavoda veikkarah vesharshah. vehu, ki af shehayyira hi shoresh lesur mera" vehaahava levaase tov", af-al-pi-chen, lo day leorer haahava levaddah levaase tov", ulefachot tzarich leorer techilla hayyira hattivit hamesutteret belev kol yisrael, shello limrod bemelech malche hammelachim hakkadosh-baruch-hu, kannizkar leel, shettehe behitgallut libbo o mocho al kol panim.

Dehayynu, lehitbonen bemachashavto al kol panim gedullat en-sof baruch-hu, umalchuto asher hi "malchut kol olamim" – elyonim vetachtonim, veihu "memalle kol almin" vesovev kol almin", uchemo shekkatuv: "halo et hashshamayim veet haaretz ani male", umanniach haelyonim vetachtonim, umeyayched malchuto al ammo yisrael bichlal, vealav bifrat, ki chayyayv adam lomar: "bishvili nivra haolam", vehu gam hu mekabbel alav malchuto, lihyot melech alav, uleavdo velaasot retzono bechol mine avodat aved.
Vehinne Adonai nitztzav alav, umelo chol haaretz kevodo", umabbit alav, uvochen kelayot valev im ovdo karauy. veal ken tzarich laavod lefanav beema uveyira, keomed lifne hammelech.
Veyaamik bemachashava zo veyaarich bah kefi yecholet hassagat mocho umachashavto, uchefi happenay shello, lifne esek hattora, o hammitzva, kemo lifne levishat tallit utefillin.

Vegam yitbonen, ech sheor-en-sof baruch-hu, hassovev kol almin" umemalle kol almin", hu ratzon haelyon, hu melubbash beotiyyot vechachmat hattora, o betzitzit utefillin ellu, uvikriato o bilvishato hu mamshich oro yitbarech alav, dehayynu al "chelek eloah mimmaal" shebbetoch gufo, likkalel velibbatel beoro yitbarech.

Vederech perat bitfillin, libbatel velikkalel bechinat chachmato uvinato shebbenafsho haelohit, bivchinat chachmato uvinato shel en-sof baruch-hu, hamelubbashot derech perat befarashiyyot: "kaddesh", "vehaya ki yeviacha", dehayynu, shello lehishtammesh bechachmato uvinato shebbenafsho, bilti laAdonai levaddo, vechen libbatel velikkalel bechinat haddaat shebbenafsho, hakkolel chesed ugevura, shehen yira veahava shebbelibbo, bivchinat daat haelyon hakkolel chesed ugevura, hamelubbash befarashiyyot: "shema", "vehaya im shamoa", vehayeynu kemo shekkatuv beshulchan aruch: "leshabed hallev vehammoach kulei";

Uvaatifat tzitzit, yechavven kemo shekkatuv bazzohar: lehameshich alav malchuto yitbarech, asher hi "malchut kol olamim" vechulei, leyaychadah alenu al yede mitzva zo, vehu keinyan "som tasim alecha melech".

Vaazay, af im bechol zot lo tippol alav ema vafachad behitgallut libbo, mikkol makom, meachar shemmekabbel alav malchut shamayim, umamshich alav yirato yitbarech behitgallut machashavto uretzono shebbemocho, vekabbala zo hi amittit beli shum safek, shehare hi teva nafshot kol yisrael shello limrod bammelech hakkadosh yitbarech – hare hattora shellomed o hammitzva sheose mechamat kabbala zo umechamat hameshachat hayyira shebbemocho, nikraot beshem "avoda shelema", kechol avodat haeved laadvno umalko.

Ma sheen ken im lomed umekayyem hammitzva beahava levaddah, kede ledavka vo al yede torato umitzvotav – enah nikret beshem avodat haeved, vehattora amra: "vaavadtem et Adonai elohechem vegomer", "veoto taavodu vegomer"; uchemo shekkatuv bazzohar [parashat behar]: "kehay tora deyahavin aleh ol bekadmeta begin leappaka minneh tav lealma kulei, hache name itzterich levar nash lekabbala aleh ol malchut shamayim bekadmeta kulei, vei hay la ishtechach gabbeh – la sharya beh kedushsha kulei"; [uveraya mehemna sham daf 111 ammud 2] shekkol adam tzarich lihyot bishte bechinot umadregot, vehen: bechinat "eved" uvechinat "ben".
Veaf deyesh "ben" shehu gam ken "eved", hare i efshar lavo lemadrega zo, beli kedimat hayyira illaa, kayyadua layyodim:

Vehinne, af mi sheggam bemocho uvemachashavto eno margish shum yira uvusha, mippene pechitut erech nafsho mimmekor chutzebah, mimmadregot tachtonot dey sefirot daasiyya, af-al-pi-chen, meachar shemmitkavven baavodato kede laavod et hammelech, hare zo avoda gemura, ki hayyira vehaavoda nechshavot lishte mitzvot beminyan taryag, veenan meakkevot zo et zo.

Veod, shebbeemet mekayyem gam mitzvat yira bema shemmamshich hayyira bemachashavto, ki beshaa verega zo al kol panim, mora shamayim alav al kol panim, kemora basar vadam hedyot lefachot, sheeno melech, hammabbit alav, shennimna baavuro millaasot davar sheeno hagun beenav, shezzo nikret yira, kemo sheamar rabban yochanan ben zakkay letalmidav: "yehi ratzon sheyyehe mora shamayim alechem kemora basar vadam kulei, tedu kesheadam over avera omer shello yirani adam kulei".

Rak sheyyira zo nikret "yira tattaa" veyirat chet" shekkodemet lechachmato, veyira illaa" hu "yere boshet" kulei, deit yira veit yira kulei", aval beli yira kelal, la farcha leella beahava levaddah, kemo shehaof eno yachol lifroach bechanaf echad, didchilu urechimu hen teren gadfin [kemo shekkatuv battikkunim].

Vechen hayyira levaddah – hi kanaf echad, vela farcha bah leella, af shennikret "avodat eved". vetzarich lihyot gam ken bechinat "ben", leorer haahava hattivit al kol panim, hamesutteret belibbo, shettehe behitgallut mocho al kol panim, lizkor ahavato laAdonai echad bemachashavto uvirtzono, ledavka bo yitbarech.
Vezot tihye kavvavnato beesek hattora o hammitzva hazzo, ledavka vo nafsho haelohit vehachiyyunit ulevushehen, kannizkar leel.

Ach amnam, amru rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha: "leolam al yotzi adam atzmo min hakkelal", lachen yitkavven leyached uledavka bo yitbarech, mekor nafsho haelohit umekor nafshot kol yisrael, shehu ruach piv yitbarech, hannikra beshem "shechina", al shem sheshshochenet umitlabbeshet toch kol almin lehachayotan ulekayyeyman, vehi hi – hammashpaat bo koach haddibbur hazze shemmedabber bedivre tora, o koach hammaase hazze laasot mitzva zo.
Veyichud ze, hu al yede hameshachat or-en-sof baruch-hu lematta, al yede esek hattora vehammitzvot shehu melubbash bahen.

Veyitkavven lehameshich oro yitbarech al mekor nafsho venafshot kol yisrael leyaychadan, uchemo sheyyitbaer lekamman perush yichud ze baarichut, ayyen sham. vezehu perush "leshem yichud kudesha-berich-hu ushechinteh beshem kol yisrael".

Haggaha
vegam ﬠl yede ze yitmatteku gam ken haggevurot bachasadim mimmela, behitkallut hammiddot veyichudam, ﬠl yede gilluy ratzon haﬠleyon baruch-hu, hammitgalle lemaﬠla beitﬠruta diltatta, hu gilluyo lematta bﬠsek hattora vehammitzva shehen retzono yitbarech; uchemo shekkatuv beidra rabba uvemishnat chasidim massechet arich anpin perek 4, shettaryag mitzvot hattora nimshachot mechivvavrta daarich anpin", shehu ratzon haﬠleyon, mekor hachasadim:

Veaf shellihyot kavvavna zo amittit belibbo, sheyyihye libbo chafetz beemet yichud haelyon hazze, tzarich lihyot belibbo ahava rabba laAdonai levaddo, laasot nachat ruach lefanav levad, velo lerauot nafsho hatztzemea laAdonai, ella kivra deishtaddel batar avoy veimmeh, derachim lon yattir miggarmeh venafsheh kulei [kemo shennitbaer leel beshem raya mehemna], mikkol makom, yesh lechol adam leharegil atzmo bechavvavna zo.

Ki af sheenah beemet laamitto legamre belibbo sheyyachpotz baze bechol libbo, mikkol makom, meat mizzeer chafetz libbo baze beemet, mippene ahava hattivit shebbelev kol yisrael laasot kol ma shehu ratzon haelyon baruch-hu, veyichud ze hu retzono haamitti. vehayeynu yichud haelyon shebbaatzilut, hannaase beitaruta diltatta, al yede yichud nefesh haelohit vehitkallutah beor Adonai hamelubbash battora umitzvot sheoseket bahen, vehayu laachadim mammash, kemo shennitbaer leel, ki al yede ze mityachadim gam ken mekor hattora vehammitzvot, shehu hakkadosh-baruch-hu, im mekor nafsho haelohit, hannikra beshem "shechina", shehen bechinat "memalle kol almin" uvechinat "sovev kol almin", kemo shennitbaer bemakom acher baarichut.

Aval yichud nafsho vehitkallutah beor Adonai – lihyot laachadim, baze chafetz kol adam miyyisrael beemet laamitto legamre bechol lev uvechol nefesh, meahava hattivit hamesutteret belev kol yisrael ledavka baAdonai, velo lippared velihyot nichrat venivdal chas veshalom miyyichudo veachduto yitbarech beshum ofen, afilu bimsirat nefesh mammash.

Veesek hattora umitzvot vehattefilla, hu gam ken inyan mesirat nefesh mammash, kemo betzetah min hagguf bimlot shivim shana, sheenah mehareheret betzarche hagguf, ella, machashavtah meyuchedet umelubbeshet beotiyyot hattora vehattefilla, shehen devar Adonai umachashavto yitbarech, vehayu laachadim mammash, shezzehu kol esek hanneshamot began eden, kidita baggemara uvazzohar, ella sheshsham mitannegim behassagatam vehitkallutam beor Adonai.

Vezehu shettikkenu bitchillat birchot hashshachar kodem hattefilla: "elohay, neshama vechulei veatta nefachtah kulei veatta atid littelah mimmenni kulei", kelomar, meachar sheatta nefachtah bi veatta atid littelah mimmenni", lachen, meatta ani mosrah umachazirah lecha leyaychadah beachdutecha, uchemo shekkatuv: "elecha, Adonai, nafshi essa", vehayeynu, al yede hitkashsherut machashavti bemachashavtecha vedibburi bedibburecha – beotiyyot hattora vehattefilla, uvifrat baamira laAdonai lenocheach, kemo "baruch atta", uchehay gavvna.

Vehinne, bahachana zo shel mesirat nafsho laAdonai, yatchil birchot hashshachar, "baruch atta kulei", vechen bahachana zo yatchil lilmod shiur kavua miyyad achar hattefilla, vechen beemtza hayyom, kodem sheyyatchil lilmod, tzericha hachana zo lefachot, kannoda, sheikkar hahachana lishmah leakkev – hu bitchillat hallimmud babbenonim, uchemo beget vesefer tora, shetztzerichim lishmah leakkev, vedayyo sheyyomar bitchillat hakketiva: "hareni kotev leshem kedushshat sefer tora", o "lishmo velishmah" kulei.

Ucheshellomed shaot harebe retzufot, yesh lo lehitbonen bahachana zo hannizkeret leel, bechol shaa veshaa al kol panim, ki, bechol shaa veshaa hi hameshacha acheret meolamot elyonim lehachayot hattachtonim, vehameshachat hachayyut shebbeshaa shellefaneha – chozeret limkorah [besod "ratzo vashov" shebbesefer yetzira] im kol hattora umaasim tovim shel hattachtonim, ki bechol shaa sholet tzeruf echad miv tzerufe shem havaya baruch-hu beyv sheot hayyom, vetzerufe shem adnay ballayla, kannoda.

Vehinne, kol kavvavnato bimsirat nafsho laAdonai al yede hattora vehattefilla, lehaalot nitzotz elohut shebbetochah limkoro, tehe rak kede laasot nachat ruach lefanav yitbarech, kimshal simchat hammelech bevo elav beno yechido, betzeto min hashshivya uvet haasurim, kannizkar leel.

Vehinne, kavvavna zo hi amittit beemet laamitto legamre, bechol nefesh miyyisrael, bechol et uvechol shaa, meahava hattivit shehi yerushsha lanu meavotenu. rak shetztzarich likboa ittim lehitbonen bigdullat Adonai, lehassig dechilu urechimu sichliyyim, vechulle hay veulay vechulei, kannizkar leel:
Tanya, Part I; Likkutei Amarim 42: Vehinne, bema shennitbaer leel beinyan yira tattaa, yuvan hetev ma shekkatuv baggemara al pasuk "veatta yisrael ma Adonai elohecha shoel meimmach ki im leyira et Adonai elohecha": "atu yira milleta zutarti hi"? in, legabbe moshe milleta zutarti hi vechulei.

Delichora eno muvan hatterutz, deha "shoel meimmach" ketiv. ella hainyan hu, ki kol nefesh venefesh mibbet yisrael yesh bah mibbechinat moshe rabbenu alav hashshalom, ki hu mishshiva roim hammamshichim chayyut velohut lichlalut nishmot yisrael, shellachen, nikraim beshem "roim", umoshe rabbenu alav hashshalom – hu kelalut kullam, venikra "raya mehemna", dehayynu, shemmamshich bechinat haddaat lichlalut yisrael, leda et Adonai, kol echad kefi hassagat nishmato vesharshah lemala, vinikatah mishshoresh nishmat moshe rabbenu alav hashshalom, hammushereshet bedaat haelyon shebbey sefirot daatzilut, hameyuchadot bemaatzilan baruch-hu, shehu vedato echad vehu hammadda kulei".

Veod zot yeter al ken, bechol dor vador yordin nitzotzin minnishmat moshe rabbenu alav hashshalom umitlabbeshin beguf venefesh shel chachme haddor "ene haeda", lelammed daat et haam, veleda gedullat Adonai, uleavdo belev vanefesh, ki haavoda shebballev – hi lefi haddaat, kemo shekkatuv: "da et elohe avicha veavdehu belev shalem venefesh chafetza", veleatid hu omer: "velo yelammedu ish et reehu lemor deu et Adonai, ki chullam yedu oti vegomer".

Ach ikkar haddaat, enah hayedia levaddah, sheyyedu gedullat Adonai mippi sofrim umippi sefarim, ella haikkar hu, lehaamik dato bigdullat Adonai, velitkoa machashavto baAdonai bechozek veometz hallev vehammoach, ad shettehe machashavto mekushsheret baAdonai bekesher ammitz vechazak, kemo shehi mekushsheret bedavar gashmi sheroe beene vasar umaamik bo machashavto, kannoda, sheddaat hu leshon hitkashsherut, kemo: "vehaadam yada vegomer".

Vechoach ze umidda zo lekashsher dato baAdonai, yesh bechol nefesh mibbet yisrael, binikatah minnishmat moshe rabbenu alav hashshalvm. rak meachar shennitlabbesha hannefesh bagguf, tzericha ligia rabba vaatzuma kefula umechuppelet. haachat – hi yegiat basar, levattesh et hagguf ulehachnio shello yachshich al or hannefesh, kemo shennitbaer leel beshem hazzohar, degufa dela salik beh nehora denishmeta mevatteshin leh", vehayeynu, al yede hirhure teshuva meomek hallev, kemo shennitbaer sham.

Vehashshenit – hi yegiat hannefesh, shello tichbad aleha haavoda leyaggea machashavtah lehaamik ulehitbonen bigdullat Adonai shaa gedola retzufa. ki shiur shaa zo – eno shave bechol nefesh, yesh nefesh zakka betivah, shemmiyyad shemmitbonenet bigdullat Adonai – yaggia eleha hayyira ufachad Adonai, kemo shekkatuv beshulchan aruch orach chayyim siman 1: "kesheyyitbonen haadam shehammelech haggadol melech malche hammelachim hakkadosh-baruch-hu, asher "melo chol haaretz kevodo", omed alav veroe bemaasav – miyyad yaggia elav hayyira vechulei".

Veyesh nefesh shefala betivah vetoladtah, mimmekor chutzebah mimmadregot tachtonot dey sefirot daasiyya, velo tuchal limtzo bemachashavtah haelohut, ki im bekoshi uvechazka, uvifrat im huttammea bechattat neurim, shehaavonot mavdilim kulei [kemo shekkatuv besefer chasidim siman 35].

Umikkol makom, bekoshi uvechazka – shettitchazzek meod machashavto beometz vigia rabba veomek gadol, lehaamik bigdullat Adonai shaa gedola – bevadday taggia elav al kol panim hayyira tattaa hannizkeret leel, uchemo sheamru rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha: "yagati umatzati – taamin", uchedichtiv: "im tevakshenna chakkasef vechammatmonim tachpesenna – az tavin yirat Adonai", perush, kederech shemmechappes adam matmon veotzar hattamun betachtiyyot haaretz, shechofer acharav bigia atzuma, kach, tzarich lachpor bigia atzuma legallot otzar shel yirat shamayim, hatztzafun umusetar bevinat hallev shel kol adam miyyisrael, shehi bechina umadrega shellemala mehazzeman, vehi hayyira hattivit hamesutteret hannizkeret leel.

Rak, shekkede shettavo lide maase bivchinat yirat chet, lihyot "sur mera" bemaase dibbur umachashava, tzarich legallotah mimmatzpune binat hallev shellemala mehazzeman, lahaviah livchinat machashava mammash shebbammoach, lehaamik bah machashavto meshech zeman ma mammash, ad shettetze peullatah mehakkoach el happoal mammash, dehayynu, lihyot "sur mera vaase tov" bemachashava dibbur umaase, mippene Adonai hatztzofe umabbit umaazin umakshiv umevin el kol maasehu, uvochen kilyotav velibbo, uchemaamar rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha: "histakkel bishlosha devarim kulei, ayin roa veozen shomaat kulei".

Vegam ki en lo demut hagguf, hare adderabba – hakkol galuy veyadua lefanav, beyeter seet leen ketz meriyyayt haayin ushemiat haozen al derech mashal, rak hu al derech mashal, kemo adam hayyodea umargish beatzmo kol ma shennaase venifal beechad mikkol ramach evarav, kemo kor o chom, vaafilu chom shebbetzipparne raglav al derech mashal – im nichva baur, vechen mahutam veatzmutam vechol ma shemmitpael bahem, yodea umargish bemocho.

Ucheen yedia zo al derech mashal, yodea hakkadosh-baruch-hu kol hannifal bechol hannivraim, elyonim vetachtonim, lihyot kullam mushepaim mimmennu yitbarech, kemo shekkatuv: "ki mimmecha hakkol", vezehu sheomrim: "vegam kol hayetzur lo nichchad mimmekka", uchemo shekkatav harambam, [vehiskimu laze chachme hakkabbala, kemo shekkatav haramak bappardes] shebbidiat atzmo kivyachol, yodea kol hannivraim hannimtzaim meamittat himmatzo vechulei.

Rak shemmashal ze, eno ella leshakkech et haozen, aval beemet, en hammashal dome lannimshal kelal, ki nefesh haadam, afilu hassichlit vehaelohit, hi mitpaelet mimmeore hagguf vetzaaro, mechamat hitlabbeshutah mammash bannefesh hachiyyunit hamelubbeshet bagguf mammash.

Aval hakkadosh-baruch-hu, eno mitpael chas veshalom mimmeore haolam veshinnuyav, velo mehaolam atzmo, shekkullam, enan poalim bo shum shinnuy chas veshalom. vehinne, kede lehasekil ze hetev besichlenu, kevar heerichu chachme haemet besifrehem, ach kol yisrael maaminim bene maaminim beli shum chakirat sechel enoshi, veomrim: "atta hu ad shello nivra haolam vechulei", kannizkar leel perek 20:

Vehinne, kol adam miyyisrael, yihye mi sheyyihye, kesheyyitbonen baze shaa gedola bechol yom, ech shehakkadosh-baruch-hu male mammash et haelyonim veet hattachtonim, veet hashshamayim veet haaretz mammash, "melo chol haaretz kevodo" mammash, vetzofe umabbit uvochen kilyotav velibbo vechol maasav vedibburav, vechol tzeadav yispor, azay, tikkava belibbo hayyira lechol hayyom kullo, kesheyyachazor veyitbonen baze afilu behitbonnut kalla, bechol et uvechol shaa – yihye "sur mera vaase tov" bemachashava dibbur umaase, shello lamrot chas veshalom ene chevodo, asher male chol haaretz, uchemaamar rabban yochanan ben zakkay letalmidav kannizkar leel.

Vezehu sheamar hakkatuv: "ki im leyira et Adonai elohecha lalechet bechol derachav", shehi yira hammevia lekiyyum mitzvotav yitbarech besur mera vaase tov", vehi yira tattaa hannizkeret leel, ulegabbe moshe, dehayynu, legabbe bechinat haddaat shebbechol nefesh miyyisrael – haelohit, milleta zutarti hi, kannizkar leel. [shehaddaat hu hamekashsher matzpune binat hallev el bechinat gilluy bemachashava mammash, kayyadua leyode chen.]

Veod zot yizkor, ki, kemo shebbemelech basar vadam ikkar hayyira hi mippenimiyyuto vechayyuto velo miggufo, shehare kesheyyashen – en shum yira mimmennu, vehinne, penimiyyuto vechayyuto, en nire leene vasar, rak beene hassechel – al yede reiyyayt ene vasar begufo ulevushav, sheyyodea shechayyuto melubbash betocham, veim ken, kacha mammash yesh lo liro et Adonai, al yede reiyyayt ene vasar bashshamayim vaaretz vechol tzevaam, asher or-en-sof baruch-hu melubbash bahem lehachayotam.

Haggaha
vegam nire biriyyayt haﬠyin, shehem betelim leoro yitbarech behishtachavavatam kol yom kelappe maﬠrav bishkiﬠtam, – kemaamar rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha ﬠl pasuk: "utzeva hashshamayim lecha mishtachavim" – shehashshechina bammaﬠrav, venimtza – hillucham kol hayyom kelappe maﬠrav hu derech hishtachavava uvittul. vehinne, gam mi shello raa et hammelech meolam, veeno makkiro kelal, afﬠl-pi-chen keshshenichnas lachatzar hammelech veroe sarim rabbim venichbadim mishtachavim leish echad – tippol ﬠlav ema vafachad:
Veaf shehu al yede hitlabbeshut bilvushim rabbim, hare en hevdel vehefresh kelal beyirat melech basar vadam, ben shehu arom, uven shehu lavush levush echad, uven shehu lavush bilvushim rabbim.

Ella haikkar hu hahergel, leharegil dato umachashavto tamid, lihyot kavua belibbo umocho tamid, asher kol ma sheroe beenav, hashshamayim vehaaretz umeloah, hakkol hem levushim hachitzonim shel hammelech hakkadosh-baruch-hu, veal yede ze – yizkor tamid al penimiyyutam vechayyutam. veze nichlal gam ken bilshon "emuna", shehu leshon regilut, shemmargil haadam et atzmo, kemo uman hameammen yadav vechulei.

Vegam lihyot lezikkaron tamid – leshon chachamenu-zichronam-livracha, "kabbalat ol malchut shamayim", shehu keinyan "som tasim alecha melech", kemo shennitbaer bemakom acher vechulei, ki hakkadosh-baruch-hu manniach et haelyonim vehattachtonim, umeyayched malchuto alenu vechulei, vaanachnu mekabbelim vechulei, vezehu inyan hahishtachavavot shebbitfillat 18, achar kabbalat ol malchut shamayim bedibbur bikriat shema, lachazor ulekabbel befoal mammash, bemaase vechulei, kemo shennitbaer bemakom acher:
Tanya, Part I; Likkutei Amarim 43: Vehinne al yira tattaa zo, shehi lekiyyum mitzvotav yitbarech bivchinat "sur mera vaase tov", amru: "im en yira en chachma".

Veyesh bah bechinat katnut uvechinat gadlut. dehayynu, keshennimshechet bechinat yira zo mehahitbonnut bigdullat Adonai, deihu memalle kol almin, umehaaretz larakia mahalach tk shana vechulei, uven rakia lerakia kulei, ragle hachayyot keneged kullan vechulei", vechen hishtalshelut kol haolamot lemala mala ad rum hammaalot – af-al-pi-chen, nikre yira zo yira chitzonit vetattaa, meachar shennimshechet mehaolamot, shehem levushim shel hammelech hakkadosh-baruch-hu, asher mistatter umitallem umitlabbesh bahem lehachayotam ulekayyeymam lihyot yesh meayin vechulei, rak shehi hashshaar vehappetach lekiyyum hattora vehammitzvot.

Ach hayyira illaa, yere boshet veyira fenimit, shehi nimshechet mippenimit haelohut shebbetoch haolamot, aleha amru: "im en chachma en yira", dechachma, hi koach ma – "vehachachma meayin timmatze", veezehu chacham haroe et hannolad", perush, sheroe kol davar ech nolad venithavve meayin leyesh, bidvar Adonai veruach piv yitbarech, kemo shekkatuv: "uveruach piv kol tzevaam".

Vee lazot, hare hashshamayim vehaaretz vechol tzevaam, betelim bimtziut mammash bidvar Adonai veruach piv, uchela mammash chashive veayin vaefes mammash, kevittul or veziv hashshemesh – beguf hashshemesh atzmah, veal yotzi adam atzmo mehakkelal, sheggam gufo venafsho verucho venishmato betelim bimtziut bidvar Adonai, vedibburo yitbarech meyuchad bemachashavto kulei, vechannizkar leel [perakim 20 27] baarichut bederech mashal minnefesh haadam, sheddibbur echad middibburo umachashavto – kela mammash kulei. vezehu sheamar hakkatuv: "hen yirat Adonai hi chachma".
Ach i efshar lehassig leyira vechachma zo, ella bekiyyum hattora vehammitzvot, al-yede yira tattaa hachitzonit, vezehu sheamru "im en yira en chachma".

Vehinne, beahava yesh gam ken shete madregot: "ahava rabba" veahavat olam", "ahava rabba" – hi "ahava betaanugim", vehi shalhevet haola meeleha, uvaa milmala bivchinat mattana lemi shehu shalem beyira, kannoda al maamar rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha: "darko shel ish lechazzer achar ishsha", sheahava nikret "ish" vezachar", kemo shekkatuv: "zachar chasdo", veishsha – yirat Adonai", kannoda; uveli kedimat hayyira, i efshar lehaggia leahava rabba zo, ki ahava zo hi mibbechinat atzilut, delet tamman kitztzutz uferud chas veshalom.

Ach "ahavat olam" hi habbaa mehattevuna vadaat bigdullat Adonai en-sof baruch-hu, hamemalle kol almin vesovev kol almin, vechulla kammeh kela mammash chashiv, uchevittul dibbur echad bannefesh hammaskelet beodo bemachashavtah o bechemdat hallev kannizkar leel, asher al yede hitbonnut zo, mimmela titpashshet middat haahava shebbannefesh millevusheha, dehayynu, shello titlabbesh beshum devar hanaa vetaanug gashmi o ruchani leahava oto, velo lachpotz kelal shum davar baolam, bilti Adonai levaddo – mekor hachayyim shel kol hattaanugim, shekkullam betelim bimtziut uchela mammash kammeh chashive, veen aroch vedimyon kelal benehem chas veshalom, kemo sheen aroch leayin vaefes hammuchelat legabbe chayyim nitzchiyyim, uchemo shekkatuv: "mi li vashshamayim, veimmecha lo chafatzti vaaretz, kala sheeri ulevavi, tzur levavi vegomer", uchemo sheyyitbaer lekamman.

Vegam mi sheen middat ahava shebbenafsho melubbeshet kelal beshum taanug gashmi o ruchani – yachol lehalehiv nafsho kerishpe esh veshalhevet azza velahav haole hashshamayma, al yede hitbonnut hannizkeret leel, kemo sheyyitbaer lekamman.

Vehinne, bechinat ahava zo, peamim shekkodemet leyira, kefi bechinat haddaat hammolidah, kannoda [shehaddaat kolel chasadim ugevurot, shehem ahava veyira, ufeamim shehachasadim kodmim lered ulehitgallot], velachen efshar lerasha uvaal averot sheyyaase teshuva meahava hannolda belibbo, bezachro et Adonai elohav.

Umikkol makom, hayyira gam ken kelula bah mimmela, rak shehi bivchinat katnut vehelem, dehaynu, yirat chet, limrod bo chas veshalom, vehaahava – hi behitgallut libbo umocho. ach zehu derech mikre vehoraat shaa, behashegacha feratit meet Adonai, letzorech shaa, kemaase derabbi elazar ben duredayyay.

Aval seder haavoda hakkevua uteluya bivchirat haadam – tzarich lehakedim techilla kiyyum hattora vehammitzvot al yede yira tattaa bivchinat katnut al kol panim, besur mera vaase tov", lehair nafsho haelohit beor hattora umitzvoteha, veachar kach, yair aleha or haahava [ki "veahavta" begimatriyya 2 peamim "or", kayyadua leyode chen]:
Tanya, Part I; Likkutei Amarim 44: Vehinne, kol madregat ahava mibb madregot ellu: "ahava rabba" veahavat olam" – nechleket lechamma bechinot umadregot leen ketz, kol chad lefum shiura dileh, kemo shekkatuv bazzohar hakkadosh al pasuk: "noda bashshearim balah" – "da kudesha-berich-hu, deihu ityeda veitdabbek lechol chad lefum ma dimshaer belibbeh vechulei".

Velachen nikraim dechilu urechimu – "hannistarot laAdonai elohenu", vetora umitzvot – hen "hanniglot lanu ulevanenu laasot kulei". ki tora achat umishpat echad lechullanu, bekiyyum kol hattora umitzvot bivchinat maase, ma-sheen-ken bidchilu urechimu shehem lefi haddaat et Adonai shebbemoach valev, kannizkar leel.
Ach achat hi ahava hakkelula mikkol bechinot umadregot "ahava rabba" veahavat olam", vehi shava lechol nefesh miyyisrael, virushsha lanu meavotenu.

Vehayeynu, ma shekkatav hazzohar al pasuk: "nafshi ivviticha ballayla vegomer" – "deyarchim lekudesha-berich-hu rechimuta denafsha verucha kema deitdabbeku illen begufa vegufa rachim lon vechulei". vezehu shekkatuv: "nafshi ivviticha", kelomar, mippene sheatta Adonai "nafshi" vechayyay haamittim, lechach – "ivviticha", perush, sheani mitavve vetaev lecha keadam hammitavve lechayye nafsho, ucheshehu challash umeunne – mitavve vetaev shettashuv nafsho elav, vechen keshehu holech lishon – mitavve vechafetz shettashuv nafsho elav kesheyyeor mishshenato, kach, ani mitavve vetaev leor en-sof baruch-hu, chayye hachayyim haamittiyyim, lehameshicho bekirbi al yede esek hattora bahakitzi mishshenati ballayla, deorayyta vekudesha-berich-hu kulla chad.
Kemo shekkatav hazzohar sham: "devae bar nash merchimuta dekudesha-berich-hu lemekam bechol lela, leishtaddela befulechaneh ad tzafra kulei".

Veahava rabba ugedola mizzo, vehi mesutteret gam ken bechol nefesh miyyisrael birushsha meavotenu, hi, ma shekkatuv beraya mehemna: "kivra deishtaddel batar avoy veimmeh, derachim lon yattir miggarmeh venafsheh verucheh kulei", ki halo av echad lechullanu.

Veaf ki mi hu ze veezehu asher arav libbo lageshet lehassig afilu chelek echad minni elef mimmadregat ahavat "raya mehemna"? mikkol makom, hare efes katzehu veshemetz menhu merav tuvo veoro – meir lichlalut yisrael bechol dor vador, kemo shekkatuv battikkunim, deitpashshetuteh bechol dara vedara leanhara lon vechulei".

Rak sheheara zo hi bivchinat hester vehelem gadol benafshot kol bet yisrael, ulehotzi ahava zo hamesutteret mehahelem vehahester el haggilluy, lihyot behitgallut libbo umocho – "lo niflet velo rechoka hi", ella "karov haddavar meod beficha uvilvavcha", dehayynu, lihyot ragil al leshono vekolo – leorer kavvavnat libbo umocho, lehaamik machashavto bechayye hachayyim en-sof baruch-hu, ki hu avinu mammash haamitti umekor chayyenu, uleorer elav haahava keahavat habben el haav. uchesheyyargil atzmo ken tamid hare hahergel naase teva.

Veaf im nidme lo lichora, shehu koach dimyoni – lo yachush, meachar shehu emet laamitto mitztzad atzmo bivchinat "ahava mesutteret". rak shettoelet yetziatah el haggilluy kede lahaviah lide maase, shehu esek hattora vehammitzvot shellomed umekayyem al yede ze, kede laasot nachat ruach lefanav yitbarech keven haoved et aviv.

Veal ze amru: "machashava tova hakkadosh-baruch-hu metzarfah lemaase", lihyot gadfin lefarcha, kannizkar leel. vehannachat ruach hu, kimshal simchat hammelech mibbeno shebba elav betzeto mibbet haasurim kannizkar leel, o "lihyot lo dira battachtonim", kannizkar leel.
Vehinne, gam livchinat "nafshi ivviticha" hannizkar leel, karov haddavar meod lehotziah mehahelem el haggilluy, al yede hahergel tamid befiv velibbo shavin.

Ach im eno yachol lehotziah el haggilluy belibbo, af-al-pi-chen, yachol laasok battora umitzvot lishman, al yede tziyyur inyan ahava zo bammachashava shebbemocho, umachashava tova – hakkadosh-baruch-hu metzarfah kulei":

Vehinne, b bechinot ahavot ellu, af shehen yerushsha lanu meavotenu uchemo teva benafshotenu, vechen hayyira hakkelula bahen, shehi, liro millippared chas veshalom mimmekor chayyenu veavinu haamitti baruch-hu, af-al-pi-chen, enan nikraot beshem "dechilu urechimu tiviyyim", ella keshehen bemocho umachashavto levad vetaalumot libbo, veaz, mekoman bey sefirot ditzira, ulesham hen maalot immahen hattora vehammitzvot habbaot mechamatan uvesibbatan.

Aval keshehen behitgallut libbo – nikraim "reuta delibba" bazzohar, umekoman – bey sefirot divria, ulesham hen maalot immahen hattora vehammitzvot habbaot mechamatan. mippene sheyyetziatan mehahelem vehester hallev el bechinat gilluy, hi al yede haddaat utekiat hammachashava bechozek vehitbonnut atzuma meumeka delibba, yattir vetadir, been-sof baruch-hu, ech hu chayyenu mammash veavinu haamitti baruch-hu.
Umudaat zot ma shekkatuv battikkunim: ki "beolam habberia mekannena tamman imma illaa", shehi hahitbonnut beor-en-sof chayye-hachayyim baruch-hu, uchemaamar eliyyahu: "bina libba uvah hallev mevin".
Velo od, ella shebb bechinot ahavot ellu hannizkarot leel, hen kelulot min bechinat "ahava rabba", ugedola umeulla middechilu urechimu sichliyyim" – asher haahava nikret leel beshem "ahavat olam".

Rak sheaf-al-pi-chen, tzarich litroach besichlo lehassig ulehaggia gam livchinat "ahavat olam" hannizkeret leel, habbaa mehattevuna vadaat bigdullat Adonai, kede lehagedil medurat esh haahava berishpe esh veshalhevet azza velahav haole hashshamayma, ad shemmayim rabbim lo yuchelu lechabbot vechulei uneharot lo yishtefuha vechulei". ki yesh yitron umaala livchinat ahava kerishpe esh veshalhevet azza vechulei, habbaa mehattevuna vadaat bigdullat en-sof baruch-hu, al shete bechinot ahava hannizkarot leel – kaasher enan kerishpe esh veshalhevet kulei, keyitron umaalat hazzahav al hakkesef vechulei, kemo sheyyitbaer lekamman.

Vegam, "ki ze kol haadam" vetachlito, lemaan daat et kevod Adonai vikar tiferet gedullato, ish ish kefi asher yuchal seet, kemo shekkatuv beraya mehemna parashat bo: "begin deyishtemodun leh vechulei", vechannoda:
Tanya, Part I; Likkutei Amarim 45: Od yesh derech yashar lifne ish, laasok battora umitzvot lishman, al yede middato shel yaakov avinu alav hashshalom, shehi middat harachamim, leorer bemachashavto techilla rachamim rabbim lifne Adonai al nitzotz elohut hamechayye nafsho, asher yarad mimmekoro – chayye hachayyim en-sof baruch-hu, hamemalle kol almin, vesovev kol almin, vechulla kammeh kela chashiv, venitlabbesh bemashka dechivya", harachok meor pene hammelech betachlit haherchek – ki haolam hazze hu tachlit hakkelippot haggassot kulei.

Uvifrat, kesheyyizkor al kol maasav vedibburav umachshevotav miyyom heyoto, asher lo tovim hemma, umelech asur barhatim" – "birhite mocha", ki "yaakov chevel nachalato". vechimshal hammoshech bechevel vechulei, vehu sod galut hashshechina. veal ze neemar: "veyashov el Adonai virachamehu", leorer rachamim rabbim al shem Adonai hashshochen ittanu, kedichtiv: "hashshochen ittam betoch tumeotam".

Vezehu sheamar hakkatuv: "vayyishshak yaakov lerachel, vayyissa et kolo vayyevk". ki rachel hi keneset yisrael, mekor kol hanneshamot. veyaakov bemiddato haelyona, shehi middat harachamim shebbaatzilut, hu hammeorer rachamim rabbim aleha. vayyissa et kolo – lemala, limkor harachamim haelyonim, hannikra "av harachamim" umekoram. vayyevk – leorer ulehamshich mishsham rachamim rabbim al kol hanneshamot veal mekor keneset yisrael, lehaalotan miggalutan, uleyaychadan bayyichud haelyon or-en-sof baruch-hu, bivchinat neshikin, shehi – itdabbekut rucha berucha, kemo shekkatuv: "yishshakeni minneshikot pihu", dehayynu, hitkashsherut dibbur haadam bidvar Adonai zo halacha", vechen machashava bemachashava, umaase bemaase, shehu maase hammitzvot, uvifrat maase hatztzedaka vachesed. dechesed deroa yemina", vehu bechinat chibbuk mammash, kemo shekkatuv: "vimino techabbekeni". veesek hattora bedibbur umachashevet haiyyun – hen bechinat neshikin mammash.
Vehinne, al yede ze, yachol lavo livchinat "ahava rabba" behitgallut libbo, kedichtiv: "leyaakov asher pada et avraham", kemo shennitbaer bemakom acher:
Tanya, Part I; Likkutei Amarim 46: Veyesh derech yashar lifne ish, shave lechol nefesh, vekarov haddavar meod meod, leorer ulehair or haahava hattekua umesutteret belibbo, lihyot meira betokef orah keesh boara behitgallut libbo umocho, limsor nafsho laAdonai vegufo umeodo bechol lev uvechol nefesh umeod, meumeka delibba beemet laamitto, uvifrat bishat keriat shema uvirchoteha, kemo sheyyitbaer.

Vehu, kaasher yasim el libbo ma sheamar hakkatuv: "kammayim happanim lappanim, ken lev haadam el haadam"; perush, kemo shekkidmut vetzurat happanim shehaadam mare bammayim, ken nire lo sham bammayim otah tzura atzmah – kacha mammash, "lev haadam" hanneeman beahavato leish acher, hare haahava zo meoreret ahava belev chavero elav gam ken, lihyot ohavim neemanim ze laze, bifrat kesheroe ahavat chavero elav.

Vehinne, zehu teva hannahug bemiddat kol adam, af im shenehem shavim bemaala. veal achat kamma vechamma, im melech gadol verav, mare ahavato haggedola vehaatzuma leish hedyot venivze ushefal anashim umenuvvavl hammuttal beashpa, veyored elav mimmekom kevodo im kol sarav yachdav, umekimo umerimo meashpato, umachniso lehechalo hechal hammelech, cheder lifnim mecheder, makom sheen kol eved vesar nichnas lesham, umityayched immo sham beyichud vekeruv amitti vechibbuk venishshuk veitdabbekut rucha berucha bechol lev vanefesh – al achat kamma vechamma, shettitorer mimmela haahava kefula umechuppelet belev hahedyot ushefal anashim hazze el nefesh hammelech, behitkashsherut hannefesh mammash millev vanefesh meumeka delibba leen ketz, veaf im libbo kelev haeven – himmes yimmas vehaya lemayim, vetishtappech nafsho kammayim – bichlot hannefesh mammash leahavat hammelech:

Vehinne, kechol haddevarim haelle uchechol hachizzayon hazze, vegadol yater meod bechifle chiflayim leen ketz, asa lanu elohenu. ki ligdullato en cheker, veihu memalle kol almin" vesovev kol almin", venoda mizzohar hakkadosh vehaari zichrono livracha, ribbuy hahechalot vehaolamot ad en mispar, uvechol olam vehechol ribbo rivvot malachim leen ketz vetachlit, uchemo shekkatuv baggemara: ketiv, "hayesh mispar ligdudav", uchetiv, "elef alfin yeshammeshunneh, veribbo rivvan kadamohi kulei", umeshanne: "elef alfin vechulei – mispar gedud echad, aval ligdudav – en mispar", vechullam kammeh kela mammash chashive, uvetelim bimtziut mammash, kevittul dibbur echad mammash legabbe mahut hannefesh hamedabberet veatzmutah, beod shehaya dibburah adayin bemachashavtah o birtzon vechemdat hallev, kannizkar leel baarichut:

Vechullam shoalim: "ayye mekom kevodo", veonim: "melo chol haaretz kevodo" – hem yisrael ammo, ki hinniach hakkadosh-baruch-hu et haelyonim veet hattachtonim, velo vachar bechullam ki im beyisrael ammo, vehotziam mimmitzrayim, ervat haaretz, mekom hazzuhama vehattumea, lo al yede malach velo al yede kulei, ella hakkadosh-baruch-hu bichvodo uveatzmo yarad lesham, kemo shekkatuv: "vaered lehatztzilo vegomer", kede lekarvam elav bekeruv veyichud amitti, behitkashsherut hannefesh mammash bivchinat neshikin pe lafe – ledabber devar Adonai zo halacha, veitdabbekut rucha berucha – hi hassagat hattora vidiat retzono vechachmato, dechulla chad mammash, vegam bivchinat chibbuk – hu kiyyum hammitzvot maasiyyot beramach evarim, deramach pikkudin hen ramach evarin demalka kannizkar leel, vederech kelal, nechlakin leshalosh bechinot: yamin usemol veemtza, shehen: chesed din rachamim – teren deroin vegufa vechulei.

Vezehu sheomrim: "asher kiddeshanu bemitzvotav", keadam hamekaddesh ishsha lihyot meyuchedet immo beyichud gamur, kemo shekkatuv: "vedavak beishto vehayu levasar echad". – kacha mammash veyeter al ken leen ketz, hu yichud nefesh haelohit haoseket battora umitzvot venefesh hachiyyunit ulevushehen – hannizkarim leel – beor-en-sof baruch-hu.
Velachen himshil shelomo alav hashshalom beshir hashshirim", yichud ze leyichud chatan vechalla, bidvika chashika vachafitza bechibbuk venishshuk.

Vezehu sheomrim: "asher kiddeshanu bemitzvotav" – sheheelanu lemaalat kodesh haelyon baruch-hu, shehi kedushshato shel hakkadosh-baruch-hu bichvodo uveatzmo, ukedushsha – hi leshon havedala, ma shehakkadosh-baruch-hu hu muvedal mehaolamot, vehi bechinat sovev kol almin, ma sheeno yachol lehitlabbesh bahen.

Ki al yede yichud hannefesh vehitkallutah beor-en-sof baruch-hu, hare hi bemaalat umadregat kedushshat en-sof baruch-hu mammash, meachar shemmityaychedet umitkallelet bo yitbarech, vehayu laachadim mammash. vezehu shekkatuv: "vihyitem li kedoshim ki kadosh ani Adonai, vaavdil etchem min haammim lihyot li", veomer: "vaasitem et kol mitzvotay vihyitem kedoshim lelohechem ani Adonai elohechem vegomer"; perush, ki al yede kiyyum hammitzvot hareni eloah shellachem, kemo "elohe avraham elohe yitzchak vechulei", shennikra ken mippene shehaavot hayu bechinat merkava lo yitbarech uvetelim venichlalim beoro.

Vechacha hu bechol nefesh miyyisrael bishat esek hattora vehammitzvot. velachen chiyyeyvu rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha lakum velaamod mippene kol osek bemitzva, af im hu bur veam haaretz, vehayeynu, mippene Adonai hashshochen umitlabbesh benafsho beshaa zo, rak sheen nafsho margeshet, mippene masach hachomer haggufani, shello nizdakkech, umachashich ene hannefesh merot marot elohim kemo haavot vechayyotze vahen, sherau olamam bechayyehem.

Vezehu sheamar asaf beruach hakkodesh bead kol keneset yisrael shebbaggola: "vaani vaar velo eda, behemot hayiti immach, vaani tamid immach". kelomar sheaf al pi sheani kivhema bihyoti immecha, velo eda velo argish benafshi yichud ze – shettippol aleha emata vafachad techilla, veachar kach ahava rabba betaanugim o kerishpe esh, kemiddat hatztzaddikim shennizdakkech chumeram; vechannoda, sheddaat hu leshon haregasha bannefesh, vehu kolel chesed ugevura – af-al-pi-chen, "ani tamid immach", ki en hachomer monea yichud hannefesh beor-en-sof baruch-hu hamemalle kol almin, uchemo shekkatuv: "gam choshech lo yachshich mimmekka".

Uvaze yuvan chomer onesh issur melacha beshabbatot vechametz bappesach hashshave lechol nefesh, lefi sheaf benefesh bur veam haaretz gamur, meir or kedushshat shabbat veyom tov, veniddon benafsho becharet usekila al chillul kedushsha zo.
Vegam mashshehu chametz o tiltul muketze – pogem bakkedushsha sheal nafsho kemo bikdushshat nefesh hatztzaddik, ki tora achat lechullanu.

[Uma shekkatuv "behemot" leshon rabbim, lerammez – ki lefanav yitbarech gam bechinat daat haelyon, hakkolel chesed ugevura, nidme kivhemot vaasiyyay gufanit legabbe or-en-sof, kemo shekkatuv: "kullam bechachma asita", venikra "behema rabba", kemo shennitbaer bemakom acher. vehu shem "ban" begimatriyya "behema" shellifne haatzilut]:
Tanya, Part I; Likkutei Amarim 47: Vehinne, "bechol dor vador, – vechol yom vayom – chayyayv adam lirot atzmo keillu hu yatza hayyom mimmitzrayim". vehi yetziat nefesh haelohit mimmaasar hagguf, "mashka dechivya", likkalel beyichud or-en-sof baruch-hu, al yede esek hattora vehammitzvot bichlal, uvifrat bekabbalat malchut shamayim bikriat shema, shebbah mekabbel umamshich alav yichudo yitbarech beferush, beamro: "Adonai elohenu Adonai echad".

Uchemo shennitbaer leel, ki "elohenu" hu kemo "elohe avraham vechulei", lefi shehaya batel venichlal beyichud or-en-sof baruch-hu. rak sheavraham zacha laze bemaasav vehillucho bakkodesh mimmadrega lemadrega. kemo shekkatuv: "vayyissa avram haloch venasoa vegomer":

Aval anachnu, yerushsha umattana hi lanu, shennatan lanu et torato, vehilbish bah retzono vechachmato yitbarech, hameyuchadim bemahuto veatzmuto yitbarech betachlit hayyichud, vahare ze keillu natan lanu et atzmo kivyachol. kemo shekkatuv bazzohar hakkadosh al pasuk: "veyikchu li teruma" [deli" kelomar "oti", vahava-leh-lememar "uteruma", ella mishshum dechulla chad, ayyen sham hetev]:

Vezehu sheomrim: "vattitten lanu Adonai elohenu beahava kulei", "ki veor panecha natatta lanu Adonai elohenu kulei". velaze en monea lanu middevekut hannefesh beyichudo veoro yitbarech, ella haratzon, sheim en haadam rotze kelal chas veshalom ledavka vo kulei. aval miyyad sherotze umekabbel umamshich alav elohuto yitbarech veomer "Adonai elohenu Adonai echad" – hare mimmela nichlelet nafsho beyichudo yitbarech, deruach ayyti ruach veamshich ruach", vehi bechinat yetziat mitzrayim. velachen tikkenu parashat yetziat mitzrayim bishat keriat-shema davka, af shehi mitzva bifne atzmah, velo mimmitzvat keriat shema, kidita baggemara ufoskim, ella mippene shehen davar echad mammash. vechen besof parashat yetziat mitzrayim mesayyem gam ken "ani Adonai elohechem", vehayeynu gam ken kemo shennitbaer leel:
