Tanya, Part I; Likkutei Amarim 48: Vehinne, kaasher yitbonen hammaskil bigdullat en-sof baruch-hu, ki kishmo ken hu – en-sof veen ketz vetachlit kelal, leor vechayyut hammitpashshet mimmennu yitbarech birtzono happashut umeyuchad bemahuto veatzmuto yitbarech betachlit hayyichud. veillu hayta hishtalshelut haolamot meor-en-sof baruch-hu beli tzimtzumim, rak keseder hammadregot mimmadrega lemadrega bederech illa vealul – lo haya haolam hazze nivra kelal kemo shehu atta bivchinat gevul vetachlit, "mehaaretz larakia mahalach tk shana", vechen ben kol rakia lerakia, vechen ovi kol rakia verakia.

Vaafilu olam habba vegan eden haelyon, medor nishmot hatztzaddikim haggedolim vehanneshamot atzman, veen tzarich lomar hammalachim – hen bivchinat gevul vetachlit, ki yesh gevul lehassagatan beor-en-sof baruch-hu hammeir alehen behitlabbeshut chachma-bina-daat kulei. velachen yesh gevul lahanaatan shennehenin mizziv hashshechina umitannegin beor Adonai, ki en yecholin lekabbel hanaa vetaanug bivchinat en-sof mammash, shello yitbattelu mimmetziutan veyachzeru limkoran.

Vehinne, peratiyyut hatztzimtzumim, ech uma – en kan mekom beuram. ach derech kelal, hen hem bechinat hester vehelem hameshachat haor vehachayyut, shello yair veyumeshach lattachtonim bivchinat gilluy, lehitlabbesh ulehashpia bahen ulehachayotam lihyot yesh meayin – ki im, meat mizzeer or vechayyut, bichde sheyyihyu bivchinat gevul vetachlit, shehi heara muetet meod umammash kela chashive legabbe bechinat heara beli gevul vetachlit, veen benehem erech veyachas kelal, kannoda perush millat ‘erech bemisparim, sheechad bemispar, yesh lo erech legabbe mispar elef alafim, shehu chelek echad minni elef alafim, aval legabbe davar shehu bivchinat beli gevul umispar kelal – en kenegdo shum erech bemisparim, sheafilu elef alfe alafim veribbo revavot, enan afilu keerech mispar echad legabbe elef alfe alafim veribbo revavot, ella kela mammash chashive.

Vechacha mammash hi bechinat haheara muetet zo, hammitlabbeshet beolamot elyonim vetachtonim lehashepia bahem lehachayotam, legabbe erech or hagganuz venelam, shehu bivchinat "en-sof", veeno mitlabbesh umashpia baolamot bivchinat gilluy lehachayotam, ella makkif alehem milmala, venikra – "sovev kol almin".

Veen happerush sovev umakkif milmala bivchinat makom chas veshalom, ki lo shayyaych kelal bechinat makom beruchaniyyut. ella rotze lomar, sovev umakkif milmala leinyan bechinat gilluy hashepaa, ki hahashpaa shehu bivchinat gilluy baolamot – nikret beshem "halebasha", shemmitlabbeshet baolamot, ki hem malbishim umassigim hahashpaa shemmekabbelim, ma sheen ken hahashpaa sheenah bivchinat gilluy ella behester vehelem, veen haolamot massigim otah – enah nikret "mitlabbeshet" ella makkefet vesovevet. hilkach, meachar shehaolamot hem bivchinat gevul vetachlit – nimtza sheen hashepaat or-en-sof mitlabbesh umitgalla bahem bivchinat gilluy, rak meat mizzeer, heara muetet metzumetzemet meod meod, vehi rak kede lehachayotam bivchinat gevul vetachlit.
Aval ikkar haor beli tzimtzum kol kach nikra "makkif" vesovev", meachar sheen hashepaato mitgallet betocham, meachar shehem bivchinat gevul vetachlit.

Vehammashal baze, hinne haaretz hallezu haggashmiyyut, af shemmelo chol haaretz kevodo", vehayeynu or-en-sof baruch-hu, kemo shekkatuv: "halo et hashshamayim veet haaretz ani male, neum Adonai". af-al-pi-chen, en mitlabbesh betochah bivchinat gilluy hahashpaa, rak chayyut meat mizzeer, bechinot domem vetzomeach levad. vechol or-en-sof baruch-hu nikra sovev aleha, af shehu betochah mammash. meachar sheen hashepaato mitgallet bah yoter, rak mashpia bah bivchinat hester vehelem, vechol hashepaa shebbivchinat hester, nikra makkif milmala, ki, "alma deitkasya" hu lemala bemadrega mealma deitgalya".

Ulekarev el hassechel yoter, hu bederech mashal: kemo haadam shemmetzayyer bedato eze davar sheraa o sheroe, hinne af shekkol guf etzem haddavar hahu vegabbo vetocho vetoch tocho, kullo metzuyyayr bedato umachashavto, mippene sheraahu chullo o sheroehu, hinne nikret dato makkefet haddavar hahu kullo. vehaddavar hahu mukkaf bedato umachashavto, rak, sheeno mukkaf befoal mammash – rak bedimyon machashevet haadam vedato.

Aval hakkadosh-baruch-hu dichtiv beh: "ki lo machshevotay machshevotechem kulei", hare machashavto vedato sheyyodea kol hannivraim, makkefet kol nivra venivra merosho vead tachtito, vetocho vetoch tocho, hakkol befoal mammash.

Lemashal, kaddur haaretz hallezu, hare yediato yitbarech makkefet kol ovi kaddur haaretz vechol asher betocho vetoch tocho ad tachtito, hakkol befoal mammash, shehare, yedia zo, hi chayyut kol ovi kaddur haaretz kullo, vehithauuto meayin leyesh. rak shello haya mithavve kemot shehu atta, baal gevul vetachlit vechayyut muetet meod, kede bechinot domem vetzomeach. im lo, al yede tzimtzumim rabbim vaatzumim, shetztzimtzemu haor vehachayyut shennitlabbesh bechaddur haaretz lehachayoto ulekayyeymo bivchinat gevul vetachlit, uvivchinot domem vetzomeach bilvad.

Ach yediato yitbarech hameyuchedet bemahuto veatzmuto – ki "hu hammadda vehu hayyodea vehu hayyadua, uvidiat atzmo kivyachol yodea kol hannivraim, velo bidia shechutz mimmennu kidiat haadam, ki kullam nimtzaim meamittato yitbarech, vedavar ze en bicholet haadam lehassigo al bureyo vechulei"

Haggaha
kemo shekkatav harambam zichrono livracha, vehiskimu ﬠmo chachme hakkabbala, kemo shekkatuv bappardes meharmak zichrono livracha. vechen hu lefi kabbalat haari zichrono livracha, besod hatztzimtzumim vehitlabbeshut orot bakkelim, kemo shennitbaer lﬠyl perek 2:

– Hare yedia zo, meachar shehi bivchinat en-sof, enah nikret beshem mitlabbeshet bechaddur haaretz shehu baal gevul vetachlit, ella makkefet vesovevet. af sheyyedia zo kolelet kol avyo vetocho befoal mammash, umehavvav oto al yede ze meayin leyesh, uchemo shennitbaer bemakom acher:
Tanya, Part I; Likkutei Amarim 49: Vehinne, af ki perate bechinot hahester vehahelem or-en-sof baruch-hu, behishtalshelut haolamot ad shennivra olam hazze haggashmi atzmu misfor, uminim mimminim shonim, kayyadua lattoamim meetz hachayyim, ach derech kelal, hem shelosha mine tzimtzumim atzumim kelaliyyim. lishlosha mine olamot kelaliyyim. uvechol kelal yesh ribbo rivvot peratiym, vehem shelosha olamot beria, yetzira, asiyya. ki olam haatzilut – hu elohut mammash.

Uchede livro olam habberia, shehen neshamot umalachim elyonim, asher avodatam laAdonai bivchinat chachma-bina-daat hammitlabbeshim bahem, vehem massigim umekabbelim mehem – haya techilla tzimtzum atzum, kannizkar leel.

Vechen mibberia litzira, ki or meat mizzeer hammitlabbesh beolam habberia, adayin hu bivchinat en-sof legabbe olam hayetzira, vei efshar lehitlabbesh bo, ella al yede tzimtzum vehelem. vechen mitzira laasiyya [uchemo shennitbaer bemakom acher beur shelosha tzimtzumim ellu baarichut, lekarev el sichlenu haddal].

Vetachlit kol hatztzimtzumim hu – kede livro guf haadam hachumeri, uleachpayay lesitra ochora, velihyot yitron haor min hachoshech – behaalot haadam et nafsho haelohit vehachiyyunit ulevusheha vechol kochot hagguf kullan laAdonai levaddo, kannizkar leel baarichut, ki ze tachlit hishtalshelut haolamot.

Vehinne, "kammayim happanim lappanim" – kemo shehakkadosh-baruch-hu, kivyachol, hinniach vesillek letzad echad, derech mashal, et oro haggadol habbilti tachlit, ugenazo vehistiro beg mine tzimtzumim shonim, vehakkol bishvil ahavat haadam hattachton – lehaaloto laAdonai, ki "ahava docheket habbasar", al achat kamma vechamma, bechifle chiflayim leen ketz, ki rauy leadam gam ken lehanniach velaazov kol asher lo minnefesh vead basar, ulehafkir hakkol – bishvil ledavka bo yitbarech bidvika chashika vachafitza, velo yihye shum monea mibbayit umibbachutz, lo guf velo nefesh velo mamon, velo ishsha uvanim.

Uvaze yuvan tuv taam vadaat letakkanat chachamim, shettikkenu birchot keriat shema "shetayim lefaneha kulei", delichora, en lahem shayyaychut kelal im keriat shema, kemo shekkatvu harashba ushear poskim, velamma karu otan "birchot keriat shema"? velamma tikkenu otan lefaneha davvka?

Ella mishshum sheikkar keriat shema – lekayyem "bechol levavcha kulei" – "bishne yetzarecha kulei", dehayynu, laamod neged kol monea meahavat Adonai; ulevavcha" – hen haishsha viladeha, shellevavo shel adam keshura vahen betivo, kemo sheamru rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha al pasuk: "hu amar vayyehi" – "zo ishsha", "hu tzivva vayyaamod" – "ellu vanim"; venafshecha" umeodecha" – kemashmao, chayye umezone – lehafekir hakkol bishvil ahavat Adonai.

Veech yavo haadam hachumeri lemidda zo? lechach, sidderu techilla – birkat "yotzer or", vesham neemar venishna baarichut inyan veseder hammalachim "haomdim berum olam", lehodia gedullato shel hakkadosh-baruch-hu, ech shekkullam betelim leoro yitbarech, "umashmiim beyira kulei, umakdishim kulei, veomrim beyira kadosh kulei", kelomar, shehu muvedal mehen veeno mitlabbesh bahen bivchinat gilluy, ella, "melo chol haaretz kevodo" – hi keneset yisrael lemala veyisrael lematta, kannizkar leel.
Vechen "haofannim vechayyot hakkodesh beraash gadol vechulei, baruch kevod Adonai mimmekomo", lefi sheen yodim umassigim mekomo, uchemo sheomrim: "ki hu levaddo marom vekadosh".

Veachar-kach beracha sheniyya: – "ahavat olam ahavtanu Adonai elohenu", kelomar, shehinniach kol tzeva mala hakkedoshim, vehishra shechinato alenu, lihyot nikra "elohenu", kemo "elohe avraham kulei" kannizkar leel. vehayeynu, ki ahava docheket habbasar, velachen nikra "ahavat olam" – shehi bechinat tzimtzum oro haggadol habbilti tachlit, lehitlabbesh bivchinat gevul hannikra "olam", baavur ahavat ammo yisrael, kede lekarvam elav, likkalel beyichudo veachduto yitbarech.

Vezehu sheomrim "chemla gedola vitera", perush, yetera al kirvat elohim shebbechol tzeva mala; "uvanu vacharta mikkol am velashon" – hu hagguf hachumeri hannidme bechumeriyyuto legufe ummot haolam; "vekeravtanu vechulei lehodot vechulei", uferush hodaa yitbaer bemakom acher; "uleyachedcha kulei" – likkalel beyichudo yitbarech, kannizkar leel.

Vehinne, kaasher yasim hammaskil elle haddevarim el umeka delibba umocha, azay mimmela, "kammayim happanim lappanim" – titlahet nafsho vetitlabbesh beruach nediva, lehitnaddev lehanniach velaazov kol asher lo minneged, verak ledavka bo yitbarech velikkalel beoro bidvika chashika vechulei, bivchinat neshikin veitdabbekut rucha berucha" kannizkar leel.

Ach ech hi bechinat "itdabbekut rucha berucha"? laze amar: "vehayu haddevarim haelle kulei al levavecha, vedibbarta bam kulei", uchemo shekkatuv beetz chayyim, sheyyichud hanneshikin, ikkaro hu yichud chachma-bina-daat bechachma-bina-daat, vehu – iyyun hattora; vehappe – hu motza haruach vegilluyo bivchinat gilluy, vehayeynu – bechinat haddibbur bedivre tora, "ki al motza fi Adonai yichye haadam".

Umikkol makom, lo yatza yede chovato behirhur veiyyun levaddo ad sheyyotzi bisfatav, kede lehameshich or-en-sof baruch-hu lematta ad nefesh hachiyyunit hashshochenet bedam haadam, hammithavve middomem-tzomeach-chay, kede lehaalot kullan laAdonai im kol haolam kullo, ulechallan beyichudo veoro yitbarech, asher yair laaretz veladdarim bivchinat gilluy, "venigla kevod Adonai, verau chol basar vechulei", shezzehu tachlit hishtalshelut kol haolamot, lihyot kevod Adonai male chol haaretz hallezu davka bivchinat gilluy, leahafacha chashocha linhora umerira lemitka, kannizkar leel baarichut.
Vezehu tachlit kavvavnat haadam baavodato, lehameshich or-en-sof baruch-hu lematta, rak shetztzarich techilla haalaat "mayyin nukevin", – limsor lo nafsho umeodo kannizkar leel:
Tanya, Part I; Likkutei Amarim 50: Vehinne, kol bechinot umadregot ahava hannizkarot leel – hen missitra deyammina uvechinat "kohen ish chesed", venikraot "kesef hakkodashim", milleshon "nichsof nichsafta levet avicha".
Ach yesh od bechinat ahava haola al kullana, kemaalat hazzahav al hakkesef, vehi ahava kerishpe esh" – mibbechinat gevurot elyonot devina illaa.

Dehayynu, sheal yede hitbonnut bigdullat en-sof baruch-hu, dechulla kammeh kela mammash chashiv – titlahet vetitlahev hannefesh likar tiferet gedullato uleistakkela bikara demalka, kerishpe esh shalhevet azza haola lemala, velippared mehappetila vehaetzim shenneechezet bahen, vehayeynu, al yede tigboret yesod haesh elohi shebbannefesh haelohit, umizze baa lide tzimmaon, uchemo shekkatuv: "tzama lecha nafshi", veachar kach livchinat "cholat ahava", veachar kach baa lide kelot hannefesh mammash, kemo shekkatuv: "gam kalta nafshi".

Vehinne, mikkan yatza shoresh haleviyyim lematta [veleatid shehaolam yitalle – yihyu hem hakkohanim, uchemo sheamar haari zichrono livracha al pasuk: "vehakkohanim haleviyyim" shehaleviyyim shel achshav yihyu kohanim leatid], vaavodat haleviyyim hayta leharim kol rinna vetoda, beshira vezimra, beniggun uneima, bivchinat "ratzo vashov", shehi bechinat ahava azza zo keshalhevet hayyotze min habbazak, kidita baggemara [perek b dachagiga].

Vei efshar levaer inyan ze hetev bemichtav, rak kol ish nilbav venavon, hammaskil al davar umaamik lekashsher dato utevunato baAdonai – yimtza tov veor hagganuz benafsho hammaskelet, kol chad lefum shiura dileh [yesh mitpael kulei veyesh mitpael kulei], achare kedimat yirat chet, lihyot sur mera betachlit shello lihyot "avonotechem mavdilim" kulei chas veshalom.

Vehinne, seder haavoda beesek hattora vehammitzvot hannimshechet mibbechinat ahava azza zo, hi bivchinat "shov" levad, kemo shekkatuv besefer yetzira: "veim ratz libbecha – shuv leechad", perush "veim ratz libbecha" – hi teshukat hannefesh shebballev bechalal hayemani, keshemmitgabberet umitlahevet umitlahetet bimod meod ad kelot hannefesh mammash, lehishtappech el chek aviha chayye hachayyim baruch-hu, velatzet mimmaasarah bagguf haggufani vegashmi ledavka bo yitbarech – azay, zot yashiv el libbo: maamar rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha, ki "al karchach atta chay" bagguf hazze lehachayoto, kede lehameshich chayyim elyonim mechayye hachayyim baruch-hu lematta, al yede torat chayyim, lihyot dira battachtonim leachduto yitbarech bivchinat gilluy, kemo shennitbaer leel, uchemo shekkatuv bazzohar hakkadosh: "lemeheve echad beechad", perush, shehayyichud hannelam yihye bivchinat "alma deitgalya".

Vezehu sheomrim: "lecha dodi vechulei". uvaze yuvan maamar rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha: "al karchach atta chay, veal karchach vechulei", veella ech yihye retzono? uchemo shennitbaer bemakom acher baarichut al mishna zo – "al karchach atta chay", beezrat chayye hachayyim baruch-hu:
Tanya, Part I; Likkutei Amarim 51: Vehinne, letosefet beur leshon hayyannuka dilel, tzarich levaer techilla, lehavin ketzat inyan hasheraat hashshechina shehayta shora bevet kadshe kadashim, vechen kol mekom hasheraat hashshechina, ma inyayno? halo "melo chol haaretz kevodo", velet atar panuy minneh"!

Ach hainyan, kedichtiv: "umibbesari echeze eloah", shekkemo shennishmat haadam hi memallea kol ramach evre hagguf merosho vead raglo, veaf-al-pi-chen, ikkar mishkanah vehasheraatah hi bemocho, umehammoach mitpashshetet lechol haevarim, vechol ever mekabbel mimmenna chayyut vechoach harauy lo lefi mizgo utechunato, haayin lirot, vehaozen lishmoa, vehappe ledabber, veharaglayim lahaloch, kannire bechush – shebbammoach margish kol hannifal beramach evarim vechol hakkorot otam.

Vehinne, en shinnuy kabbalat hakkochot vehachayyut shebbeevre hagguf min hanneshama mitztzad atzmah umahutah, sheyyihye mahutah veatzmutah mitchallek leramach chalakim shonim mitlabbeshim beramach mekomot, kefi tziyyur chelke mekomot evre hagguf, – shellefi ze nimtza atzmutah umahutah metzuyyayr betziyyur gashmi udemut vetavnit ketavnit hagguf chas veshalom, ella kullah etzem echad ruchani, pashut umufeshat mikkol tziyyur gashmi umibbechinat vegeder makom umidda ugevul gashmi mitztzad mahutah veatzmutah, velo shayyaych bemahutah veatzmutah lomar shehi bammochin shebbarosh yoter mibbaraglayim, meachar shemmahutah veatzmutah eno begeder uvechinat makom ugevul gashmi, rak shettaryag mine kochot vechayyut kelulim bah bemahutah veatzmutah, latzet el happoal vehaggilluy mehahelem, lehachayot ramach evarin veshasa gidin shebbagguf al yede hitlabbeshutam bannefesh hachiyyunit, sheyyesh lah gam ken ramach veshasa kochot vechayyut hallalu.

Vehinne, al hameshachat kol hattaryag mine kochot vechayyut mehelem hanneshama el hagguf lehachayoto – aleha amru, sheikkar mishkanah vehasheraatah shel hameshacha zo vegilluy ze – hu kullo bammochin shebbarosh, velachen hem mekabbelim techilla hakkoach vehachayyut harauy lahem lefi mizgam utechunatam, shehen chachma-bina-daat vechoach hammachashava vechol hashshayyaych lammochin. velo zo bilvad, ella gam kelalut kol hameshachot hachayyut lishar haevarim, gam ken kelula umelubbeshet bammochin shebbarosh, vesham hu ikkarah vesharshah shel hameshacha zo, bivchinat gilluy haor vehachayyut shel kol hanneshama chullah, umishsham mitpashshetet heara lishar kol haevarim, umekabbel kol echad koach vechayut harauy lo kefi mizgo utechunato: koach hariyya mitgalle baayin, vechoach hashshemia baozen vechulei. vechol hakkochot mitpashshetim mehammoach kannoda, ki sham hu ikkar mishkan hanneshama chullah bivchinat gilluy, shenniglet sham kelalut hachayyut hammitpashshet mimmenna. rak kochoteha shel kelalut hachayyut meirim umitpashshetim mishsham lechol evre hagguf, kedimyon haor hammitpashshet umeir mehashshemesh lechadre chadarim. [vaafilu hallev – mekabbel mehammoach, velachen hammoach shallit alav betoladto, kannizkar leel].

Vechacha mammash, al derech mashal, en-sof baruch-hu memalle kol almin lehachayotam, uvechol olam yesh beruim leen ketz vetachlit, ribbo revavot mine madregot malachim uneshamot kulei, vechen ribbuy haolamot en lo ketz ugevul, gavoah al gavoah kulei.

Vehinne, mahuto veatzmuto shel en-sof baruch-hu shave baelyonim vetachtonim, kimshal hanneshama hannizkar leel, uchemo shekkatuv battikkunim: "deihu setimu dechol setimin", perush, daafilu bealmin setimin dilella, hu satum venelam betocham, kemo shehu satum venelam battachtonim, ki "let machashava tefisa veh kelal", afilu beolamot elyonim, venimtza, kemo shemmatzuy sham – kach nimtza battachtonim mammash.

Vehahevdel shebben olamot elyonim vetachtonim, hu mitztzad hameshachat hachayyut asher en-sof baruch-hu mamshich umeir bivchinat gilluy mehahelem [shezze echad mehatteamim shehahashpaa vehameshachat hachayyut mechunna beshem "or" al derech mashal], lehachayot haolamot vehabberuim shebbahem, shehaolamot haelyonim mekabbelim bivchinat gilluy ketzat yoter mehattachtonim, vechol habberuim shebbahem mekabbelim kol echad kefi kocho utechunato, shehi techunat uvechinat hameshacha happeratit asher en-sof baruch-hu mamshich umeir lo.
Vehattachtonim, afilu haruchaniyyim, enam mekabbelim bivchinat gilluy kol kach, rak bilvushim rabbim asher en-sof baruch-hu malbish bahem hachayyut vehaor asher mamshich umeir lahem lehachayotam.

Vechol kach atzmu vegavru hallevushim asher en-sof baruch-hu malbish umastir bahem haor vehachayyut, ad asher bara vo olam hazze hachumeri vehaggashmi mammash, umehavvevhu umechayyehu bechayyut veor asher mamshich umeir lo, or hamelubbash umechusse umusetar betoch hallevushim harabbim vehaatzumim hammaalimim umastirim haor vehachayyut, ad sheen nire venigle shum or vechayyut rak devarim chumeriyyim vegashmiyyim, venirim metim, ach betocham – yesh or vechayyut hamehavve otam meayin leyesh tamid, shello yachzeru lihyot ayin vaefes keshehayu, veor ze hu meen-sof baruch-hu, rak shennitlabbesh bilvushim rabbim, uchemo shekkatuv beetz chayyim, sheor vechayyut kaddur haaretz hachumeri hannire leene vasar, hu mimmalchut demalchut daasiyya, uvetochah – malchut ditzira vechulei, ad shebbetoch kullan – 10 sefirot daatzilut hameyuchadot bemaatzilan en-sof baruch-hu:
Tanya, Part I; Likkutei Amarim 52: Uchemo shebbenishmat haadam ikkar gilluy kelalut hachayyut – hu bammochin, vechol haevarim, mekabbelim or vechoach levad, hammeir lahem mimmekor gilluy hachayyut shebbammochin – kacha mammash, al derech mashal, ikkar gilluy kelalut hameshachat hachayyut, lehachayot haolamot vehabberuim shebbahem – hu melubbash venichlal birtzono vechachmato uvinato vedato yitbarech, hannikrain beshem "mochin", vehen hen hamelubbashim battora umitzvoteha.

Vegilluy kelalut hameshacha zo – hu mekor hachayyut, asher haolamot mekabbelim kol echad bifratut. rak heara mitpashshetet umeira mimmakor ze, kedimyon or hammitpashshet mehashshemesh al derech mashal, vechochot evre hagguf mehammoach hannizkar leel.

Umakor ze, hu hannikra "alma deitgalleya", umatronita", veimma tattaa", ushechina" milleshon "veshachanti betocham", al shem, shemmakor ze hu reshit hitgallut or-en-sof, asher mamshich umeir laolamot bivchinat gilluy, umimmakor ze, nimshach lechol echad haor vechayyut perati harauy lo veshochen umitlabbesh betocham lehachayotam.

Velachen nikra "em habbanim" al derech mashal, ucheneset yisrael", shemmimmakor ze, neetzlu neshamot daatzilut venivreu neshamot divria vechulei. vechullan enan, rak mehitpashshetut hachayyut vehaor mehammakor hazze hannikra "shechina", kehitpashshetut haor mehashshemesh.

Aval hashshechina atzmah, shehi reshit haggilluy veikkaro, ma sheen-sof baruch-hu meir laolamot bivchinat gilluy, vehi mekor kol hameshachot hachayyut shebbechol haolamot [shekkol hachayyut shebbahem, eno rak or hammitpashshet mimmenna – kaor hammitpashshet mehashshemesh] – i efshar laolamot lisbol ulekabbel or shechinatah, shettishkon vetitlabbesh betocham mammash, belo levush hammaalim umastir orah mehem, shello yitbattelu bimtziut legamre bimkoram, kevittul or hashshemesh bimkoro beguf hashshemesh, sheen nire sham or ze, rak etzem guf hashshemesh bilvad.

Umahu hallevush sheyyuchal lehasetirah ulehalbishah, velo yitbattel bimtziut beorah? hu retzono yitbarech vechachmato vechulei hamelubbashim battora umitzvoteha, hanniglet lanu ulevanenu, deorayyta mechachma nafkat", hi chachma illaa, dilella leella mealma deitgalya, deihu chakkim vela vechachma yedia vechulei, uchemo shennitbaer leel, sheor-en-sof baruch-hu melubbash umeyuchad bechachma illaa, vehu yitbarech vechachmato echad. rak sheyyarda beseter hammadregot mimmadrega lemadrega behishtalshelut haolamot, ad shennitlabbesha bidvarim gashmiyyim, shehen taryag mitzvot hattora.

Uviridatah behishtalshelut meolam leolam – gam hashshechina yarda venitlabbesha bah bechol olam veolam, vezehu hechal kadshe kadashim shebbechol olam veolam, uchemo shekkatuv bazzohar veetz chayyim, shehashshechina, shehi malchut daatzilut [shehi bechinat gilluy or-en-sof baruch-hu vechayyut shemmeir laolamot, velachen hi nikret "devar Adonai" veruach piv", kivyachol al derech mashal, kemo shebbaadam haddibbur hu megalle machashavto hassetuma venelama lehashshomim] – hi mitlabbeshet behechal kadshe kadashim divria, shehi chachma-bina-daat divria, uvehitlabbeshutan bemalchut divria – nivreu hanneshamot vehammalachim shebbabberia.

Vegam mishsham nimshach hattalmud shellefanenu, uchemo shennitbaer leel beshem hattikkunim, shebbeolam habberia, meirot umashpiot sham chachmato uvinato vedato shel en-sof baruch-hu bivchinat tzimtzum atzum, bichde sheyyuchelu hanneshamot vehammalachim, shehem baale gevul vetachlit, lekabbel hashepaa mibbechinat chachma-bina-daat ellu, velachen nimshach mishsham hattalmud, shehu gam ken bechinat chachma-bina-daat, shehattalmud hu taame hahalachot al bureyayn, vehatteamim – hem bechinat chachma-bina-daat, vehahalachot atzman – hen mimmiddotav shel en-sof baruch-hu, shehen: chesed din rachamim kulei, shemmehen nimshach hahetter vehaissur, vehakkasher vehappasul, vehachiyyuv vehappetur, kemo shekkatuv battikkunim.

Uvehitlabbeshut malchut daatzilut bemalchut divria, mitlabbeshet behechal kadshe kadashim ditzira shehu chachma-bina-daat ditzira. uvehitlabbeshutan bemalchut ditzira – notzru haruchot vehammalachim shebbitzira.
Vegam mishsham hi hammishna shellefanenu, shehi halachot pesukot, hannimshachot gam ken mechachma-bina-daat shel en-sof baruch-hu.

Rak shebbechinot chachma-bina-daat shehem taame hahalachot, hem melubbashim ugenuzim begufe hahalachot, velo bivchinat gilluy. vegufe hahalachot shehen bivchinat gilluy – hen hen hearat middotav shel en-sof baruch-hu bivchinat gilluy, kemo shennitbaer leel beshem hattikkunim deshit sefiran mekannenin bitzira", shehen derech kelal shene kavvin, yamin usemol – lehakel missitra dechesed, dehayynu, lehattir – sheyyuchal laalot el Adonai, o lehachamir kulei; vehakkol, al pi chachma illaa daatzilut, uvina vadaat kelulot bah, umeyuchadot been-sof baruch-hu, ki betoch kullan melubbashot chachma-bina-daat daatzilut, sheor-en-sof baruch-hu meyuchad bahen betachlit hayyichud.
Vechen bederech ze, yarda hashshechina venitlabbesha behechal kadshe kadashim daasiyya.
Vechol olam mig olamot ellu mitchallek lerivvot madregot, hannikraot gam ken olamot peratim, umalchut daatzilut melubbeshet bammalchut

Haggaha
uvaze yuvan leshon hakkatuv: "malchutecha malchut kol olamim":
Shel kol olam perati – yoredet umitlabbeshet behechal kadshe kadashim, shehu chachma-bina-daat shebbaolam shellemata mimmennu bemadrega.

Vehinne, mehashshechina hamelubbeshet behechal kadshe kadashim shel kol olam veolam, kelali o perati, nimshach umitpashshet mimmenna or vechayyut lechol haolam vehabberuim shebbo, neshamot umalachim vechulei, ki kullam nivreu baasara maamarot shebbemaase vereshit, shehem "devar Adonai" hannikra beshem "shechina":
Tanya, Part I; Likkutei Amarim 53: Vehinne, keshehaya bayit rishon kayyaym, shebbo haya haaron vehalluchot bevet kadshe kadashim – hayta hashshechina, shehi malchut daatzilut, shehi bechinat gilluy or-en-sof baruch-hu, shora sham, umelubbeshet baaseret haddibberot, beyeter seet veyeter oz, begilluy rav veatzum yoter miggilluyah behechlot kadshe kadashim shellemala beolamot elyonim.

Ki aseret haddibberot hen kelalut hattora chullah, denafka miggo chachma illaa, dilella leella mealma deitgalya, uchede lechakkan beluchot avanim gashmiyyim – lo yarda mimmadrega lemadrega, kederech hishtalshelut haolamot ad olam hazze haggashmi, ki olam hazze haggashmi – mitnaheg behitlabbeshut hatteva haggashmi, "vehalluchot – maase elohim hemma, vehammichtav – michtav elohim hu", lemala mehatteva shel olam hazze haggashmi, hannishpa mehearat hashshechina shebbehechal kadshe kadashim daasiyya, shemmimmenna nimshach or vechayyut leolam haasiyya, sheggam olam hazze bichlalo, ella, bechinat chachma illaa daatzilut, shehi kelalut hattora shebbey haddibberot, nitlabbesha bemalchut daatzilut vedivria levaddan, vehen levaddan hameyuchadot beor-en-sof shebbetochan – hen hannikraot beshem "shechina", hashshora bekadshe kadashim devayit rishon, al yede hitlabbeshutah bey haddibberot hachakukot balluchot shebbaaron benes umaase elohim chayyim [hu "alma deitkasya", hamekannen beolam habberia, kannoda leyode chen].

Uvevayit sheni shello haya vo haaron vehalluchot, amru rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha, shello hayta shechina shora bo, perush, madregat shechina shehayta shora bevayit rishon shello kederech hishtalshelut haolamot. ella, bevayit sheni, hayta shora kederech hishtalshelut vehitlabbeshut malchut daatzilut bemalchut divria, vedivria bemalchut ditzira, veditzira behechal kadshe kadashim daasiyya, vekadshe kadashim daasiyya haya mitlabbesh bekadshe kadashim shebbevet hammikdash shellematta, vesharta bo hashshechina – malchut ditzira hamelubbeshet bekadshe kadashim daasiyya, velachen lo haya rashshay shum adam likkanes sham, levad kohen gadol beyom hakkippurim. – umishshecharav bet hammikdash en lo lehakkadosh-baruch-hu beolamo ella 4 ammot shel halacha bilvad", vaafilu echad sheyyoshev veosek battora – shechina immo", kidita bivrachot perek kamma, perush "shechina immo" – kederech hishtalshelut vehitlabbeshut malchut daatzilut bemalchut divria vitzira vaasiyya.

Ki taryag mitzvot hattora, rubban kechullan hen mitzvot maasiyyot, vegam hatteluyot bedibbur umachashava, kemo talmud tora uvirkat hammazon ukeriat shema utefilla – ha kayyeyma lan, dehirhur – lav kedibbur dame", veeno yotze yede chovato behirhur vechavvavna levad, ad sheyyotzi bisfatav, vekayyeyma lan daakimat sefatav have maase".

Vetaryag mitzvot hattora im sheva mitzvot derabbanan – begimatriyya "keter", shehu ratzon haelyon baruch hu hamelubbash bechachmato yitbarech, hameyuchadot beor-en-sof baruch-hu betachlit hayyichud. vaAdonai bechachma yasad aretz" hi tora shebbeal pe denafka mechachma illaa, kemo shekkatuv bazzohar deabba yasad beratta".

Vezehu sheamar hayyannuka: "dinhora illaa deadlik al resheh" hi shechinta – "itzterich lemishcha", perush, lehitlabbesh bechachma, hannikret "shemen mishchat kodesh", kemo shekkatuv bazzohar, veinun ovadin tavin" – hen taryag mitzvot hannimshachot mechachmato yitbarech, kede leechoz or hashshechina bappetila, hi nefesh hachiyyunit shebbagguf, hannikret petila al derech mashal. ki, kemo shebbanner haggashmi, haor meir al yede kilyon userefat happetila hannehpechet leesh, kach, or hashshechina shore al nefesh haelohit al yede kilyon nefesh habbahamit vehithappechutah mechashocha linhora umimmeriru lemitka – batztzaddikim, o lefachot, al yede kilyon levusheha shehen machashava dibbur umaase, vehithappechutan mechoshech hakkelippot leor Adonai en-sof baruch-hu hamelubbash umeyuchad bemachashava dibbur umaase shel taryag mitzvot hattora – babbenonim.

Ki al yede hithappechut nefesh habbahamit, habbaa mikkelippat noga, mechashocha linhora vechulei – naase bechinat "haalaat mayyin nukevin", lehameshich or hashshechina, hi bechinat gilluy or-en-sof baruch-hu, al nafsho haelohit shebbammochin shebberosho. uvaze yuvan hetev ma shekkatuv: "ki Adonai elohecha esh ochla hu", uchemo shennitbaer bemakom acher:
Nishlam chelek rishon bﬠzerat Adonai yitbarech veyitﬠle
Tanya, Part II; Shaar HaYichud VehaEmuna: Likkute amarim chelek sheni
Hannikra beshem "chinnuch katan"
Melukkat mippi sefarim umippi sofrim kedoshe elyon nishmatam-eden, meyussad al parasha rishona shel keriat-shema:
Chanoch lannaar al pi darko, gam ki yazkin lo yasur mimmenna. hinne, middichtiv: "al pi darko", mashma, sheenah derech haemet laamitto, veim ken, may maalyuta sheggam ki yazkin lo yasur mimmenna"?

Ach hinne mudaat zot, ki sharshe avodat Adonai visodoteha, hen dechilu urechimu, hayyira – shoresh visod lesur mera", vehaahava – levaase tov" vekiyyum kol mitzvot ase deorayyta uderabbanan, kemo sheyyitbaer bimkoman. (umitzvat hachinnuch hi gam ken bemitzvot ase, kemo shekkatuv beorach chayyim siman 343):
Vehinne, beahava ketiv besof parashat ekev: "asher anochi metzavve etchem laasotah, leahava et Adonai vegomer". vetzarich lehavin, ech shayyaych leshon "asiyyay" gabbe ahava shebballev?

Ach hainyan hu, deyesh shene mine ahavat Adonai. haachat, hi kelot hannefesh betivah el borah, kaasher titgabber nefesh hassichlit al hachomer vetashpilehu vetachniehu tachteha, azay titlahev vetitlahet beshalhevet haola meeleha, vetagel vetismach baAdonai oseha, vetitanneg al Adonai taanug nifla. vehazzochim lemaalat ahava rabba zo – hem hannikraim tzaddikim, kedichtiv: "simchu tzaddikim baAdonai". ach lo kol adam zoche laze, ki laze tzarich zikkuch hachomer bimod meod, vegam tora umaasim tovim harebe, lizkot linshama elyona shellemala mimmadregat ruach vanefesh, kemo shekkatuv bereshit chachma shaar haahava.

Vehashshenit, hi ahava shekkol adam yuchal lehaggia eleha, kesheyyitbonen hetev beumeka delibba biddevarim hammeorrim et haahava laAdonai belev kol yisrael. hen derech kelal – ki hu chayyenu mammash, vechaasher haadam ohev et nafsho vechayyav – ken yeehav et Adonai, kaasher yitbonen veyasim el libbo ki Adonai hu nafsho haamittit vechayyav mammash, kemo shekkatuv bazzohar al pasuk: "nafshi ivviticha vegomer". vehen derech perat – shekkesheyyavin veyaskil bigdullato shel melech malche hammelachim hakkadosh-baruch-hu derech peratit, kaasher yuchal seet besichlo uma shellemala missichlo.

Veachar kach, yitbonen beahavat Adonai haggedola veniflaa elenu, lered lemitzrayim "ervat haaretz", lehotzi nishmotenu mikkur habbarzel", shehu hassitra ochora" rachamana litztzelan, lekarvenu elav uledabbekenu bishmo mammash, vehu ushemo echad, dehayynu, sherommanu mittachlit hashshiflut vehattumea – letachlit hakkedushsha, ugedullato yitbarech sheen lah ketz vetachlit, azay "kammayim happanim el panim" – titorer haahava belev kol maskil umitbonen beinyan ze beumeka delibba, leehov et Adonai ahava azza, uledavka vo belev vanefesh, kemo sheyyitbaer bimkomah baarichut.

Vehinne, inyan ahava zo ratza moshe rabbenu alav-hashshalom litta belev kol yisrael, befarasha: "veatta yisrael vegomer", bappasuk: "hen laAdonai elohecha hashshamayim vegomer, rak baavotecha chashak vegomer, umaltem vegomer, beshivim nefesh vegomer, veahavta vegomer". velachen siyyem devarav al ahava zo: "asher anochi metzavve etchem laasotah", shehi ahava asuya ballev, al yede habbina vehaddaat bidvarim hammeorrim et haahava. veal ze tzivva kevar techilla: "vehayu haddevarim haelle asher anochi metzavvecha hayyom al levavecha", kede sheal yede ze tavo leahava et Adonai, kidita besifre al pasuk ze.

Vehinne, al ahava zo, hashshenit, shayyaych leshon mitzva vetziuuy, dehayynu, lasum libbo vedato bidvarim hammeorrim et haahava. aval beahava rishona, shehi shalhevet haola meeleha, lo shayyaych leshon tziuuy umitzva kelal. velo od, ella shehi mattan secharan shel tzaddikim, litom meen olam habba baolam hazze, shealeha neemar: "avodat mattana etten et kehunnatchem", kemo sheyyitbaer bimkomah.

Ach hinne yadua layyodim, taama dikra may dichtiv: "ki sheva yippol tzaddik vakam", uvifrat shehaadam nikra "mehallech" velo "omed", vetzarich lelech mimmadrega lemadrega, velo laamod bemadrega achat leolam, uven madrega lemadrega, terem sheyyaggia lemadrega elyona mimmenna, hu bivchinat "nefila" mimmadrega harishona. ach, "ki yippol – lo yutal" ketiv, veenah nikret nefila, ella legabbe madregato harishona, velo legabbe shear kol adam chas veshalom, sheaf-al-pi-chen, hu lemala mikkol haadam baavodato, ki nishar bah bechinat reshimu mimmadregato harishona. ach ikkarah, meahava shennitchannech vehuregal bah minneurav, beterem shehiggia lemadregat tzaddik. vezehu shekkatuv: "gam ki yazkin vegomer". vehinne, reshit haddevarim hammeorrim haahava vehayyira visodan – hi haemuna hattehora veneemana beyichudo veachduto yitbarech veyitalle:
Lehavin meat mizzeer ma shekkatuv bazzohar, dishma yisrael kulei" – hu "yichuda illaa", uvaruch shem kevod malchuto leolam vaed" – hu "yichuda tattaa":

Veyadata hayyom vahashevota el levavecha, ki Adonai hu haelohim bashshamayim mimmaal veal haaretz mittachat – en od. vetzarich lehavin: vechi taale al datecha sheyyesh elohim nishre bammayim mittachat laaretz, shetztzarich lehazehir kol kach "vahashevota el levavecha"?

Hinne, ketiv: "leolam, Adonai, devarcha nitztzav bashshamayim", ufiresh habbaal-shem-tov zichrono livracha: ki "devarcha" sheamarta "yehi rakia betoch hammayim vegomer" – tevot veotiyyot ellu, hen nitztzavot veomdot leolam betoch rekia hashshamayim, umelubbashot betoch kol harkiim leolam lehachayotam, kedichtiv: "udevar elohenu yakum leolam", "udevarav chayim vekayyaymim laad kulei", ki illu hayu haotiyyot mistallekot kerega chas veshalom vechozrot limkoran, hayu kol hashshamayim ayin vaefes mammash, vehayu kelo hayu kelal, uchemo kodem maamar "yehi rakia kulei" mammash.

Vechen bechol habberuim shebbechol haolamot elyonim vetachtonim, vaafilu eretz hallezu haggashmit uvechinat domem mammash, illu hayu mistallekot mimmenna kerega chas veshalom haotiyyot measara maamarot shebbahen nivret haaretz besheshet yeme vereshit, hayta chozeret leayin vaefes mammash, kemo lifne sheshet yeme vereshit mammash.

Vezehu sheamar haari zichrono livracha, sheggam bedomem mammash, kemo avanim veafar umayim, yesh bechinat nefesh vechayyut ruchanit. dehayynu, bechinat hitlabbeshut otiyyot haddibbur measara maamarot hamechayyot umehauot et haddomem, lihyot yesh meayin vaefes shellifne sheshet yeme vereshit.

Veaf shello huzekar shem "even" baasara maamarot shebbattora, af-al-pi-chen, nimshach chayyut laeven al yede tzerufim vechillufe otiyyot, hammitgalgelot berl shearim panim veachor, kemo shekkatuv besefer yetzira, ad shemmishtalshel measara maamarot venimshach mehen tzeruf shem "even", vehu chayyuto shel haeven.

Vechen bechol hannivraim shebbaolam, hashshemot shennikraim bahem bilshon hakkodesh – hen hen otiyyot haddibbur, hammishtalshelot mimmadrega lemadrega measara maamarot shebbattora, al yede chillufim utemurot haotiyyot berl shearim, ad shemmaggiot umitlabbeshot beoto nivra lehachayoto.

Lefi sheen perate hannivraim yecholim lekabbel chayyutam measara maamarot atzman shebbattora, shehachayyut hannimshach mehen atzman – gadol meod mibbechinat hannivraim peratiyyim, veen koach bahem lekabbel hachayyut, ella al yede sheyyored hachayyut umishtalshel mimmadrega lemadrega pechuta mimmenna, al yede chillufim utemurot haotiyyot, vegimatriyyaot shehen cheshbon haotiyyot, ad sheyyuchal lehittzamtzem ulehitlabbesh ulehithauot mimmennu nivra perati.

Veze shemo asher yikreu lo bilshon hakkodesh, hu keli lachayyut hametzumetzam beotiyyot shem ze, shennishtalshel measara maamarot shebbattora, sheyyesh bahem koach vechayyut livro yesh meayin, ulehachayoto leolam, deorayyta vekudesha berich hu kulla chad":

Vehinne, mikkan teshuvat hamminim vegilluy shoresh tautam, hakkofrim behashegacha feratit uveotot umofte hattora, shettoim bedimyonam hakkozev, shemmedamin maase Adonai – "ose shamayim vaaretz" lemaase enosh vetachbulotav, ki kaasher yatza latztzoref keli – shuv en hakkeli tzarich lide hatztzoref, ki af sheyyadav mesullakot hemennu veholech lo bashshuk – hakkeli kayyaym betavnito vetzalmo mammash kaasher yatza mide hatztzoref, kach medammin hassechalim haellu maase shamayim vaaretz.

Ach "tach merot enehem", hahevdel haggadol shebben maase enosh vetachbulotav, shehu yesh miyyesh, rak shemmeshanne hatztzura vehattemuna mittemunat chatichat kesef litmunat keli, lemaase shamayim vaaretz, shehu yesh meayin.

Vehu pele gadol yoter mikkeriat yam suf al derech mashal, sheholich Adonai et hayyam beruach kadim azza kol hallayla vayyibbaku hammayim", venitztzevu chemo ned" uchechoma veillu hifsik Adonai et haruach kerega – hayu hammayim chozrim veniggarim bemorad kedarkam vetivam, velo kamu kechoma beli safek, af shehatteva hazze bammayim gam ken nivra umechuddash yesh meayin, shehare chomat avanim nitztzevet meatzmah beli ruach, rak shetteva hammayim eno chen.

Vechol shekken vekal vachomer bivriat yesh meayin, shehi lemala mehatteva, vehafele vafele yoter mikkeriat yam suf, al achat kamma vechamma shebbehistallekut koach habbore min hannivra chas veshalom – yashuv hannivra leayin vaefes mammash. ella tzarich lihyot koach happoel bannifal tamid, lehachayoto ulekayyeymo. vehen hen bechinot otiyyot haddibbur measara maamarot shebbahem nivreu.

Veal ze neemar: "veatta mechayye et kullam" – al tikre "mechayye", ella "mehavve", dehayynu, yesh meayin, veatta" – hen bechinot haotiyyot mealef vead tav, vehahe – hi Adonai motzaot happe, mekor haotiyyot. vehen hen bechinot otiyyot haddibbur measara maamarot shebbahem nivreu.

Veaf sheen lo demut hagguf – hare mikra male dibber hakkatuv: "vaydabber Adonai", "vayyomer Adonai", vehi bechinat hitgallut hachv otiyyot elyonot lanneviim, umitlabbeshot besichlam vehassagatam bemare hannevua, vegam bemachashavtam vedibburam, kemo shekkatuv: "ruach Adonai dibber bi, umillato al leshoni", uchemo sheamar haari zichrono livracha [beshaar hannevua].

Ucheen ze hi hitlabbeshut haotiyyot babberuim, kedichtiv: "bidvar Adonai shamayim naasu, uveruach piv kol tzevaam", rak, shehi al yede hishtalshelut rabbot vaatzumot, ad sheyyordot laasiyya gufanit, ma sheen ken hassagat hanneviim, hi baatzilut hammitlabbeshet beolam habberia:

Vehinne, achare haddevarim vehaemet haelle, kol maskil al davar yavin laashuro, ech shekkol nivra vayesh hu beemet nechshav leayin vaefes mammash legabbe koach happoel veruach piv shebbannifal, hamehavve oto tamid umotzio meayin mammash leyesh.

Uma shekkol nivra venifal nire lanu leyesh umammashut, zehu, mechamat sheen anu massigim veroim beene vasar et koach Adonai veruach piv shebbannivra, aval illu nittena reshut laayin lirot ulehassig et hachayyut veruchaniyyut shebbechol nivra, hashshofea bo mimmotza fi Adonai" veruach piv – lo haya gashmiyyut hannivra vechumero umammasho nire kelal leenenu, ki hu batel bimtziut mammash legabbe hachayyut veharuchaniyyut shebbo, meachar shemmibbalade haruchaniyyut, haya ayin vaefes mammash, kemo kodem sheshet yeme vereshit mammash, veharuchaniyyut hashshofea alav mimmotza fi Adonai" veruach piv, hu levaddo hammotzio tamid meefes vaayin leyesh, umehavve oto, im ken, efes bilado beemet.

Vehammashal laze hu, or hashshemesh "hammeir laaretz veladdarim", shehu ziv veor hammitpashshet migguf hashshemesh venire leen kol, meir al haaretz uvachalal haolam, vehinne, ze pashut, sheor veziv hazze yeshno gam ken beguf vechomer kaddur hashshemesh atzmo shebbashshamayim, sheim mitpashshet umeir lemerachok kol kach, kol shekken sheyyuchal lehair bimkomo mammash, rak sheshsham, bimkomo mammash, nechshav hazziv hazze leayin vaefes mammash, ki batel mammash bimtziut legabbe guf kaddur hashshemesh, shehu mekor haor vehazziv hazze, shehazziv vehaor hazze, eno rak heara meira migguf veetzem kaddur hashshemesh; rak bachalal haolam, tachat kol hashshamayim veal haaretz, sheen kan guf kaddur hashshemesh bimtziut – nire kan haor vehazziv hazze leyesh mammash leen kol, venofel alav kan shem "yesh" beemet, ma-sheen-ken keshehu bimkoro beguf hashshemesh – en nofel alav shem "yesh" kelal, rak shem "ayin" vaefes", ki beemet, hu sham leayin vaefes mammash, sheen meir sham rak mekoro levaddo, shehu guf hashshemesh hammeir, veefes bilado.

Vechaddevarim haelle mammash, bidmutam ketzalmam, hem kol habberuim – legabbe shefa haelohi meruach piv, hashshofea alehem umehavve otam, vehu mekoram, vehem atzmam, enam, rak kemo or veziv mitpashshet min hashshefa veruach Adonai hashshofea umitlabbesh betocham umotziam meayin leyesh, velachen hem betelim bimtziut legabbe mekoram, kemo or hashshemesh shebbatel bimtziut venechshav leayin vaefes mammash, veeno nikra beshem "yesh" kelal keshehu bimkoro, rak tachat hashshamayim – sheen sham mekoro, kach kol habberuim, en nofel alehem shem "yesh" kelal, ella leene vasar shellanu, sheen anu roim umassigim kelal et hammakor, shehu ruach Adonai hamehavve otam, velachen nire leenenu gashmiyyut hannivraim vechumeram umammasham shehem yesh gamur, kemo shennire or hashshemesh yesh gamur kesheeno bimkoro.

Rak shebbaze, en hammashal dome lannimshal legamre lichora, shebbammashal, en hammakor bimtziut kelal bachalal haolam veal haaretz shennire sham oro leyesh gamur, ma-sheen-ken kol habberuim, hem bimkoram tamid, rak sheen hammakor nire leene vasar. velamma enan betelim bimtziut limkoram? ach lehavin ze – tzarich lehakedim:

Ki hinne ketiv: "ki shemesh umagen Adonai elohim", perush, "magen" – hu nartek lashshemesh, lehagen sheyyuchelu habberiyyot lesavlo, kemaamar rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha: "leatid lavo hakkadosh-baruch-hu motzi chamma minnartekah, reshaim niddonin bah kulei". uchemo shehannartek megin bead hashshemesh, kach shem "elohim" megin leshem havaya baruch-hu.

Deshem havaya, perusho – shemmehavve et hakkol meayin leyesh, vehayyud meshammeshet al happeulla shehi bilshon hove vetamid, kidferesh Rashi al pasuk: "kacha yaase iyyov kol hayyamim", vehayeynu – hachayyut hannishpa bechol rega mammash bechol habberuim mimmotza fi Adonai verucho, umehavve otam meayin leyesh bechol rega, ki lo day lahem bema shennivreu besheshet yeme vereshit lihyot kayyaymim baze, kemo shennitbaer leel.

Vehinne, besiddur shevachav shel hakkadosh-baruch-hu ketiv: "haggadol haggibbor kulei", uferush "haggadol" – hi middat chesed vehitpashshetut hachayyut bechol haolamot uveruim leen ketz vetachlit, lihyot beruim meayin leyesh vekayyaymim bechesed chinnam, venikret "gedulla", ki baa miggedullato shel hakkadosh-baruch-hu bichvodo uveatzmo, "ki gadol Adonai veligdullato en cheker", velachen mashpia gam ken chayyut vehithauut meayin leyesh leolamot uveruim en ketz, shetteva hattov lehetiv.

Vehinne, kemo shemmidda zo hi shevacho shel hakkadosh-baruch-hu levaddo, sheen bicholet shum nivra livro yesh meayin ulehachayoto, vegam, midda zo hi lemala mehasekalat kol habberuim vehassagatam, sheen koach besechel shum nivra lehasekil ulehassig midda zo vichaltah livro yesh meayin ulehachayoto, ki habberia yesh meayin hu davar shellemala missechel hannivraim, ki hi mimmiddat gedullato shel hakkadosh-baruch-hu, vehakkadosh-baruch-hu umiddotav – achdut pashut, kidita bazzohar hakkadosh deihu vegarmohi chad", ucheshem sheen bicholet shum sechel nivra lehassig boro, kach eno yachol lehassig middotav.

Uchemo sheen bicholet shum sechel nivra lehassig middat gedullato, shehi hayecholet livro yesh meayin ulehachayoto, kedichtiv: "olam chesed yibbane" – kach mammash en bichalto lehassig middat gevurato shel hakkadosh-baruch-hu, shehi middat hatztzimtzum umeniat hitpashshetut hachayyut miggedullato, millered ulehitgallot al hannivraim lehachayotam ulekayyeymam begilluy, ki im behester panim, shehachayyut mistatter beguf hannivra, ucheillu guf hannivra hu davar bifne atzmo, veeno hitpashshetut hachayyut veharuchaniyyut kehitpashshetut hazziv vehaor mehashshemesh, ella hu davar bifne atzmo.

Veaf shebbeemet, eno davar bifne atzmo, ella kemo hitpashshetut haor mehashshemesh, mikkol makom, hen hen gevurotav shel hakkadosh-baruch-hu, asher kol yachol, letzamtzem hachayyut veharuchaniyyut hannishpa meruach piv ulehastiro, shello yibbatel guf hannivra bimtziut.

Veze, en besechel shum nivra lehassig mahut hatztzimtzum vehahester, vesheyyihye af-al-pi-chen guf hannivra – nivra meayin leyesh, kemo sheen yecholet besechel shum nivra, lehassig mahut habberia meayin leyesh.

[Vehinne, bechinat hatztzimtzum vehester hachayyut – nikra beshem "kelim", vehachayyut atzmo – nikra beshem "or", shekkemo shehakkeli mechasse al ma shebbetocho, kach bechinat hatztzimtzum mechasse umastir haor vehachayyut hashshofea; vehakkelim – hen hen haotiyyot, sheshsharshan Adonai otiyyot 280, shehen Adonai gevurot hamechallekot umafridot hahevel vehakkol baAdonai motzaot happe lehithauot 22 otiyyot, veshoresh ha gevurot – hu "butzina dekardunita", shehi gevura illaa deattik yomin", veshoresh hachasadim – hu gam ken chesed deattik yomin", kayyadua leyode chen]:

Vehinne, al ze amru rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha: "bitchilla ala bemachashava livro et haolam bemiddat haddin, raa sheen haolam mitkayyem – shittef bo middat rachamim", dehayynu, hitgallut elohut al yede tzaddikim veotot umoftim shebbattora.

Vehinne al ze amru bazzohar, dilella, besitra dikdushsha illaa, it yemina veit semala", dehayynu, chesed ugevura, perush, dishtehen hen middot elohut lemala missechel hannivraim vehassagatam, "deihu vegarmohi chad" beolam haatzilut. veaf hassagat moshe rabbenu alav-hashshalom binvuato, lo hayta beolam haatzilut, ella al yede hitlabbeshuto beolam habberia. veaf gam zot, lo bishte middot ellu – chesed ugevura, ella al yede hitlabbeshutan bammiddot shellematta mehen bemadrega, shehen middot netzach-hod-yesod [kemo shekkatuv beshaar hannevua].

Rak shemmattan secharam shel tzaddikim began eden, hu hassagat hitpashshetut hachayyut veor hannimshach mishte middot ellu chesed ugevura, vehu – mezon nishmot hatztzaddikim sheasku battora lishmah baolam hazze. ki mehitpashshetut shete middot ellu, nimtach rakia al hanneshamot shebbegan eden, verakia ze nikra "raza deorayyta", uvo sod 22 otiyyot hattora, hannetuna mishte middot ellu, kedichtiv: "mimino esh dat lamo", umerakia ze, notef tal limzon hanneshamot, dehayynu, yediat sod 22 otiyyot hattora, ki harakia hazze – hu sod haddaat, vehattora – hi mezon hanneshamot began eden, vehammitzvot – hen levushim, kimvoar kol ze [bazzohar vayyakhel daf 209 very, uveetz chayyim shaar 44 perek 3]:

Vehinne, shem "elohim", hu shem middat haggevura vehatztzimtzum, velachen hu gam ken begimatriyya "hatteva", lefi shemmastir haor shellemala – hamehavve umechayye haolam, venire, keillu haolam omed umitnaheg bederech hatteva. veshem "elohim" ze, hu magen venartek leshem havaya, lehaalim haor vehachayyut hannimshach mishshem havaya umehavve meayin leyesh, shello yitgalle lannivraim vibbatlu bimtziut.
Vahare – bechinat gevura zo vetzimtzum hazze, hu gam ken bechinat chesed shehaolam yibbane bo, vezo hi bechinat gevura hakkelula bechesed.

Vehinne, mehitkallut hammiddot zo bazo, nire laayin deihu vegarmohi chad", shehen middotav, ki meachar shehen beyichud gamur immo, lachen hen mityaychadot zo bazo uchelulot zo mizzo, kemaamar eliyyahu: "veant hu dekashir lon umeyached lon vechulei, uvar minnach let yichuda beillae kulei".

Vezehu shekkatuv: "vahashevota el levavecha, ki Adonai hu haelohim", perush, sheshshene shemot ellu – hem echad mammash, sheggam shem "elohim" hammetzamtzem umaalim haor, hu bechinat chesed – kemo shem havaya, mishshum shemmiddotav shel hakkadosh-baruch-hu mityachadot immo beyichud gamur, vehu ushemo echad, shemmiddotav hen shemotav.

Veim ken, mimmela teda shebbashshamayim mimmaal veal haaretz mittachat – en od", perush, sheggam haaretz hachumerit shenniret yesh gamur leen kol, hi ayin vaefes mammash legabbe hakkadosh-baruch-hu, ki shem "elohim" eno maalim umetzamtzem ella lattachtonim, velo legabbe hakkadosh-baruch-hu, meachar shehu ushemo "elohim" – echad, velachen, gam haaretz umittachat laaretz hen ayin vaefes mammash legabbe hakkadosh-baruch-hu, veenan nikraot beshem kelal, afilu beshem "od" shehu leshon tafel, kemaamar rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha "yehuda veod likra", ucheguf shehu tafel lanneshama vechayyut shebbetocho [vezehu shekkatuv: "ahalla Adonai bechayyay, azammera lelohay beodi", shehachayyim nimshachim mishshem havaya, vehaod" shehu hagguf hattafel – mishshem "elohim"], lefi shehanneshama enah mehavva hagguf meayin leyesh, aval hakkadosh-baruch-hu hamehavve et hakkol meayin leyesh – hakkol batel bimtziut etzlo, kemo or hashshemesh bashshemesh.

Velachen hutzerach hakkatuv lehazehir "veyadata hayyom vahashevota el levavecha vegomer", shello taale al datecha shehashshamayim vechol tzevaam vehaaretz umeloah hem davar nifrad bifne atzmo, vehakkadosh-baruch-hu memalle kol haolam kehitlabbeshut hanneshama bagguf, umashpia koach hatztzomeach baaretz, vechoach hattenua baggalgallim, umeniam umanhigam kirtzono, kemo shehanneshama menia et hagguf umanhigato kirtzonah.

Ach beemet, en hammashal dome lannimshal kelal, ki hanneshama vehagguf hem beemet nifradim ze mizze besharsham, ki en hithauut shoresh hagguf veatzmuto – minnishmato, ella – mittippot aviv veimmo, vegam achare chen, en giddulo minnishmato levaddah, ella al yede achilat ushetiyyayt immo kol tisha chodashim, veachar kach al yede achilato ushetiyyayto beatzmo, ma-sheen-ken hashshamayim vehaaretz, shekkol atzmutam umahutam nithavva meayin vaefes hammuchelat – rak bidvar Adonai veruach piv yitbarech, vegam adayin nitztzav devar Adonai leolam, veshofea bahem tamid bechol rega, umehavve otam tamid meayin leyesh, kehithauut haor mehashshemesh betoch guf kaddur hashshemesh atzmo derech mashal, veim ken, hem betelim beemet bimtziut legamre legabbe devar Adonai veruach piv yitbarech, hameyuchadim bemahuto veatzmuto yitbarech kemo sheyyitbaer lekamman, kevittul or hashshemesh bashshemesh.

Rak shehen hen gevurotav, bemiddat haggevura vehatztzimtzum, lehasetir ulehaalim hachayyut hashshofea bahem, sheyyihyu nirim hashshamayim vehaaretz vechol tzevaam keillu hem davar bifne atzmo. ach en hatztzimtzum vehahester ella lattachtonim, aval legabbe hakkadosh-baruch-hu – "kulla kammeh kela mammash chashive", keor hashshemesh bashshemesh, veen middat haggevura masteret chas veshalom lefanav yitbarech, ki enenna davar bifne atzmo ella "Adonai hu haelohim":
Uvaze yuvan ma shekkatuv bazzohar hakkadosh, defasuk "shema yisrael" – hu "yichuda illaa", uvaruch shem kevod malchuto leolam vaed" – hu "yichuda tattaa", ki "vaed" hu "echad" bechillufe atvavn.

Ki hinne, sibbat vetaam hatztzimtzum vehahester hazze, shehistir veheelim hakkadosh-baruch-hu et hachayyut shel haolam kede sheyyihye haolam nire davar nifrad bifne atzmo, hinne hu yadua lakkol, ki tachlit beriat haolam hu bishvil hitgallut malchuto yitbarech, deen melech belo am", perush "am" – milleshon "ommot", shehem devarim nifradim vezarim urechokim mimmaalat hammelech, ki illu afilu hayu lo banim rabbim meod – lo shayyaych shem "melucha" alehem, vechen afilu al sarim levaddam, rak "berov am" – davvka – "haderat melech".

Veshem hammore al middat malchuto yitbarech, hu shem adnut, ki hu adon kol haaretz. venimtza, ki midda zo veshem ze – hen hammehavvin umekayyeymin haolam, lihyot olam kemot shehu achshav, yesh gamur vedavar nifrad bifne atzmo veeno batel bimtziut mammash, ki behistallekut midda zo veshem ze chas veshalom, haya haolam chozer limkoro bidvar Adonai veruach piv yitbarech, uvatel sham bimtziut mammash, velo haya shem "olam" alav kelal.
Vehinne, geder uvechinat shem "olam" nofel al bechinat makom uvechinat zeman davka. bechinat makom – hu: mizrach umaarav, tzafon, darom, mala umatta. bechinat zeman – avar, hove veatid.

Vehinne, kol bechinot ellu en lahen shayyaychut bammiddot hakkedoshot haelyonot, ki im bemiddat malchuto yitbarech levaddah, shayyaych lomar shehu yitbarech melech lemala ad en ketz ulematta ad en tachlit, vechen led sitrin, vechen bivchinat zeman – "Adonai melech, Adonai malach, Adonai yimloch" venimtza, shechayyut hammakom vechen chayyut hazzeman, vehithauutam meayin leyesh, vekiyyumam kol zeman kiyyumam, hu mimmiddat malchuto yitbarech veshem adnut baruch-hu.

Ulefi shemmiddat malchuto yitbarech meyuchedet bemahuto veatzmuto yitbarech betachlit hayyichud, kemo sheyyitbaer, hilkach, gam bechinat hammakom vehazzeman betelim bimtziut mammash legabbe mahuto veatzmuto yitbarech, kevittul or hashshemesh bashshemesh.

Vezehu shilluv shem adnut beshem havaya, ki shem havaya more shehu lemala min hazzeman, shehu haya hove veyihye berega echad kemo shekkatuv [beraya mehemna parashat pinchas], vechen lemala mibbechinat makom, ki hu mehavve tamid et kol bechinat hammakom kullo milmala ad lematta uled sitrin.

Vehinne, af-al-pi shehu yitbarech lemala mehammakom vehazzeman, af-al-pi-chen – hu nimtza gam lematta bemakom uzeman, dehayynu, shemmityayched bemiddat malchuto shemmimmenna nimshach venithavvev hammakom vehazzeman, vezehu yichuda tattaa [shilluv havaya beadnut baruch-hu], dehayynu, shemmahuto veatzmuto yitbarech, hannikra beshem "en-sof" baruch-hu – male et kol haaretz mammash bizman umakom, ki bashshamayim mimmaal uvaaretz uled sitrin, hakkol male meor-en-sof baruch-hu beshave mammash, ki kach hu baaretz mittachat kemo bashshamayim mimmaal mammash, ki hakkol hu bechinat makom – habbatel bimtziut beor-en-sof baruch-hu, hammitlabbesh bo al yede middat malchuto hameyuchedet bo yitbarech.

Rak, shemmiddat malchuto hi middat hatztzimtzum vehahester, lehasetir or-en-sof baruch-hu, shello yibbatlu hazzeman vehammakom mimmetziutam legamre, velo yihye shum bechinat zeman umakom bimtziut afilu lattachtonim.

Vehinne, bema shennitbaer, yuvan ma shekkatuv: "ani Adonai lo shaniti", perush, sheen shum shinnuy kelal, kemo shehaya levaddo kodem beriat haolam – kach hu levaddo achar shennivra. vezehu sheomrim: "atta hu ad shello nivra haolam, atta hu kulei", beli shum shinnuy beatzmuto, velo bedato, ki bidiat atzmo yodea kol hannivraim, shehakkol mimmennu uvatel bimtziut etzlo, uchemo shekkatav harambam zichrono livracha, shehu hayyodea, vehu hayyadua, vehu haddea atzmah – hakkol echad, vedavar ze en koach bappe leamro, velo baozen leshamo, velo belev haadam lehakkiro al bureyo".

Ki hakkadosh-baruch-hu, mahuto veatzmuto vedato – hakkol echad mammash mikkol tzad ufinna, bechol derech yichud, veen dato davar nosaf al mahuto veatzmuto, kemo shehu benefesh haadam, sheddatah davar nosaf al mahutah umurekav bah, shehare keshehaadam lomed veyodea eze davar – kevar hayta bo nafsho hammaskelet beterem shellamad veyada, veachar shellamad veyada – nittosfa yedia zo benafsho, vechen midde yom beyom – "yamim yedabberu, verov shanim yodiu chachma", veen zo achdut peshuta, ella murekevet.

Aval hakkadosh-baruch-hu – hu achdut pashut beli shum harekava vetzad ribbuy kelal. veim ken, al karchacha mahuto veatzmuto vedato – hakkol davar echad mammash, beli shum harekava. ulefichach, keshem shei efshar leshum nivra baolam lehassig mahut habbore veatzmuto, kach, i efshar lehassig mahut dato, rak lehaamin beemuna, shehi lemala mehassechel umehassaga, shehakkadosh-baruch-hu yachid umeyuchad – hu vedato hakkol echad mammash, uvidiat atzmo – makkir veyodea kol hannimtzaim elyonim vetachtonim, ad shilshul katan shebbayyam, vead yattush katan sheyyihye betabbur haaretz – en davar nelam mimmennu, veen yedia zo mosifa bo ribbuy veharekava kelal, meachar sheenah – rak yediat atzmo, veatzmuto vedato hakkol echad.

Ulefi shezze kashe meod letzayyer besichlenu, al ken amar hannavi: "ki gavhu shamayim mearetz – ken gavhu derachay middarchechem umachshevotay mimmachshevotechem", uchetiv: "hacheker eloah timtza vegomer", uchetiv: "haene vasar lach, im kirot enosh tire", shehaadam roe veyodea kol haddevarim bidia shechutz mimmennu, vehakkadosh-baruch-hu – bidiat atzmo. ad kan leshono.
[Ayyen sham behilchot yesode hattora. vehiskimu immo chachme hakkabbala, kimvoar bappardes meharamak zichrono livracha]:

Vehinne, mikkan yesh lehavin shiggat miktzat chachamim beenehem, Adonai yechapper baadam, sheshshagu vetau beiyyunam bechitve haari zichrono livracha, vehevinu inyan hatztzimtzum hammuzekar sham kifshuto, shehakkadosh-baruch-hu sillek atzmo umahuto chas veshalom meolam hazze, rak shemmashgiach milmala behashegacha feratit al kol hayetzurim kullam, asher bashshamayim mimmaal veal haaretz mittachat.

Vehinne, millevad shei efshar kelal lomar inyan hatztzimtzum kifshuto – shehu mimmikre hagguf – al hakkadosh-baruch-hu, hannivdal mehem ribbo rivvot havedalot ad en ketz; af gam zot, lo vedaat yedabberu, meachar shehem maaminim bene maaminim shehakkadosh-baruch-hu yodea kol hayetzurim shebbaolam hazze hashshafal umashgiach alehem, veal karchacha en yediato otam mosifa bo ribbuy vechiddush, mippene sheyyodea hakkol bidiat atzmo, hare kivyachol – mahuto veatzmuto vedato hakkol echad.

Vezehu shekkatuv battikkunim tikkun 57: "delet atar panuy mineh, la beillain vela betattain"; uveraya mehemna parashat pinchas: "ihu tafis bechulla velet man detafis beh kulei, ihu sovev kol almin kulei, velet man denafik mershuteh levar, ihu memalle kol almin kulei, ihu mekashsher umeyached zina lezineh ella vetatta, velet kureva bed yesodin, ella bekudesha-berich-hu kad ihu benayyhu", ad kan leshono.

Verotze lomar: "let man detafis beh" – sheen mi sheyyitpos behassagat sichlo mikkol sechalim haelyonim, bemahuto veatzmuto shel hakkadosh-baruch-hu, kemo shekkatuv battikkunim: "setima dechol setimin, velet machashava tefisa vach kelal". vegam battachtonim, af-al-gav deihu memalle kol almin, eno kenishmat haadam toch gufo, shehi nitpeset toch hagguf ad shemmitpaelet umekabbelet shinnuyim mishshinnuye hagguf vetzaaro, mehakkaot o kerirut o chamimut haesh vechayyotze, ma-sheen-ken behakkadosh-baruch-hu, sheeno mekabbel shum shinnuy mishshinnuye olam hazze, mikkayitz lechoref umiyyom lelayla, kedichtiv: "gam chshech lo yachshich mimmekka, velayla kayyom yair", lefi, sheeno nitpas kelal toch haolamot, af-al-gav dimmalle lon.

Vezehu gam ken inyan "sovev kol almin", perush, derech mashal, kesheadam mitbonen beeze devar chachma besichlo o davar gashmi bemachashavto, azay, sichlo umachashavto makkifim al haddavar hahu hametzuyyar bemachashavto o besichlo, ach en makkifim al haddavar hahu mammash – befoal mammash; aval hakkadosh-baruch-hu dichtiv beh "ki lo machshevotay machshevotechem vegomer", machashavto vidiato sheyyodea kol hannivraim, makkefet kol nivra venivra befoal mammash, shehare, hi hi chayyuto vehithauuto meayin leyesh befoal mammash.

Umemalle kol almin" – hi bechinat hachayyut hammitlabbeshet toch etzem hannivra, shehi metzumetzemet betocho betzimtzum rav, kefi erech mahut hannivra, shehu baal gevul vetachlit bechammuto veechuto, dehayynu – maalato vachashivuto. kegon hashshemesh, sheggufo yesh lo gevul vetachlit bechammuto, shehu kemo 167 peamim kegodel kaddur haaretz, veechuto umaalato, hu oro, gam ken yesh lo gevul ad kamma yuchal lehair, ki lo yair levilti tachlit, meachar shehu nivra, vechen kol hannivraim hem baale gevul vetachlit, ki mehaaretz larakia mahalach tk shana kulei.

Veim ken, hachayyut hamelubbeshet bahem, hi bivchinat tzimtzum rav veatzum, ki tzericha techilla lehittzamtzem tzimtzumim rabbim vaatzumim, ad sheyyithavve mikkochah veorah etzem hannivraim kemot shehem, baale gevul vetachlit.

Ki mekor hachayyut – hu ruach piv shel hakkadosh-baruch-hu hammitlabbesh baasara maamarot shebbattora, veruach piv yitbarech, haya yachol lehitpashshet leen ketz vetachlit, velivro olamot en ketz vetachlit lechammutam veechutam, ulehachayotam ade ad, velo haya nivra olam hazze kelal (shekkemo shehakkadosh-baruch-hu nikra "en-sof", kach kol middotav ufeullotav, deihu vegarmohi chad", hayeynu hachayyut hannimshechet mimmiddotav, shehen chesed verachamim ushear middotav hakkedoshot, al yede hitlabbeshutan shemmitlabbeshot beruach piv – "ki hu amar vayyehi", veolam" – al yede – "chesed yibbane" bidvar Adonai veruach piv, hannaase keli ulevush lechesed ze, kehaden kamtza dilvusheh minneh uveh").

Ella shetztzimtzem hakkadosh-baruch-hu haor vehachayyut, sheyyuchal lehitpashshet meruach piv, vehilbisho toch tzerufe otiyyot shel asara maamarot vetzerufe tzerufehen bechillufe utemurot haotiyyot atzman uvecheshbonan umisparan. shekkol chilluf utemura, more al yeridat haor vehachayyut mimmadrega lemadrega, dehayynu, sheyyuchal livro ulehachayot beruim shemadregot echutam umaalatam hi pechuta mimmadregot echut umaalat habberuim hannivraim meotiyyot vetevot atzman shebbaasara maamarot, shebbahen mitlabbesh hakkadosh-baruch-hu bichvodo uveatzmo – shehen middotav.

Vehacheshbon, more al miut haor vehachayyut, miut achar miut, ad shello nishar mimmennu ella bechina acharona, shehu bechinat hacheshbon umispar, kamma mine kochot umadregot kelulot beor vechayyut hazze hamelubbash betzeruf ze shel teva zo.

(Veachar kol hatztzimtzumim haelle vechayyotze vahen kaasher gazra chachmato yitbarech, hu shehaya yachol haor vehachayyut lehitlabbesh gam battachtonim, kemo avanim veafar haddomem, ki "even", derech mashal, shemah more, ki sharshah mishshem haole ban bemisparo, veod alef nosefet mishshem acher, letaam hayyadua leyotzrah. vehinne, shem ban beatzmo, hu beolamot elyonim meod, rak sheal yede tzimtzumim rabbim vaatzumim mimmadrega lemadrega, yarad mimmennu chayyut muat bimod meod, ad sheyyuchal lehitlabbesh beeven. vezo hi nefesh haddomem, hamechayya umehavva oto meayin leyesh bechol rega, uchemo shennitbaer leel. vezo hi bechinat "memalle kol almin", ma-sheen-ken bechinat "sovev kol almin").

Vechol koach umadrega, yachol livro beruim kefi bechinat madrega zo, gam ken leen ketz vetachlit bechammutam veechutam, lehachayot ade ad, meachar shehu koach Adonai hammitpashshet veneetzal meruach piv, veen maatzor kulei, ach shello yihye echutam bemaala gedola kol kach, keechut umaalat beruim sheyyuchelu lehibbarot mibbechinat koach umadregat haotiyyot atzman:

Vehinne, ma shekkatav harambam zichrono livracha shehakkadosh-baruch-hu mahuto veatzmuto vedato hakkol echad mammash, achdut peshuta velo murekevet kelal – ken hainyan mammash bechol middotav shel hakkadosh-baruch-hu, uvechol shemotav hakkedoshim vehakkinnuyim shekkinnu lo hanneviim vachachamenu-zichronam-livracha, kegon "channun" verachum" vechasid" vechayyotze vahen, vechen ma shennikra "chacham", dichtiv: "vegam hu chacham vegomer", vechen retzono "ki rotze Adonai et yereav" vechafetz chesed hu" verotze bitshuvatam shel reshaim veeno chafetz bemitatam uverishatam" utehor enayim merot bera", en retzono vechachmato umiddat chasdo verachamanuto ushear middotav mosifim bo ribbuy veharekava chas veshalom bemahuto veatzmuto, ella atzmuto umahuto uretzono vechachmato uvinato vedato, umiddat chasdo ugevurato, verachamanuto vetifarto hakkelula mechasdo ugevurato, vechen shear middotav hakkedoshot – hakkol achdut peshuta mammash, shehi hi atzmuto umahuto.

Uchemo shekkatav harambam zichrono livracha, sheddavar ze en koach bappe leamro, velo baozen leshamo, velo belev haadam lehakkiro al bureyo. ki haadam metzayyer besichlo kol hammusekalot sherotze lehasekil ulehavin – hakkol kemot shehem bo, kegon sherotze letzayyer besichlo mahut haratzon, o mahut chachma, o bina, o daat, o mahut middat chesed verachamim vechayyotze vahen, hu metzayyer kullan kemot shehen bo. aval beemet, hakkadosh-baruch-hu, hu ram venissa vekadosh shemo, kelomar, shehu kadosh umuvedal ribbo revavot ad en ketz vetachlit madregot havedalot, lemala mala meerech vesug umin kol hattishbachot vehammaalot sheyyuchelu hannivraim lehassig uletzayyer besichlam.

Ki hammaala umadrega harishona etzel hannivraim hi hachachma, shellachen nikret "reshit", ki beemet hi reshit umekor kol hachayyut bannivraim, ki mehachachma nimshachot bina vadaat, umehen nimshachot kol hammiddot shebbannefesh hammaskelet, kemo ahava vachesed verachamim vechayyotze bahen, vechannire bechush, shehakkatan sheen bo daat, hu bechaas tamid veachzari, vegam ahavato, hi lidvarim ketannim sheen rauy leahovam, mippene sheen bo daat leehov devarim haruyim leohovam, shehaahava kefi haddaat.

Umehammiddot shebbannefesh nimshachot bah tevot veotiyyot hammachashava, shehannefesh mechashshevet bedavar sheohevet, o ech lifol hachesed verachamim, vechen bishar middot. uvechol machashava shebbaolam – melubbeshet bah ezo midda hammevia lachashov machashava zo, umidda zo – hi chayyutah shel machashava zo. umeotiyyot hammachashava nimshachot otiyyot haddibbur, vehen chayyutan mammash. vehaddibbur mevi lide maase hatztzedaka vachesed, kegon hammelech shemmetzavve laavadav litten.

Vegam keshehaadam ose beatzmo eze davar, hare koach hannefesh vechayyutah hammitlabbesh baasiyya zo, hu keayin mammash legabbe koach hannefesh vechayyutah hammitlabbesh bedibbur haadam, ucheerech umeshal hagguf lanneshama, vechen erech otiyyot haddibbur leotiyyot hammachashava, vechen erech otiyyot hammachashava lemahut hammidda hamelubbeshet bah umechayya otah, vechen erech mahut vechayyut hammidda legabbe hachachma uvina vadaat, shekkelalutan hu hassechel shemmimmennu nimshecha midda zo.
Vechol ze benefesh haadam venefesh kol habberuim shebbechol haolamot elyonim vetachtonim, shebbechullam hachachma hi reshit umekor hachayyut:

Aval legabbe hakkadosh-baruch-hu, madregat hachachma, shehi techillat machashava vereshitah – hi sof maase etzlo, dehayynu, shennechshevet keillu hi bechinat umadregat asiyyay legabbe hakkadosh-baruch-hu, kedichtiv: "kullam bechachma asita".

Vehayeynu lomar, shekkeerech hachayyut shebbaasiyya gufanit vegashmiyyit leerech chayyut hachachma, shehi reshit umekor hachayyut baadam vechol habberuim gashmiyyim, shehu keayin legabbe chayyut shebbeotiyyot haddibbur, shehu keayin legabbe hachayyut shebbeotiyyot hammachashava, shehu keayin legabbe chayyut umaalat hammiddot shemmehen nimshecha machashava zo, shehu keayin legabbe chayyut umaalat umadregat hachachma bina vadaat mekor hammiddot, ken mammash, erech madregat umaalat hachachma, shehi reshit umekor hachayyut shebbechol haolamot – legabbe hakkadosh-baruch-hu bichvodo uveatzmo, hameromam vehammitnasse ribbo rivvot madregot rommut, yoter merommut madregat hachachma al bechinat chayyut shebbaasiyyay, shehi rommut chamesh madregot levad, shehen madregot vechinot asiyyay vedibbur umachashava umiddot vesechel. aval hakkadosh-baruch-hu, ram umitnasse mimmadregat hachachma – rivvot madregot kaellu ad en ketz.

Rak mippene sheen bannivraim koach lehassig rak hahishtalshelut mimmadregat chachma, shehi reshitam, lemadregat asiyya hashshefela, lechach anu omrim, shellegabbe hakkadosh-baruch-hu, nechshevet madregat hachachma kemadregat asiyya mammash.

Dehayynu lomar, shehu ram venissa venaale illuy rav meod meod mimmadregat hachachma, velo shayyaych kelal leyayches etzlo shum inyan hammityayches lechachma, afilu bederech maala veilluy rav, kegon lomar alav shei efshar leshum nivra elyonim vetachtonim lehassig chachmato o mahuto, ki inyan hahassaga mityayches venofel al devar chachma vasechel, lomar sheefshar lehassigo, o i efshar lehassigo mippene omek hammussag; aval hakkadosh-baruch-hu shehu lemala min hassechel vehachachma – lo shayyaych kelal lomar bo shei efshar lehassigo mippene omek hammussag, ki eno bivchinat hassaga kelal, vehaomer alav shei efshar lehassigo – hu keomer al ezo chachma rama vaamukka, shei efshar lemashsheshah beyadayim mippene omek hammussag, shekkol hashshomea yitzchak lo, lefi shechush hammishshush eno mityayches venofel ella al asiyyay gashmit hannitpeset beyadayim, vechacha mammash, nechshevet legabbe hakkadosh-baruch-hu madregat hassechel vehahassaga kaasiyyay gashmit mammash, vaafilu hassagat sechalim shebbeolamot elyonim, vaafilu madregat chachma illaa hamechayya et kullam, kedichtiv: "kullam bechachma asita".

Uma shehakkadosh-baruch-hu nikra "chacham" bakkatuv, vegam chachamenu-zichronam-livracha kinnu lo madregat umaalat hachachma, hayeynu, mishshum shehu mekor hachachma, shemmimmennu yitbarech nimshach veneetzal mahut madregat chachma illaa shebbeolam haatzilut. vechen "rachum" vechasid", al shem shehu mekor harachamim vehachasadim. vechen shear hammiddot, shekkullan nimshechu veneetzlu mimmennu yitbarech. vederech veinyan hahamshacha vehaatzilut ech uma, yadua lammaskilim

Haggaha
sod hatztzimtzum beor-en-sof baruch-hu, vetzimtzum adam kadmon, vesod haddikna, shessod kol hatztzimtzumim letzamtzem haor sheyyitlabbesh bivchinot kelim dey sefirot. vehinne, achar shennitlabbesh or-en-sof bivchinot kelim dechachma-bina-daat, az shayyaych lomar ma shekkatav harambam: "hu hayyodea, vehu hammadda, vehu hayyadua, uvidiat atzmo vechulei", lefi shebbechinot kelim daatzilut naﬠsim neshama vechayyut livria-yetziraﬠsiyya ulechol asher bahem. aval beli tzimtzum vehalebasha hannizkar lﬠyl lo shayyaych kelal lomar "hu hayyodeﬠ, vehu hammadda vechulei", ki eno bivchinat vegeder daﬠt umadda kelal chas veshalom, ella lemaﬠla maﬠla ﬠylluy rav ﬠd en ketz afilu mibbechinat vegeder chachma, ﬠd shebbechinat chachma nechshevet etzlo yitbarech kivchinat ﬠsiyya gashmit:

Vehinne, en lanu esek bannistarot, ach "hanniglot lanu", lehaamin emuna shelema deihu vegarmohi chad", dehayynu, middotav shel hakkadosh-baruch-hu uretzono vechachmato uvinato vedato im mahuto veatzmuto, hameromam levaddo rommut en ketz mibbechinat chachma vesechel vehassaga. velachen, gam yichudo shemmityayched im middotav sheheetzil meitto yitbarech, gam ken eno bivchinat hassaga lehassig ech mityayched bahen. velachen nikreu middotav shel hakkadosh-baruch-hu – shehen hassefirot – bazzohar hakkadosh: "raza dimhemnuta", shehi haemuna shellemala min hassechel:

Ach mikkol makom, hoil "vedibbera tora kilshon bene adam", "leshakkech et haozen ma shehi yechola lishmoa", lechach nittan reshut lechachme haemet ledabber bisfirot bederech mashal, vekaru otan "orot", kede sheal yede hammashal hazze yuvan lanu ketzat inyan hayyichud shel hakkadosh-baruch-hu umiddotav, shehu bederech mashal, keen yichud or hashshemesh shebbetoch guf kaddur hashshemesh im guf hashshemesh – shennikra "maor", kemo shekkatuv: "et hammaor haggadol vegomer", vehazziv vehannitzotz hammitpashshet umeir mimmennu – nikra "or", kemo shekkatuv: "vayyikra elohim laor yom", ucheshehaor hu bimkoro beguf hashshemesh – hu meyuchad immo betachlit hayyichud, ki en sham, rak etzem echad shehu guf hammaor hammeir, ki hazziv vehaor sham – etzem echad mammash im guf hammaor hammeir, veen lo shum metziut kelal bifne atzmo.

Vechaddevarim haelle mammash, veyoter mizze, hen middotav shel hakkadosh-baruch-hu uretzono vechachmato beolam haatzilut im mahuto veatzmuto kivyachol, hammitlabbesh betocham umityayched immahem betachlit hayyichud, meachar shennimshechu veneetzlu meitto yitbarech, al derech mashal kederech hitpashshetut haor mehashshemesh. ach lo mammash bederech ze, rak bederech rechoka veniflaa mehassagatenu, ki gavhu derachav midderachenu.

Umikkol makom, leshakkech haozen, nishma venitbonen mimmeshal or hashshemesh, hameyuchad uvatel bimkoro veeno ole beshem kelal bifne atzmo, rak shem hammakor levaddo – kach kol middotav shel hakkadosh-baruch-hu uretzono vechachmato, enan olot venikraot beshemot ellu kelal, ella legabbe hannivraim elyonim vetachtonim, shehavavyaytam vechayyutam vehanehagatam, shehakkadosh-baruch-hu mehavve umechayye otam umanhigam, hu birtzono vechachmato uvinato vedato hammitlabbeshot bemiddotav hakkedoshot, kidita bammidrash: "baasara devarim nivra haolam: bechachma, bitvuna uvedaat vechulei, dichtiv, 'Adonai bechachma yasad aretz, konen shamayim bitvuna, bedato tehomot nivkau vegomer". uchemaamar eliyyahu: "deappikat asar tikkunin, vekarinan lehon asar sefiran, leanhaga vehon almin setimin dela itgalyayn vealmin deitgalyayn, uvehon itkesiat kulei".

Al derech mashal, beyom rishon mishsheshet yeme vereshit – niglet middat hachesed, kelula mikkol middotav hakkedoshot, uretzono vechachmato uvinato vedato melubbashin bah, uvara vah et haor – bemaamar "yehi or", shehi bechinat hitpashshetut vehameshachat haor laolam milmala, vehitpashshetuto baolam missof haolam ad sofo, shehi bechinat middat chesed; rak mippene shekkelula gam mimmiddat gevura, lachen lo haya ruchani keor shel mala mammash, vegam nitlabbesh baolam hazze shehu bivchinat gevul vetachlit, shehu mahalach tk shana mehaaretz larakia umimmizrach lemaarav.

Vechen beyom sheni – niglet middat gevura, kelula mishshear middot, uretzono kulei, uvara vah harakia – bemaamar "yehi rakia betoch hammayim, vihi mavdil ben mayim lamayim", shehi bechinat tzimtzum ugevurot lehaalim mayim haelyonim haruchaniym mimmayim hattachtonim, veal yede ze, nitgashshemu hattachtonim behibbadlam mehaelyonim; umiddat chesed kelula bah, ki "olam chesed yibbane" shehakkol kede shetterae hayyabbasha veadam aleha laavod Adonai. vechen kullan.

Vezehu sheamar eliyyahu battikkunim sham: "leachazaa ech itnaheg alma betzedek umishpat kulei, tzedek ihu din, mishpat ihu rachame kulei, kolla leachazaa ech itnaheg alma, aval lav deit lach tzedek yedia deihu din, vela mishpat yedia deihu rachame, velav mikkol innun middot kelal":

Vehinne, gam asara maamarot, gam ken nikreu beshem "maamarot" legabbe hannivraim bilvad. ki kemo shehammiddot shebbenishmat haadam, keshebbaot lehitgallot bemaase, hen baot melubbashot beotiyyot hammachashava, kegon, middat chesed verachamim shebbanneshama, i efshar lavo lide hitgallut befoal mammash, ki im al yede shemmechashshev bedato umeharher maase hatztzedaka vachesed laasotah befoal mammash, ki i efshar laasot beli machashava, veim metzavve laacherim laasot, kemo hammelech, azay mitlabbeshet middat hachesed vegam otiyyot hammachashava – beotiyyot haddibbur [vechen keshemmedabber divre chesed verachamim lereehu]

Kach al derech mashal, middotav shel hakkadosh-baruch-hu, keshebbaot livchinat hitgallut peullatan battachtonim, nikra gilluy ze vehameshachat peulla zo – beshem "maamar" vetzeruf otiyyot", shehare i efshar shettihye shum peulla nimshechet mimmiddotav hakkedoshot beli tzerufim hannikraim beshem "otiyyot". kegon, livriat haor mimmiddat hachesed – nimshach mimmenna hameshachat peulla vechoach lifol velivro bo et haor, vehameshachat koach ze vechayyut zo, nikret beshem maamar veotiyyot "yehi or".

Ki af sheenan keotiyyot machashava shellanu chas veshalom, mikkol makom, hem inyan hammore al hithauut haor meayin leyesh, shellachen nivra haor mehameshachat koach ze, velo nivreu mimmennu devarim acherim shennivreu gam ken mimmiddat chesed, kemo mayim vechayyotze vahem, mippene shennitlabbeshu bahem kochot bivchinot tzerufim acherim, hammorim al hithauut hammayim vechayyotze.

Venimtza, ki kol chayyut vechochot hannimshachot mimmiddotav hakkedoshot lattachtonim levaram meayin leyesh ulehachayotam ulekayyeymam – nikraot beshem "otiyyot hakkedoshot", shehen bechinat hameshachat hachayyut mertzono vechachmato umiddotav lehithauut olamot ulehachayotam.

Vehem shene mine olamot: almin setimin dela itgalyayn, hem hammithavvim vechayyim vekayyaymim mikkochot vehameshachot nelamot, kemo otiyyot hammachashava shebbenishmat haadam al derech mashal; vealmin deitgalyayn", nivreu vechayyim mehitgallut shennitgallu kochot vehameshachot hannelamot, hannikraot beshem "otiyyot hammachashava", ucheshehen bivchinat hitgallut lehachayot almin deitgalyayn, nikraot beshem "maamarot" udevar Adonai" veruach piv", kemo otiyyot haddibbur baadam al derech mashal, shehen megallot lashshomim ma shehaya tzafun vesatum belibbo.

Aval beemet, bechinat otiyyot haddibbur shel mala – hi lemala mala mimmadregat umahut chachma vesechel hannivraim, shehare bemaamar veotiyyot "naase adam betzalmenu vegomer" – nivra haadam baal chachma vasechel, o afilu bahevel haelyon levad, kedichtiv: "vayyippach beappav nishmat chayyim", veim ken, haddibbur vehevel haelyon, hu mekor hachachma vehassechel shebbenishmat adam harishon, hakkolelet kol nishmot hatztzaddikim, shehem gedolim mimmalache hashsharet.

Vehayeynu, lefi sheotiyyot dibburo yitbarech hen bechinot hameshachot kochot vechayyut mimmiddotav yitbarech, hameyuchadot bemahuto veatzmuto betachlit hayyichud, shehu lemala mala leen ketz mimmadregat chachma shebbannivraim. velo nikreu beshem "otiyyot" legabbe hannivraim, ella legabbe middotav yitbarech bichvodan uveatzman.

Vehinne hen 22 mine hameshachot chayyut vechochot shonim ze mizze, shebbahen nivreu kol haolamot elyonim vetachtonim vechol habberuim shebbetocham, shekkach ala birtzono vechachmato yitbarech livro haolam bechv mine hameshachot shonot davka, lo fachot velo yoter. vehen hen 22 otiyyot hakkevuot befe velashon, keditnan besefer yetzira [utemunatan bichtav – hi mora al tziyyur hahamshacha, kemo sheyyitbaer lekamman] – sheggam otiyyot haddibbur vehammachashava shebbenefesh haadam, hen hameshachot mehassechel vehammiddot shebbannefesh, mimmahutan veatzmutan, kemo shennitbaer bemakom acher:

Rak shehabberuim mitchallekim leminehem bichlalut uvifratut, al yede shinnuye hatztzerufim vechillufim utemurot, kannizkar leel. ki kol ot, hi hameshachat chayyut vechoach meyuchad perati, ucheshennitztarfu otiyyot harebe – lihyot teva, azay, millevad ribbuy mine kochot vechayyut hannimshachim kefi mispar haotiyyot shebbatteva, od zot haola al kullana – hameshachat koach elyon vechayyut kelalit hakkolelet ushekula keneged kol mine hakkochot vehachayyut peratiyyot shel haotiyyot veola al gabbehen, vehi mechabbartan umetzaraftan yachad, lehashepia koach vechayyut laolam hannivra beteva zo, lichlalo velifratav.

Haggaha
ulefi shekkol ot vaot michv otiyyot hattora, hi hameshachat chayyut vechoach meyuchad perati sheeno nimshach beot acheret, lechach gam temunatan bichtav – kol ot hi bitmuna meyuchedet peratit, hammora ﬠl tziyyur hahamshacha vehitgallut haor vehachayyut vehakkoach hannigle venimshach beot zo, ech hu nimshach venitgalle mimmiddotav shel hakkadosh-baruch-hu uretzono vechachmato vechulei:

Kegon derech mashal, betevot shebbemaamar "yehi rakia vegomer", shennivreu bahen 7 rekiim vechol tzeva hashshamayim asher bahem, kemaamar rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha: "shechakim, shebbo rechayim omdot vetochanot man latztzaddikim vechulei, zevul, shebbo yerushalayim uvet hammikdash umizbeach vechulei, machon, shebbo otzrot sheleg veotzrot barad vechulei", shekkelalut harkiim nivreu vechayyim vekayyaymim bichlalut tevot ellu, shebbemaamar "yehi rakia vechulei", uferate habberuim shebbez rekiim – nivra kol perat mehem vechay vekayyaym meeze tzeruf otiyyot mittevot ellu, o chillufehen utemurotehen, shehen kefi bechinat chayyut hannivra happerati hahu.

Ki kol shinnuy tzeruf, hu harekavat vaarigat hakkochot vehachayyut beshinnuy, shekkol ot hakkodemet betzeruf – hi haggoveret vehi haikkar bivria zo, vehashshear – tefelot eleha venichlalot beorah, veal yede ze nivret beriyya chadasha. vechen bechillufe otiyyot o temurotehen, nivraot beriot chadashot pechute hammaala beerech hannivraim mehaotiyyot atzman.
