Ki hen derech mashal, dugemat or hammeir ballayla baaretz min hayyareach, veor hayyareach hu mehashshemesh, venimtza – or sheal haaretz hu or haor shel hashshemesh.

Vechacha mammash derech mashal, haotiyyot shebbammaamarot, hen kelalut hameshachat hachayyut vehaor vehakkoach mimmiddotav shel hakkadosh-baruch-hu livro haolamot meayin leyesh, ulehachayotan ulekayyeyman kol zeman meshech retzono yitbarech.

Umikkelalut hameshacha veheara gedola hazzo, heir Adonai vehimshich mimmenna toldoteha kayyotze vah, vaanafeha, shehen toldot vehameshachat haor mehaotiyyot, vehen hen chillufe otiyyot utemurotehen, uvara vahen beruim peratim shebbechol olam. vechen heir Adonai od, vehimshich vehorid heara deheara deheara mehearot haotiyyot. vechen himshich od, vehorid ad lematta matta bivchinat hishtalshelut, ad shennivra haddomem mammash kaavanim veafar, ushemotehen "even" veafar" hem chillufim dechillufim kulei utemurot ditmurot kulei, kannizkar leel:
Nishlam chelek sheni beezrat Adonai yitbarech veyitalle
Tanya, Part III; Iggeret HaTeshuvah 1: Tanya besof yoma: shelosha chilluke chappara hem, uteshuva im kol echad; avar al mitzvat ase veshav – eno zaz mishsham ad shemmochalin lo; avar al mitzvat lo taase veshav – teshuva tola, veyom hakkippurim mechapper.

(Perush, deaf-al-gav dilinyan kiyyum, mitzvat ase gedola, sheddocha et lo taase, hayeynu mishshum sheal-yede kiyyum mitzvat ase mamshich or veshefa beolamot elyonim mehearat or-en-sof baruch-hu (kemo shekkatuv bazzohar, deramach pikkudin innun ramach evarin demalka"), vegam al nafsho haelokit, kemo sheomrim: "asher kiddeshanu bemitzvotav"; aval leinyan teshuva, af shemmochalin lo haonesh al shemmarad bemalchuto yitbarech velo asa maamar hammelech, mikkol makom haor nedar vechulei.

Uchemaamar rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha al pasuk: "meuvvavt lo yuchal litkon" – "ze shebbittel keriat-shema shel arvit o vechulei", deaf shennizhar meatta likrot keriat-shema shel arvit veshacharit leolam, en teshuvato moelet letakken ma shebbittel paam achat;

Vehaover al mitzvat lo taase, al-yede shennidbak hara benafsho – ose pegam lemala besharshah umekor chutzebah (ballevushim dey sefirot daasiyya, kemo shekkatuv betikkune zohar: "levushin tekkinat lon, deminnayyhu parchin nishmatin livne nasha vechulei"), lechach, en kappara lenafsho velo lemala ad yom hakkippurim, kemo shekkatuv: "vechipper al hakkodesh mittumeot bene yisrael umippishehem vegomer", "lifne Adonai titharu" – "lifne Adonai" dayyka.

Velachen en lilmod mikkan shum kulla chas-veshalom bemitzvot ase, uvifrat betalmud tora, veadderabba, amru rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha: vitter hakkadosh-baruch-hu al avoda-zara vechulei, af shehen keretot umitot bet-din, velo vitter al bittul talmud tora).

Avar al keretot umitot bet-din – teshuva veyom hakkippurim tolin, veyissurin memarkin (perush, gomrin hakkappara, vehu milleshon merika ushetifa letzachtzeach hannefesh, ki, kappara hi leshon kinnuach, shemmekanneach lichluch hachet), shenneemar: "ufakadti veshevet pisham uvingaim avonam". ad kan leshon habbarayyta:

Vehinne, mitzvat hatteshuva min hattora, hi azivat hachet bilvad (kidita baggemara perek 3 desanhedrin uvechoshen-mishpat sof siman 34 leinyan edut), dehayynu, sheyyigmor belibbo belev shalem, leval yashuv od lechisla, limrod bemalchuto yitbarech, velo yaavor od mitzvot hammelech chas veshalom, hen bemitzvot ase hen bemitzvot lo taase.

Vezehu ikkar perush leshon "teshuva" lashuv el Adonai bechol libbo uvechol nafsho, leavdo velishmor kol mitzvotav, kemo shekkatuv: "yaazov rasha darko veish aven machshevotav, veyashov el Adonai vegomer"; uvefarashat nitztzavim ketiv: "veshavta ad Adonai elokecha veshamata vekolo vegomer, bechol levavcha vegomer", "shuva yisrael ad Adonai elokecha vegomer", "hashivenu Adonai elecha vegomer".

Velo kedaat hehamon, shehatteshuva hi hattaanit. vaafilu mi sheavar al keretot umitot bet-din, sheggemar kapparato hi al-yede yissurim, hayeynu, shehakkadosh-baruch-hu mevi alav yissurim (uchemo shekkatuv: "ufakadti veshevet vegomer" – "ufakadti" dayyka), vehayeynu, keshetteshuvato retzuya lefanav yitbarech, beshuvo el Adonai bechol libbo venafsho meahava, azay, beitaruta diltatta vekammayim happanim vechulei" – itaruta dilella, leorer haahava vechesed Adonai lemarek avono beyissurim baolam hazze, uchemo shekkatuv: "ki et asher yeehav Adonai yochiach vegomer".

Velachen lo hizkiru harambam vehassemag shum taanit kelal bemitzvat hatteshuva, af bichretot umitot bet-din, rak havvidduy uvakkashat mechila, kemo shekkatuv battora: "vehitvaddu et chattatam vegomer".

Uma shekkatuv beyoel: "shuvu aday bechol levavchem betzom uvivchi go", hayeynu – levattel haggezera shennigzera lemarek avon haddor al-yede yissurim baarbe. vezehu hattaam bechol taaniyyot shemmitannin al kol tzara shello tavo al hatztzibbur, uchemo shekkatuv bimgillat ester.

Uma shekkatuv besifre hammusar, uverosham sefer harokeach vesefer chasidim, harebe taaniyyot vesiggufim laover al keretot umitot bet-din, vechen lemotzi zera levattala, shechayyayv mita bide shamayim, kemo shekkatuv battora gabbe er veonan, vedino kechayyayve cheretot leinyan ze – hayeynu, kede linnatzel meonesh yissurim shel mala chas veshalom. vegam, kede lezarez ulemaher gemar kapparat nafsho. vegam ulay eno shav el Adonai bechol libbo venafsho meahava, ki im miyyira:
Tanya, Part III; Iggeret HaTeshuvah 2: Ach kol ze leinyan kappara umechilat heavon, shennimchal lo legamre ma sheavar al mitzvot hammelech kesheasa teshuva shelema, veen mazkirin lo davar vachatzi davar beyom haddin leansho al ze chas veshalom baolam-habba, veniftar legamre min haddin baolam-habba.

Amnam, sheyyihye leratzon lifne Adonai umerutztze vechaviv lefanav yitbarech kekodem hachet, lihyot nachat ruach lekono meavodato – haya tzarich lehavi karban ola afilu al mitzvat ase kalla sheen bah karet umitat bet-din, kemo sheddarshu rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha betorat kohanim al pasuk "venirtza lo"; vechidita baggemara perek kamma dizvachim, deola mechapperet al mitzvat ase, vehi doron leachar sheasa teshuva venimchal lo haonesh.

Ucheadam shessarach bammelech ufiyyeyso al-yede peraklitin umachal lo, af-al-pi-chen, sholeach doron umincha lefanav sheyyitratztze lo lirot pene hammelech (uleshon "mechapperet", vechen ma shekkatuv battora "venirtza lo lechapper alav" – en zo kapparat nafsho, ella lechapper lifne Adonai lihyot nachat ruach lekono, kidita sham baggemara, uchemo shekkatuv: "tamim yihye leratzon").
Veachshav, sheen lanu karban lehafik ratzon meAdonai – hattaanit hu bimkom karban, kemo shekkatuv baggemara "sheyyehe miut chelbi vedami shennitmaet – keillu hikravti lefanecha vechulei".

Velachen matzinu bechamma tannaim veamoraim, sheal davar kal hayu mitannim taaniyyot harebe meod, kemo rabbi elazar ben azarya, shehaya mattir shettehe para yotza birtzua shebben karneha beshabbat, vachachamim osrim, ufaam achat yatza ken parato shel shechento velo micha bah, vehushecharu shinnav mippene hatztzomot al shello kiyyem divre chaverav; vechen rabbi yehoshua, sheamar: "boshni middivrechem bet shammay", vehushecharu shinnav mippene hatztzomot; verav huna, paam achat nithappecha lo retzua shel tefillin, vehitanna 40 tzomot; vechahenna rabbot.

Veal yesod ze, limmed haarizal letalmidav al pi chachmat haemet, mispar hatztzomot lechamma avonot vachataim, af sheen bahen karet velo mita bide shamayim, kemo, al hakkaas – 151 taaniyyot vechulei; vaafilu al issur derabbanan, kemo setam yenam – yitanne 73 taaniyyot vechulei; vechen al bittul mitzvat ase derabbanan, kemo tefilla – yitanne sefer acher taaniyyot vechulei.

Vederech kelal, sod hattaanit hi segulla niflaa lehitgallut ratzon haelyon baruch-hu, kemo hakkarban, shenneemar bo: "reach nichoach laAdonai", uchemo shekkatuv bishaya: "halaze tikra tzom veyom ratzon laAdonai", mikkelal, shehatztzom hannirtze hu yom ratzon:
Tanya, Part III; Iggeret HaTeshuvah 3: Vehinne, chachme hammusar haacharonim nechleku bemi shechata chet echad peamim rabbot; deyesh omrim, shetztzarich lehitannot mispar hatztzomot leoto chet peamim rabbot kefi hammispar asher chata; kegon hammotzi zera levattala, shemmispar hatztzomot hameforash betikkune teshuva mehaarizal hen 84 taaniyyot, veim chata baze eser o esrim peamim, al derech mashal – tzarich lehitanot eser o esrim peamim 84, vechen leolam, dumeya dekarban chattat, shechayyayv lehavi al kol paam ufaam.
Veyesh medammin inyan ze lekarban ola habbaa al mitzvat ase, daafilu avar al kamma mitzvot ase – mitkapper beola achat, kidita baggemara perek kamma dizvachim.

Vehacheraa hamekubbelet baze, lehitannot 3 peamim kefi mispar hatztzomot dechet ze, dehayynu, 252 tzomot al hotzaot shichvat zera levattala, vechen bishar chataim vaavonot. vehattaam hu, al pi ma shekkatuv bazzohar hakkadosh sof parashat noach: "kevan dechav bar nash kamme kudesha-berich-hu zimna chada avid reshimu kulei, zimna telitaa itpashshet hahu kitma missitra da lesitra da kulei". lechach – tzarich mispar hatztzomot gam ken 3 peamim vechulei.

Achen, kol ze beadam chazak uvari, sheen ribbuy hatztzomot mazzik lo kelal livriut gufo, uchemo baddorot harishonim. aval mi sheribbuy hatztzomot mazzik lo, sheefshar sheyyuchal lavo lide choli o mechosh chas veshalom, kemo bedorotenu elle, asur lo leharebot betaaniyyot afilu al keretot umitot bet-din, umikkol shekken al mitzvot ase umitzvot lo taase sheen bahen karet, ella kefi asher yeshaer benafsho shebbevadday lo yazzik lo kelal.

Ki afilu baddorot harishonim, bime tannaim veamoraim – lo hayu mitannin bichhay gavna, ella habberiim, dematzu letzaure nafshayyhu; udela matzi letzaure nafsheh umitanne – nikra "chote" baggemara perek kamma detaanit, vaafilu mitanne al averot shebbeyado kidferesh Rashi sham, vechidita baggemara perek kamma dizvachim, sheen lecha adam miyyisrael sheeno mechuyyayv ase vechulei.
Umikkol shekken mi shehu baal tora, shechote veneenash bechiflayim, ki mechamat chalishut hattaanit lo yuchal laasok bah karauy.

Ella may takkanteh? kedichtiv: "vachataach betzidka feruk"; uchemo shekkatvu happoskim, litten bead kol yom taanit shel teshuva – erech 18 gedolim polish vechulei, veheashir yosif lefi ashro vechulei, kemo shekkatav hammagen-avraham hilchot taanit:

Umikkol makom, kol baal nefesh hechafetz kirvat Adonai, letakken nafsho lahashivah el Adonai bitshuva meulla min hammuvechar – yachmir al atzmo lehashelim al kol panim paam achat kol yeme chayyav mispar hatztzomot lechol avon veavon meavonot hachamurim shechayyayvin alehem mita al kol panim, vaafilu bide shamayim bilvad, kegon lehotzaot zera levattala 84 tzomot paam achat bime chayyav.

Veyachol lidchotan layyamim hakketzarim bachoref, veyitanne keeser taaniyyot al derech mashal bechoref echad, o pachot, veyigmor mispar hafd tzomot bet shanim, o yoter – kefi chocho (vegam, yachol leechol meat keg shaot lifne netz hachamma, veaf-al-pi-chen nechshav letaanit im hitna ken).

Uletashlum 252 tzomot kannizkar leel – yitanne od 4 peamim 84 ad achar chatzot hayyom bilvad, demichshav gam ken taanit birushalmi, uv chatzae yom nechshavim lo leyom echad leinyan ze. vechen lishar avonot kayyotze vahen, asher kol "lev yodea marat nafsho", vechafetz behitztzadkah:

Achen, mispar hatztzomot haodfim al 252 uchehay gavna, shehaya tzarich lehitannot, lachush ledaat hammachmirim lehitannot mispar hatztzomot sheal kol chet vechet kefi mispar happeamim shechata kannizkar leel, yifde chullan bitzdaka erech 18 gedolim polish bead kol yom. vechen shear kol taaniyyot shetztzarich lehitannot al averot sheen bahen mita, vaafilu al bittul mitzvot ase deorayyta uderabbanan, vetalmud tora keneged kullam, kefi hammispar hameforash betikkune hatteshuva mehaari zichrono livracha (verubbam nizkarim bemishnat chasidim" bemassechet hatteshuva) – hakkol kaasher lakkol, yifde bitzdaka kannizkar leel, i la matzi letzaure nafsheh kannizkar leel.

Veaf sheyyaale lesach mesuyyaym, en lachush mishshum "al yevazbez yoter mechomesh", dela mikre bizbuz bichhay gavna, meachar sheose lifdot nafsho mittaaniyyot vesiggufim. vela gara merfuat hagguf ushear tzerachav.

Ulefi shemmispar hatztzomot hammuzekarim betikkune teshuva hannizkarim leel rabbu bimod meod, lachen nahagu achshav kol hacharedim lidvar Adonai, leharebot meod meod bitzdaka, mechamat chalishut haddor, dela matzu letzaure nafsham kulle hay (uchemo shennitbaer bemakom acher al pasuk: "chasde Adonai ki lo tamnu"):
Tanya, Part III; Iggeret HaTeshuvah 4: Veulam, kol hannizkar leel, hu ligmar hakkappara umeruk hannefesh laAdonai achar hatteshuva, kemo shennitbaer leel mehaggemara perek kamma dizvachim, deola, doron hi leachar sheritztza happeraklit vechulei. amnam, hatechalat mitzvat hatteshuva veikkarah, lashuv ad Adonai beemet uvelev shalem, hahechreach levaer hetev beharechavat habbeur.

Behakedim ma shekkatuv bazzohar hakkadosh beveur millat "teshuva" al derech hassod: "tashuv Adonai", Adonai tattaa – "teshuva tattaa", Adonai illaa – "teshuva illaa". vegam, ma shekkatuv bazzohar hakkadosh biktzat mekomot, sheen teshuva moelet lefogem berito umotzi zera levattala, vehu davar tamuah meod, sheen lecha davar omed bifne hatteshuva" vaafilu avoda-zara vegilluy-arayot vechulei. uferesh bereshit chachma", shekkavvanat hazzohar sheen moelet teshuva tattaa, ki im teshuva illaa vechulei.

Hinne, lehavin zot meat mizzeer, tzarich lehakedim ma shemmevoar mehakkatuv umiddivre rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha inyan hakkaret umita bide shamayim, kesheavar avera shechayyayvim aleha karet – haya met mammash kodem chamishshim shana, uvemita bide shamayim – met mammash kodem shishshim shana, kachananya ben azzur hannavi beyirmeya (velifamim, gam bemita bide shamayim nifrain lealtar, kemo shemmatzinu beer veonan). vahare, nimtzeu bechol dor kamma vechamma chayyayve keretot umitot, veheerichu yemehem ushenotehem banneimim?

Ach hainyan yuvan, al pi ma shekkatuv: "ki chelek Adonai ammo vegomer", chelek mishshem havaya baruch-hu, kedichtiv: "vayyippach beappav nishmat chayyim", uman denafach mittocho nafach vechulei". veaf sheen lo demut hagguf vechulei" chas veshalom, ach "dibbera tora kilshon bene adam".

Ki kemo sheyyesh hefresh vehevdel gadol baadam hattachton, al derech mashal, ben hahevel sheyyotze mippiv bedibburo lahevel hayyotze al-yede neficha, shebbayyotze bedibburo – melubbash bo koach vechayyut meat mizzeer, vehu bechinat chitzoniyyut minnefesh hachayya shebbekirbo, aval bayyotze bechoach hannofeach, demittocho nafach – melubbash bo koach vechayyut penimit mibbechinat hannefesh hachayya vechulei.

Kacha mammash al derech mashal, hammavdil havedalot leen ketz, yesh hefresh atzum meod lemala, ben kol tzeva hashshamayim, vaafilu hammalachim, shennivreu meayin leyesh, vechayyim vekayyaymim mibbechinat chitzoniyyut hachayyut vehashshefa shemmashpia en-sof baruch-hu lehachayot haolamot, uvechina zo nikret beshem "ruach piv" al derech mashal, kemo shekkatuv: "uveruach piv kol tzevaam", vehi bechinat chayyut hamelubbeshet baotiyyot shebbaasara maamarot (shehen bechinat kelim vehameshachot vechulei, kemo shennitbaer belikkute-amarim chelek 2 perek 11); uven nishmat haadam, shennimshecha techilla mibbechinat penimiyyut hachayyut vehashshefa shemmashpia en-sof baruch-hu, kemo shekkatuv: "vayyippach vechulei", veachar kach yarda beseter hammadrega, gam ken, al-yede bechinat haotiyyot shebbemaamar "naase adam" vechulei kede lehitlabbesh beguf olam hazze hattachton.

Velachen nikreu hammalachim beshem "elokim" bakkatuv, uchemo shekkatuv: "ki Adonai elokechem [hu] eloke haelokim go" "hodu leloke haelokim go" "vayyavou bene haelokim lehityaytztzev go" – lefi sheyyenikat chayyutam hi mibbechinat chitzoniyyut shehi bechinat haotiyyot levad, veshem elokim hu bechinat chitzoniyyut legabbe shem havaya baruch-hu.
Aval nishmat haadam, shehi mibbechinat penimiyyut hachayyut – hi chelek shem havaya baruch-hu, ki shem havaya more al penimiyyut hachayyut, shehi lemala mala mibbechinat haotiyyot.

Uveur hainyan, kannoda mimmaamar eliyyahu: "ant hu deappikat asar tikkunin, vekarinan lehon asar sefiran, leanhaga vehon almin setimin vechulei. vechol hay sefirot nichlalot venirmazot beshem havaya baruch-hu.

Ki hayyud, shehi bechinat nekudda levad, merammezet lechachmato yitbarech, shehi bivchinat helem vehester kodem shebbaa livchinat hitpashshetut vegilluy hahassaga vehahavana (vehakkotz sheal hayyud romez livchinat ratzon haelyon baruch-hu, shellemala mala mimmadregat bechinat chachma illaa, kannoda).

Veachar shebbaa livchinat hitpashshetut vegilluy hahassaga vehahavana lealmin setimin nichlelet venirmezet beot hei, sheyyesh lah bechinat hitpashshetut larochav, hammore umerammez al harechavat habbeur vehahavana, vegam laorech, hammore al bechinat hahamshacha vehahashpaa milmala lematta lealmin setimin.

Veachar kach, keshennimshechet hameshacha vehashepaa zo yoter lematta lealmin deitgalyayn, uchemo haadam sherotze legallot chachmato laacherim al-yede dibburo al derech mashal – nichlelet venirmezet hameshacha zo beotiyyot 11.

Ki havvav mora al hahamshacha milmala lematta. vegam hameshacha zo hi al-yede middat chasdo vetuvo ushear middotav hakkedoshot, hannichlalot bederech kelal bemispar shesh, shebbappasuk: lecha Adonai haggedulla vechulei" ad "lecha Adonai hammamlacha vechulei", velo "ad" bichlal. ki middat malchuto yitbarech nikret beshem "devar Adonai", kemo shekkatuv: "baasher devar melech shilton".

Venichlelet venirmezet beot hei acharona shel shem havaya, ki penimiyyut umekor haddibbur, hu hahevel haole min hallev umitchallek laAdonai motzaot happe: 84 mehaggaron vechulei, vegam havarat hahe hi bechinat hevel levad, kemo shennikret: "ata kallila delet bah meshasha".

Veaf sheen lo demut hagguf chas veshalom, ach dibbera tora kilshon bene adam, besheggam, sheggam "devar Adonai" – 22 otiyyot, hammitchallekot laAdonai chelke hammotzaot, uvahen nivra kol hayetzur (uchemo shennitbaer belikkute-amarim chelek 2 perek 11, beur inyan otiyyot ellu).

Vechacha mammash al derech mashal, hammavdil havedalot leen ketz, benishmat haadam, shehi bechinat nefesh haelokit – demittocheh nafach, yesh bah bechinat sechel hannelam, hamerummaz beot yod, shebbechocho latzet el haggilluy, lehavin ulehaskil baamittato yitbarech uvigdullato vechulei, kol chad vechad lefum shiura dileh, lefi rochav sichlo uvinato.

Uchefi asher maamik sichlo umarchiv dato uvinato lehitbonen bigdullato yitbarech, azay – merummezet binato beot hei, sheyyesh lah rochav, vegam orech, hammore al hahamshacha milmala lematta, leholid mibbinato vehitbonnuto bigdullat Adonai ahava veyira vetoldotehen bemocho vetaalumot libbo, veachar kach – bivchinat hitgallut libbo.
Umizze nimshecha avoda haamittit beesek hattora vehammitzvot, bekol vedibbur o maase, hen otiyyot vav hei vechulei.
Vegam hahitbonnut lehavin ulehaskil baamittato ugedullato yitbarech, nimshecha gam ken mehattora, deorayyta mechachma nafka, hi bechinat yod shel shem havaya vechulei:
Tanya, Part III; Iggeret HaTeshuvah 5: Vehinne, hameshachat viridat hannefesh haelokit laolam hazze lehitlabbesh beguf haadam, nimshecha mibbechinat penimiyyut umekor haddibbur, hu hevel haelyon, hamerummaz beot hei tattaa kannizkar leel, uchemo shekkatuv: "vayyippach beappav nishmat chayyim, vayhi haadam lenefesh chayya", uman denafach vechulei".
Vezehu shekkatuv: "ki chelek Adonai ammo, yaakov chevel nachalato", perush, kemo chevel, al derech mashal, sherosho echad kashur lemala vekatzehu lematta.

Ki hinne, peshat hakkatuv ma shekkatuv "vayyippach", hu lehorot lanu, kemo sheal derech mashal keshehaadam nofeach leeze makom, im yesh eze davar chotzetz umafsik bentayim en hevel hannofeach ole umaggia kelal leoto makom, kacha mammash, im yesh davar chotzetz umafsik ben guf haadam livchinat hevel haelyon.

Ach beemet, en shum davar gashmi veruchani chotzetz lefanav yitbarech, ki "halo et hashshamayim veet haaretz ani male", umelo chol haaretz kevodo", velet atar panuy minneh", "bashshamayim mimmaal veal haaretz mittachat en od", veihu memalle kol almin vechulei".

Ella kemo shekkatuv bishaya: "ki im avonotechem hayu mavdilim benechem leven elokechem". vehattaam, lefi shehem neged ratzon haelyon baruch-hu hamechayye et hakkol, kemo shekkatuv: "kol asher chafetz Adonai asa bashshamayim uvaaretz" (uchemo shennitbaer leel, shehu mekor hashepaat shem havaya, venirmaz bekotzo shel yod).

Vezehu inyan hakkaret, shennichrat venifsak chevel hahamshacha mishshem havaya baruch-hu, shennimshecha mehe tattaa kannizkar leel, uchemo shekkatuv befarashat emor: "venichreta hannefesh hahi millefanay, ani Adonai" – "millefanay" dayyka.
Uvishar averot sheen bahen karet – al kol panim hen pogmin hannefesh, kannoda; ufegam, hu milleshon pegimat hassakkin.

Vehu al derech mashal, mechevel av shazur mittaryag chavalim dakkim, kacha chevel hahamshacha hannizkar leel – kalul mittaryag mitzvot, uchesheover chas veshalom al achat mehenna – nifsak chevel haddak vechulei.

Ach gam bechayyayv karet umita nishar adayin bo harshimu minnafsho haelokit, veal-yede ze yachol lichyot ad 50 o 60 shana velo yoter (uma shekkatuv beshem haarizal shennichnesa bo bechinat hammakkif vechulei – eno inyan lechayye gashmiyyut hagguf, umayyri ad 50 shana, o bizman hazze – kedilkamman):
Tanya, Part III; Iggeret HaTeshuvah 6: Amnam, zehu bizman shehayu yisrael bemadrega elyona, keshehayta hashshechina shora beyisrael bevet hammikdash, veaz, lo hayu mekabbelim chayyut legufam, rak – al-yede nefesh haelokit levaddah, mibbechinat penimiyyut hashshefa shemmashpia en-sof baruch-hu al-yede shem havaya baruch-hu, kannizkar leel.

Ach leachar sheyyardu mimmadregatam, vegarmu bemaasehem sod galut hashshechina, kemo shekkatuv: "uvefishechem shullecha immechem", dehayynu, sheyyarda hashepaat bechinat hei tattaa hannizkeret leel, venishtalshela mimmadrega lemadrega lematta matta, ad shennitlabbesha hashepaatah bey sefirot denoga, hammashpiot shefa vechayyut al-yede hammazzalot vechol tzeva hashshamayim vehassarim shealehem, lechol hachay haggashmi shebbaolam hazze, vegam lechol hatztzomeach, kemaamar rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha: "en lecha kol esev millematta sheen lo mazzal vechulei".
Vaazay, yachol gam hachote ufoshe yisrael lekabbel chayyut legufam venafsham habbahamiot kemo shear baale chayyim mammash, kemo shekkatuv: "nimshal kabbehemot nidmu".

Veadderabba, beyeter seet veyeter oz, al pi hamevoar mizzohar hakkadosh parashat pekude, shekkol shefa vechayyut hannishpaot laadam hattachton beshaa verega sheose hara beene Adonai bemaase o bedibbur o behirhure avera vechulei, hakkol nishpa lo mehechlot hassitra ochora hamevoarim sham bazzohar hakkadosh.
Vehaadam hu baal bechira, im lekabbel hashepaato mehechlot hassitra ochora, o mehechlot hakkedushsha shemmehem nishpaot kol machashavot tovot ukedoshot vechulei.

Ki "ze leummat ze asa haelokim" vechulei. vehechlot hassitra ochora mekabbelim veyonkim chayyutam mehitlabbeshut vehishtalshelut hashshefa dey sefirot denoga, hakkelula mibbechinat tov vara, hi bechinat "etz haddaat" vechulei, kannoda leyode chen.

Vehinne, "yaakov chevel nachalato" ketiv: al derech mashal, kemo hachevel sherosho echad lemala verosho hashsheni lematta, im yimshoch adam berosho hashsheni – yenaanea veyimmashech acharav gam rosho harishon kamma sheefshar lo lehimmashech.

Vechacha mammash beshoresh nishmat haadam umekorah mibbechinat hei tattaa hannizkeret leel, hu mamshich umorid hashepaatah al-yede maasav haraim umachshevotav ad toch hechlot hassitra ochora kivyachol, shemmishsham mekabbel machshevotav umaasav. umippene shehu hu hammamshich lahem hahashpaa, lachen hu notel chelek barosh, veday lamevin.

Vezehu sheamru rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha: "en beyadenu lo mishshalvat harshaim vechulei" – "beyadenu" davka, kelomar, bizman haggalut achar hachureban. vezohi bechinat galut hashshechina kivyachol, lehashepia lehechlot hassitra ochora asher sana nafsho yitbarech.
Ucheshehaadam ose teshuva nechona – azay mesallek mehem hahashpaa shehimshich bemaasav umachshevotav, ki bitshuvato machazir hashepaat hashshechina limkomah.
Vezehu tashuv hei tattaa – mibbechinat galut, uchemo shekkatuv: "veshav Adonai elokecha et shevutecha", kelomar im shevutecha, uchemaamar rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha: "veheshiv lo neemar vechulei":
Tanya, Part III; Iggeret HaTeshuvah 7: Veulam, derech haemet vehayyashar livchinat teshuva tattaa, hei tattaa hannizkeret leel – hem 2 devarim derech kelal.

Haechad, hu leorer rachamim haelyonim mimmekor harachamim al nishmato venafsho haelokit, shennafla "meiggera rama" – chayye hachayyim baruch-hu levira amikta", hen hechlot hattumea vehassitra ochora, veal mekorah bimkor hachayyim, hu shem havaya baruch-hu; uchemo shekkatuv: "veyashov el havaya virachamehu", perush, leorer rachamim al hashepaat shem havaya baruch-hu, shennishtalshela veyarda toch hechlot hassitra ochora hattemeim lehachayotam, al-yede maase enosh vetachbulotav, umachshevotav haraot; uchemo shekkatuv: "melech asur barhatim" – birhite mocha vechulei hi bechinat galut hashshechina, kannizkar leel.
Uzeman hamesuggal laze, hu betikkun chatzot, kemo shekkatuv bassiddur beheara, ayyen sham baarichut. vezehu shekkatuv sham: "nafla ateret roshenu, oy na lanu ki chatanu".

Velachen nikra hakkadosh-baruch-hu "melech aluv" befirke hechalot, kemo shekkatav haramak zichrono livracha, ki en lecha elbon gadol mizze, uvifrat kaasher yitbonen hammaskil bigdullat en-sof baruch-hu, memalle kol almin vesovev kol almin, kol echad veechad lefi shiur sichlo vahavanato, yitmarmer al ze meod meod.

Vehav, levattesh ulehachnia hakkelippa vesitra ochora, asher kol chayyutah hi rak bechinat gassut vehagebaha, kemo shekkatuv: "im tagbiah kannesher vegomer", vehabbittush vehahachnaa ad afar mammash – zohi mitatah uvittulah.

Vehayeynu, al-yede "lev nishbar venidke", velihyot "nivze veenav nimas" vechulei, uchemo shekkatuv bazzohar hakkadosh al pasuk: "zivche elokim ruach nishbara, lev nishbar venidke vechulei", ki kol karban min habbehema – hu leshem havaya, hi middat harachamim, aval leshem elokim, hi middat haddin – en makrivin karban behema, ki im leshabber ulehaavir ruach hattumea vehassitra ochora, vezehu "ruach nishbara".
Vehaech nishbera ruach hassitra ochora? keshehallev nishbar venidke" vechulei.

Vehaech nishbar hallev venidke? hinne, meat mizzeer hu al-yede siggufim vetaaniyyot, bedorotenu elle sheen lanu koach lehitannot harebe kedavid hammelech, kemaamar rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha al pasuk: "velibbi chalal bekirbi" – sheharago betaanit".

Ach ikkar hachenaat hallev, lihyot nishbar venidke vehaavarat ruach hattumea vesitra ochora, hu lihyot mimmare dechushebana" beomek haddaat, lehaamik dato uvinato shaa achat bechol yom o layla lifne tikkun-chatzot, lehitbonen bema sheppaal veasa bachataav bechinat galut hashshechina kannizkar leel, vegaram laakor nishmato venafsho haelokit mechayye hachayyim baruch-hu, vehoridah limkom hattumea vehammavet, hen hechlot hassitra ochora, venaaset bivchinat merkava alehem lekabbel mehem shefa vechayyut lehashepia legufo, kannizkar leel.

Vezehu sheamru rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha: "reshaim bechayyehem keruyim metim", kelomar, shechayyehem nimshachim mimmekom hammavet vehattumea, (vechen ma shekkatuv: "lo hammetim yehallu vegomer", eno keloeg larash" chas veshalom ella hakkavvavna al harshaim shebbechayyehem keruyim metim, shemmevalbelim otam bemachashavot zarot beodam berisham veenam chafetzim bitshuva, kannoda).

Veaf mi shello avar al avon karet, vegam lo al avon mita bide shamayim shehu hotzaat zera levattala uchehay gavna, ella shear averot kallot, af-al-pi-chen, meachar shehen pogmim banneshama venefesh haelokit, vechimshal pegimat ufesikat chavalim dakkim kannizkar leel, hare beribbuy hachataim yachol lihyot pegam kemo belav echad sheyyesh bo karet o mita, vaafilu bichfilat chet echad peamim rabbot meod.

Kemo shehimshil hannavi hachataim leanan hammaafil or hashshemesh, kemo shekkatuv: "machiti chaav peshaecha" – hem averot chamurot, [hammavdilim] ben penimit hashepaat shem havaya baruch-hu lannefesh haelokit, kehavedalat anan av vechashuch, hammavdil ben hashshemesh laaretz veladdarim aleha al derech mashal: vecheanan chattotecha hen "averot kallot sheadam dash baakevav", hammavdilim kehavedalat anan kal vekalush al derech mashal.

Vehinne, kemo shebbammashal hazze, im mesim adam neged or hashshemesh bachallon mechitzot kallot ukelushot larov meod, hen maafilot kemo mechitza achat ava veyoter – vechacha mammash hu bannimshal bechol avonot sheadam dash baakevav. umikkol shekken hamefuresamot middivre rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha, shehen mammash kaavoda-zara vegilluy-arayot ushefichut-damim.

Kemo haalamat ayin min hatztzedaka, kemo shekkatuv: "hishshamer lecha pen yihye davar im levavcha veliyyaal vegomer", uveliyyaal", hi oved avodat elilim vechulei, vehamesapper bignut chavero, hi lashon hara, hashshekula kaavoda-zara vegilluy-arayot ushefichut-damim, vechol hakkoes keillu oved avoda-zara, vechen mi sheyyesh bo gassut haruach, vechahenna rabbot baggemara. vetalmud tora keneged kullan, kemaamar rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha: "vitter hakkadosh-baruch-hu al avoda-zara vechulei".

Velachen sidderu bikriat-shema sheal-hammitta, lekabbel alav 4 mitot bet-din vechulei. millevad, sheal pi hassod, kol happogem beot yod shel shem havaya – keillu nitchayyev sekila, vehappogem beot hei – keillu nitchayyev serefa, uveot vav – keillu nitchayyev hereg, uveot hei acharona – keillu nitchayyev chenek: vehamevattel keriat-shema – pogem beot yod, utefillin – beot hei, vetzitzit – beot vav, utefilla – beot hei vechulei.
Umizze yachol hammaskil lilmod lishar avonot vachataim, uvittul tora keneged kullan:
Tanya, Part III; Iggeret HaTeshuvah 8: Vehinne, achare haamakat haddaat bechol hannizkar leel, yuchal levakkesh beemet, meumeka delibba "kerov rachamecha meche feshaay vegomer". ki azay tikkava belibbo beemet godel harachamanut al bechinat elokut shebbenafsho veshellemala, kannizkar leel. uvaze – yeorer rachamim haelyonim mig middot harachamim, hannimshachot meratzon haelyon baruch-hu, hannirmaz bekotzo shel yod, shellemala mala mibbechinat hahashpaa hannishpaat meotiyyot shem havaya.

Velachen hayg middot harachamim menakkim kol happegamim, uchemo shekkatuv: "nose avon vafesha venakke", veshuv en yenika lehachitzonim vehassitra ochora mehashepaat hei tattaa, kannizkar leel (uvaze tashuv hei tattaa limkomah, lehityayched beyhv, veday lamevin).

Vechen mammash lematta bannefesh haelokit shebbaadam, shuv en "avonotechem mavdilim", uchemo shekkatuv "venakke" – "menakke hu lashshavim", lirchotz ulenakkot nafsham millevushim hatztzoim, hem hachitzonim vesitra ochora, kemo shekkatuv baggemara "melappafto vechulei".

Umeachar sheruach avra vattetaharem", azay tuchal nafsham lashuv ad havaya baruch-hu mammash, velaalot mala mala limkorah, uledavka bo yitbarech beyichud nifla, kemo shehayta meyuchedet bo yitbarech betachlit hayyichud, beterem shennefachah beruach piv yitbarech lered lematta ulehitlabbesh beguf haadam (uchemo al derech mashal, beadam hannofeach beruach piv, beterem sheyyotze haruach mippiv – hu meyuchad benafsho). vezo hi teshuva shelema.

Vehinne, bechinat yichud ze uteshuva zo, hi bechinat teshuva illaa shelleachar teshuva tattaa, uchemo shekkatuv bazzohar hakkadosh beraya mehemna parashat naso, ditshuva illaa hi, deyitassek beorayyta bidchilu urechimu dekudesha-berich-hu vechulei, deihu ben 15 – bina vechulei (umaalat baale teshuva al tzaddikim gemurim baze hi, kemo shekkatuv bazzohar hakkadosh parashat chayye sara, deinun mashche alayyhu biruta delibba yattir uvechela saggi leitkarva lemalka vechulei):
Tanya, Part III; Iggeret HaTeshuvah 9: Uveur hainyan, kemo shekkatuv bazzohar hakkadosh vetikkunim bechamma mekomot, devina – ihi teshuva illaa, "vehaem rovetzet al haefrochim" vechulei.

Dehayynu, sheal-yede shemmitbonen bigdullat Adonai behaamakat haddaat, umolid meruach binato dechilu urechimu sichliyyim, uvetuv taam vadaat, kainyan shenneemar: "leahava et Adonai elokecha", mishshum "ki hu chayyecha vegomer", velo day lo beahava tivit hamesutteret levad vechulei, vechen beyira vafachad o busha vechulei, kannoda – azay nikret "haem rovetzet al haefrochim" vechulei.

Vehinne, ikkar haahava hi "itdabbekut rucha berucha" kemo shekkatuv: "yishshakeni minneshikot pihu vegomer", kannoda. veal ze neemar: "uvechol nafshecha", shehem hem kol chelke hannefesh: sechel umiddot, ulevushehem: machashava dibbur umaase, ledavka chullan bo yitbarech.
Dehayynu, hammiddot – bemiddotav yitbarech, "ma hu rachum vechulei".
Vehassechel – besichlo vechachmato yitbarech, hu iyyun hattora, deorayyta mechachma nafka":
Vechen hammachashava – bemachashavto yitbarech: vehaddibbur – bidvar Adonai, zo halacha, uchemo shekkatuv: "vaasim devaray beficha", "udevaray asher samti beficha":
Vehammaase – hu maase hatztzedaka, lehachayot ruach shefalim, kemo shekkatuv: "ki sheshet yamim asa Adonai vegomer", kannoda bemakom acher.

Vezo hi "itdabbekut derucha berucha" betachlit haddevekut vehayyichud, keshehi mechamat ahava vechulei. ulefi sheppegam habberit behotzaat zera levattala, veen tzarich lomar baarayot, o shear issure bia deorayyta o derabbanan (ki chamurim divre sofrim vechulei) pogem bammoach, lachen tikkuno hu deyitassek beorayyta, demechachma nafka.

Vezehu shekkatuv betana deve eliyyahu: "adam avar avera venitchayyev mita lammakom, ma yaase veyichye? im haya ragil likrot daf echad – yikra 2 dappim, lishnot perek echad – yishne 2 perakim vechulei". vehayeynu, kimshal chevel hannifsak vechozer vekoshro, shebbimkom hakkesher hu kaful umechuppal, vechacha hu bechevel nachalato" vechulei.
Vezehu sheamar hakkatuv: "bechesed veemet yechuppar avon vegomer", "veen emet ella tora vechulei".
